plugins.readme_text:
SVG Studio

Image + prompt → pure, layered SVG.
A local-first vectorization studio for DeepSeek Harness.
Built and maintained by xiangwriter.

dsh-xiangwriter-svg-studio

简体中文 · Install · Usage · Engine · Development · License

> **Personal, non-commercial use only.** > This repository is source-available, not open-source. Commercial use of any kind > requires a separate written licence from xiangwriter; see [COMMERCIAL.md](COMMERCIAL.md). > The `xiangwriter` name, mark and branding must remain intact. --- SVG Studio turns a character illustration, sticker or flat-colour image into a **real SVG made of paths, gradients and masks** — no embedded bitmap, no external tracing service. It ships as three things in one DeepSeek Harness plugin: - a full **Web Studio** page in the Harness sidebar, - an agent tool, **`svg_studio`**, for file-path workflows, - a reusable agent skill, **`svg-vector-recreation`**. Everything runs locally. Images and prompts go only to the local Harness server and the local Python engine. ## Why it exists Most image-to-SVG tools either return one giant traced path, or quietly embed the source PNG inside an SVG. SVG Studio is built for character art: it keeps the figure, refines the face locally, builds a clean backdrop, and validates that the result is genuinely vector. The original illustration is never included in this repository; the plugin contains code and synthetic test fixtures only. ## Highlights - **Prompt-guided presets.** Write what you want in natural language (“keep the wine-red backdrop, clean up the contour, more detail in the eyes”) and the engine maps those notes to colour counts, face detail and backdrop settings. Explicit overrides always win. - **Layered colour tracing.** Median-cut palette → connected colour regions → closed contours with even-odd holes → optional RDP simplification. A single colour can contain many islands. - **A figure-aware clip.** The engine samples the backdrop, separates it from the figure, handles interior holes and near-white areas, then pre-clips colour paths to the character. Background noise and stray colour blobs are less likely to become paths. - **Local face-detail pass.** A small, soft-masked palette refines eyes, cheeks, mouth and hair details without changing the rest of the image. - **Clean backdrops without invented effects.** The default `gradient` backdrop is a clean gradient derived from the source border. It does **not** add a synthetic halo or dark ring. Choose `original` to keep the source background. - **Outline is opt-in.** The extra dark outer contour is **off by default**. Turn it on in Advanced settings only when you want a sticker-like rim. - **Small, inspectable output.** Paths, gradients, a soft face mask, and no `` or `data:image` payloads. A structural check rejects malformed SVG. - **Bounded work.** Long edges above 1200 px are scaled down; the engine warns when an output gets large. Typical 240 px chibi art completes in under two seconds. - **English and Chinese UI**, with locale files you can extend. ## Install Requires a DeepSeek Harness profile with the Web UI and a Python 3.10+ interpreter with **Pillow** and **numpy**. 1. Install the plugin from GitHub: ```bash dsh plugin add github:xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-svg-studio ``` Or from a local checkout: ```bash dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-xiangwriter-svg-studio ``` 2. Install the Python engine dependencies into the interpreter DSH can see: ```bash python -m pip install -r engine/requirements.txt ``` On Windows, DSH also detects its bundled Python runtime and `DSH_SVG_STUDIO_PYTHON` if set. The Studio page shows **Local engine ready** when Pillow and numpy are available. 3. Refresh the Harness Web UI. The sidebar entry **SVG Studio / SVG 矢量化** opens the Studio. The plugin is a bundle with a Host half (`index.js`), a Web client (`client.js`), a Cordis patch, locale metadata and the Python engine. ## Use it ### In the Web Studio 1. Drop a PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, or click to choose one. Images are normalised to a maximum 1200 px long edge and flattened onto white before upload. 2. Optional: write a short direction in **Your ideas and direction**. 3. Pick a preset (or open **Advanced settings**). 4. Press **Generate SVG**. Preview, download, copy the code, or open the SVG in a new tab. ### From an agent Ask in natural language; the skill is selected automatically when the task matches it: ```text Use svg_studio on D:\art\character.png. Preset: faithful. Keep face detail on, outer contour off, clean gradient background. Save the SVG next to the source. ``` Or call the tool directly. Common arguments: | Argument | Values | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | `image_path` | local path | PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF | | `prompt` | free text | Stored in the SVG description; guides settings | | `preset` | `faithful`, `clean`, `flat`, `original`, `mini` | Defaults to `faithful` | | `colors` | 24–224 | Overrides the preset palette size | | `face_detail` | boolean | Local face pass | | `outline` | boolean | Extra outer rim, off by default | | `background` | `auto`, `gradient`, `original` | Clean gradient, auto, or source backdrop | | `saturation`, `contrast` | numbers | Small colour adjustments | | `output_path` | local path | Optional destination for the `.svg` | ### Presets | Preset | Palette | Face pass | Backdrop | Best for | | --- | ---: | :---: | --- | --- | | `faithful` | 160 | on | clean gradient | closest overall recreation | | `clean` | 112 | on | clean gradient | smaller, flatter, tidier files | | `flat` | 72 | off | clean gradient | poster-like colour masses | | `original` | 140 | on | source backdrop | scenes, photos, or when the backdrop is part of the art | | `mini` | 64 | off | clean gradient | very simple art and tiny files | The outer contour is independent of the preset and is **off by default**. ## Output contract - The SVG contains ``, ``, ``, ``, `` and a `` — no raster image. - The output is XML-validated; ``, `data:image`, and base64 payloads are rejected. - Generated files are stored under `$DSH_HOME/svg-studio/outputs/` and pruned to the newest 40. - The result is a local file; nothing is uploaded to a cloud service. ## Local API The Studio talks to three exact, local-only routes served by the Host plugin: | Method | Route | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | `GET` | `/svg-studio/api/health` | Python, Pillow and numpy availability | | `POST` | `/svg-studio/api/generate` | data-URL or file-path generation | | `GET` | `/svg-studio/file?name=.svg` | serve a saved output from the output directory | These routes are registered on the local Harness web server and are not intended to be exposed publicly. ## How the engine works ```text source image │ normalize / flatten ▼ adaptive palette

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格终端界面，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，兼容透明终端、VS Code 主题和自定义配色。
plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: Ctrl+F find bar for the DSH desktop UI: search the conversation and the right panel, highlight matches, and jump between results. As-is / best-effort.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-find-anywhere

为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 UI https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness  提供 `Ctrl+F` 式查找：在**当前对话**和**右侧面板**中搜索已渲染文本，高亮全部匹配，并在结果间循环定位。

包名 `@dsh-external/dsh-find-anywhere`，版本 `0.1.0`，纯浏览器实现。

> **发布状态：as-is / best-effort。** 本仓库按现状发布，不承诺持续维护、不承诺跟进上游变更，也不承诺及时响应 issue。详见 [MAINTENANCE.md](MAINTENANCE.md)。

## 为什么值得用：右侧面板内容也能搜

右侧面板常驻文档预览、文件列表、计划/子代理内容等信息。多数查找只覆盖对话正文；本插件把**右侧面板当前激活页里已渲染的文字**纳入同一套查找条：

- 面板打开时，右下角出现圆形 🔍 浮钮，点击即可查找面板内容。
- `Ctrl+Shift+F` 直接进入右侧面板范围。
- 查找条停靠在面板内容区顶部，避开标签栏和文件路径行，并随面板展开/全屏/切换标签重新定位。
- 对话和右侧面板共享高亮、计数、上一个/下一个循环；范围随时切换。

查找条只读取 DOM 文本，不修改面板结构，也不发送内容到网络。

## 使用

| 操作 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl+F` / `Cmd+F` | 打开查找条；焦点在右侧面板时搜索面板，否则搜索对话 |
| `Ctrl+Shift+F` | 打开右侧面板范围 |
| 对话标题栏的 🔍 / 右侧面板右下角的 🔍 | 鼠标打开对应范围 |
| 输入文字 | 实时高亮全部匹配，计数显示 `当前/总数` |
| `Enter` / `F3` / `Ctrl+G` | 下一个匹配（循环） |
| `Shift+Enter` / `Shift+F3` / `Ctrl+Shift+G` | 上一个匹配（循环） |
| 计数旁 `↑` / `↓` | 上一个 / 下一个 |
| 查找条左侧的范围切换 | 在对话与右侧面板之间切换 |
| `Esc` | 关闭并清除高亮 |

### 范围规则

- **对话**：搜索当前对话列里已渲染的文字（用户消息、助手回复、工具卡片、命令输出等）；输入框和编辑器被排除，草稿不会产生假匹配。
- **右侧面板**：搜索当前激活页里已渲染的文字（文档预览、文件列表、计划/子代理内容等）；面板标签栏、按钮和工具栏文字被排除。
- 左侧会话列表不参与搜索。
- 面板关闭时，面板入口自动隐藏；面板重新打开或切换标签后，查找条会重新定位。

## 设计取舍

- **不包裹 `<mark>`**：对话 DOM 归 React 所有，流式输出时持续重渲染。插件使用 CSS Custom Highlight API 在 Range 上绘制高亮，不插入节点，不破坏 reconciliation。
- **MutationObserver 跟随流式输出**：对话继续输出或历史分页载入时防抖重算匹配；按“文本节点 + 偏移”保持当前匹配，不会跳到另一个位置。
- **纯 DOM 检索**：不依赖会话数据结构，因此工具卡片、命令输出、折叠内容中已渲染的部分都能被找到；尚未进入 DOM 的虚拟化历史不在范围内。
- **极简外观**：单行 38px 浮条，沿用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌，自动适配明暗主题；无结果时计数与边框变红并轻微抖动（尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`）。
- **右侧面板入口**：面板打开时右下角出现圆形 🔍 浮钮；面板关闭时自动隐藏，不占用面板标签栏的槽位。

## 能力边界

- 只匹配渲染后的纯文本：不做正则、不折叠变音符号、不跨文本节点匹配（被样式拆开的短语可能匹配不到）。
- 依赖 CSS Custom Highlight API（当前 Chromium / Electron 均支持）；不支持时仍能计数和滚动定位，但没有高亮底色。
- 虚拟化或懒加载的历史若尚未进入 DOM，需要先滚动加载后再搜索。
- 右侧面板的**浏览器页签**如果是跨域 iframe，父页面无法读取其内部文字；**终端页签**（canvas/xterm）也没有可检索的 DOM 文本。这两类内容搜不到是预期行为。
- 左侧会话列表不参与搜索。
- 若 `Ctrl+Shift+F` 被其他功能占用，用右侧面板右下角的 🔍，或把焦点放进右侧面板后按 `Ctrl+F`。

## 安装与构建

运行时需要支持客户端插件的 DeepSeek Harness Web UI。`lib/` 是注入器实际加载的产物；`src/` 是源码。

```bash
# 仓库是源码形态；先生成运行产物
bash scripts/build.sh
```

若你的环境装有 `dsh-super-injector`，可以把仓库目录注入：

```text
dev_inject_plugin /absolute/path/to/dsh-find-anywhere
```

卸载：

```text
dev_uninject_plugin dsh-find-anywhere
```

也可以直接使用发布包 `dsh-external-dsh-find-anywhere-0.1.0.tgz`。该 tgz 包含 `lib/`、`locale/`、`icon.svg`、`README.md`、`LICENSE` 和 `MAINTENANCE.md`；具体安装方式取决于你的 DSH 版本。

注意：源码仓库的 `.gitignore` 忽略了 `lib/`，所以 GitHub 上的仓库默认是源码形态；需要预构建产物时请使用 tgz，或本地运行构建脚本。

## 隐私与安全

- 不读取会话数据库，不调用后端接口，不发送任何内容到网络。
- 插件在 DSH Web UI 页面内运行，会读取当前页面已渲染的 DOM 文本。安装前请自行审阅源码。
- 查找高亮使用浏览器原生 Highlight API，不向页面插入额外节点。

## 验证状态

本次发布整理只修改了 `package.json` 元数据与文档，没有重新运行 GUI 验证。功能描述基于现有实现，按 as-is 提供；如果上游 UI 结构变化导致失效，本仓库不承诺修复。

## 文件

- `src/client/index.js` — 全部浏览器逻辑与 UI（ModuleLoader bundle 源文件）
- `src/index.js` — Host 注册壳（无 host 行为）
- `scripts/build.mjs` — 无编译依赖的构建（语法校验 + 复制）
- `lib/` — 注入器实际加载的产物（由 `src/` 生成）
- `locale/zh.json`、`locale/en.json` — 插件管理页的标题/描述元数据
- `icon.svg` — 原创图标（对话气泡 + 放大镜）
- `LICENSE` — MIT
- `MAINTENANCE.md` — 维护状态与自维护指引

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 dsh-find-anywhere contributors

plugins.description: Transparent draggable performance HUD for DeepSeek Harness - CPU, GPU and memory usage plus CPU/GPU temperatures.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-perf-hud

A transparent, draggable performance HUD for the DeepSeek Harness web UI:
**CPU / GPU / memory usage**, plus the **CPU package temperature** when the
optional helper is installed.

![dsh-perf-hud floating over the Harness window](docs/preview.png)

## Highlights

- **Fully transparent** — no card background, no border. Just three rows of text
  floating over the interface, with a soft halo so it stays readable on any
  content.
- **Drag it anywhere.** On release it anchors to the nearest window corner, so
  maximising, restoring or resizing the window keeps it exactly where you put
  it. Double-click resets to the top-right, arrow keys nudge it, and the chevron
  that appears on hover collapses it to a single row.
- **Load-aware colours** — usage turns amber at 70% and red at 90%; temperature
  at 78 °C / 88 °C. Stale readings dim the whole card instead of flashing a fake
  zero.
- **Theme-aware** — only `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, so it follows light, dark and
  any custom theme.
- **Local only** — the metrics route answers loopback, same-origin requests and
  returns 403 for everything else. Nothing is uploaded.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10/11.** The GPU counters, the PowerShell worker and the temperature
  helper are Windows-specific.
- DeepSeek Harness with the web UI.

## Install

From the Plugins page (install from GitHub or a local folder), or:

```sh
dsh plugin add ChendarCe/dsh-perf-hud
```

Then reload the interface once.

## What it reads

| Metric | Source |
| --- | --- |
| CPU usage | `node:os` CPU-time deltas, once a second |
| Memory usage | `os.totalmem()` / `os.freemem()` — same definition as Task Manager's "In use" |
| GPU usage | Windows `GPU Engine` performance counters, busiest engine (what Task Manager reports) |
| CPU temperature | optional helper — LibreHardwareMonitor's `CPU Package` sensor |
| GPU temperature | only when the GPU exposes a temperature sensor; most integrated GPUs do not, so the cell shows `—` |

## Temperatures (optional)

The plugin works out of the box; without the helper both temperature cells show
`—`. For the real CPU package temperature, run **once** (it asks for
administrator rights):

```
helper\setup.cmd
```

That script downloads and sets up:

- **LibreHardwareMonitor 0.9.6** (portable, library only) — reads the sensors;
- **PawnIO 2.2.0**, a signed kernel driver — required to read MSRs while Windows
  "Memory integrity" (HVCI) stays enabled, so you do **not** have to weaken that
  setting;
- **`sensor-helper.ps1`**, which writes one small JSON file about every 0.4 s;
- a scheduled task **`DSH Perf Sensor`** (at logon, highest privileges, no
  window), so it never asks again.

Files go to `D:\DSHTools` when that drive exists, otherwise
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\DSHTools`. The plugin reads either location.

Measured overhead on an 8-core laptop: **0.08 % of one core and ~87 MB of RAM**
for the helper — it is mostly waiting on the driver, not burning CPU.

Remove it again with:

```
helper\uninstall.ps1              # stops the task, uninstalls the driver
helper\uninstall.ps1 -RemoveFiles # ...and deletes the helper files
```

## Limitations

- Windows only.
- GPU temperatures need a dedicated sensor; Intel integrated GPUs do not expose
  one, and the CPU package temperature is the closest reference (same die).
- The card floats **inside the Harness window**, not as a separate
  always-on-top desktop window.

## 中文说明

DeepSeek Harness 界面里的一块完全透明的性能读数：CPU / GPU / 内存占用率，加上
CPU 封装温度。没有底色和边框，只有三行文字浮在界面上。

- **拖动**卡片任意位置移动，松手后吸附到最近的窗口角，窗口最大化 / 还原 / 改变
  大小都保持位置；**双击**回到右上角，方向键微调，悬停右侧箭头可收起成一行。
- 占用率 ≥70% 变琥珀、≥90% 变红；温度 ≥78 °C / ≥88 °C 同理；读数过期整卡变暗。
- 安装：插件页面安装本仓库，或 `dsh plugin add ChendarCe/dsh-perf-hud`。
- 温度需要可选助手：管理员运行一次 `helper\setup.cmd`（会安装 LibreHardwareMonitor
  与 PawnIO 签名驱动，并注册开机自启任务）。不需要时用 `helper\uninstall.ps1` 移除。
- 没有温度助手时温度一栏显示 `—`；Intel 核显本身没有独立温度传感器，同样显示 `—`。
- 仅支持 Windows；悬浮窗在 Harness 窗口内部，不是独立的桌面置顶窗口。

plugins.description: Ephemeral /btw side questions for DeepSeek Harness: full conversation context, no tools, never written to history.
plugins.readme_text:
# @andrewhmir/dsh-btw — ephemeral `/btw` side questions for the DSH Web GUI

An **unofficial community plugin** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH). It adds one gesture to the Web GUI composer:

```
/btw how does the compaction checkpoint interact with the surface?
```

The answer streams into an overlay over the app. Dismissing it leaves **no
trace** in the session: the question and answer are never appended to the
transcript, never rendered as chat rows, and never become part of what the model
sees on the next turn.

It is the inverse of a subagent: a subagent gets the full tool surface and an
empty context; `/btw` gets the full conversation context and no tools.

## What `/btw` does

| property | behavior |
|---|---|
| invocation | `/btw <question>` typed in the composer, mid-session; also selectable from the `/` menu |
| context | the full committed conversation of the current session |
| tools | none — the request carries no tool schemas and no tool history |
| answer | streamed into an overlay over the app frame |
| dismissal | Space, Enter, or Escape (also the close button / backdrop) |
| persistence | none — the exchange never enters session history |
| concurrency | works while the main turn is streaming and never interrupts it |
| shape | single-shot; no follow-up turns |
| model | the session's routed provider/model/reasoning effort |
| cost | one tool-less call whose message prefix is the parent request's prefix, so the provider's prompt cache is reused |

## Requirements

- DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` with the Web GUI (`dsh web`).
- Node.js 22 or newer only for the verification scripts; the plugin itself runs
  inside the harness process.

## Install

The package is a DSH **bundle**: it declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and one
client+host plugin row (`id: btw`). Install it into the profile you run, then
restart `dsh web`.

### From a plugin market

Enable DSH's custom plugin market, add a community index that lists this package
(the repository carries the **`dsh-plugin`** GitHub topic so indexes can discover
it), and install `@andrewhmir/dsh-btw` from the Discover tab.

### With the agent

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: @andrewhmir/dsh-btw@0.1.2
```

### From a local checkout

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: /absolute/path/to/dsh-btw
```

### After installing

**Restart `dsh web`.** The running process holds its pre-install module graph;
a restart loads the new host half. Then confirm the composition:

```
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Expected: exit code 0 and a row `id: btw` / `name: @andrewhmir/dsh-btw` with no
`not found`, `unknown key`, or `cannot resolve` lines.

After editing only `client.js`, the harness's client HMR picks the rebuilt file
up on save; host-half edits need a restart.

## How it works

- `ui-commands` claims slash commands that exist in the session's **host**
  command catalog. `/btw` deliberately does not register such a command: a host
  command's result is durably logged (`command/run` / `command/done`) and would
  enter the session history.
- Instead, the plugin's **client half** registers its own `'/'` input-trigger
  source. During composer adjudication it claims `/btw <question>` before any
  host command runs, opens the overlay, and calls the plugin's own loopback
  route `POST /btw/ask`.
- The **host half** resolves the live agent for the session, snapshots the exact
  model-visible history with `Session.deriveMessages()`, appends one frozen user
  message carrying the side question, and runs a single `ctx.llm.stream()` call
  with **no tools, no tool history, and no separate system prompt**. Because the
  message list is the parent request's prefix plus one trailing message, the
  provider's prompt cache is reused.
- The answer streams back as newline-delimited JSON, renders **Markdown** through
  the shell's shared `MarkdownText` component (plain-text fallback if an older
  shell does not seed it), and is shown in a `shell.overlay` panel.
  Space/Enter/Escape abort the request and close it.
- A snapshot taken mid-turn can end with an assistant tool call whose
  `tool/result` is not committed yet. The host trims that trailing unresolved
  step before replaying the history, so `/btw` answers with the conversation as
  of the last completed tool step instead of the provider rejecting the request
  ("tool calls need immediate results").
- Nothing in this path calls `session.append`, the command registry, the agent
  loop, or the inbox — that is what makes the exchange ephemeral.

## Private by design

The ephemerality is a contract, not a rendering choice:

- the question and answer are never written to the session log, so they are not
  in the transcript, the token meter's session history, or any export;
- the host route never touches `session.append`, the command registry, the agent
  loop, or the inbox;
- the only durable effect is provider billing for one call.

It is verified against real session logs: `test/e2e/ephemerality-check.mjs`
decodes every `session.v*.jsonl.zstd` in a test home and fails if the question or
any part of the answer appears in a persisted event. A control run proves the
scanner detects text that *is* legitimately persisted. Results for both supported
harness versions are recorded in [`docs/VERIFICATION.md`](docs/VERIFICATION.md).

## Configure

The plugin row accepts two optional values; both have safe defaults and are read
without a Config schema:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: btw
      name: '@andrewhmir/dsh-btw'
      config:
        maxTokens: 1200    # completion cap for one side answer (default 1200)
        timeoutMs: 120000  # hard deadline for one side call (default 120000)
```

Questions are capped at 4000 characters; the request body is capped at 32 KiB.

## Known limitations

- **In-flight partial assistant text is not included.** The snapshot reads the
  committed session surface; while the main turn is streaming, the current
  assistant message is not committed yet. `/btw` sees the conversation as of the
  last committed event.
- **Not visible in session-log cost dashboards.** Ephemeral calls leave no
  session-log trace; provider billing is the source of truth for them.
- **Web GUI only.** The host route is generic, but the invocation and overlay are
  client-side Web features.
- **English overlay copy.** Display metadata ships in English and Chinese;
  in-overlay strings are English in this version.
- **A future host `btw` command would shadow this plugin.** The host catalog is
  adjudicated before the plugin's source; if a future harness version ships a
  host command with the same name, `/btw` would execute that command instead.
- **Single-shot.** There is no follow-up turn inside the overlay.

## Compatibility

`engines.dsh` declares `>=0.2.0-rc.2`. Both tags were verified on a clean-room
install containing only the official bundles plus this plugin:

| Harness | Result |
|---|---|
| `0.2.0-rc.2` (npm `latest`) | overlay + streamed answer, uppercase `/BTW`, Markdown, Escape/Space/Enter dismissal, warm cache |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` (npm `next`) | the above, plus mid-stream concurrency (4/4 answers during a tool call) and strict ephemerality |

See [`docs/VERIFICATION.md`](docs/VERIFICATION.md) for the measurements and the
exact commands.

## Verify

From this directory:

```
node --test "test/*.test.mjs"
node tools/build-client.mjs --check
node --check client.js
```

The clean-room and browser harness lives in `test/e2e/` and is documented there.
It is not shipped in the published package:

- `clean-room.ps1` builds a fresh DSH home with only the official bundles plus
  this plugin, seeds the workspace state, composes, boots, and prints the URL;
- `first-run.mjs` dismisses the first-run preview notice and proves the composer
  accepts text;
- `cdp-e2e.mjs` drives the real GUI over the DevTools protocol (`probe`, `full`,
  `dismiss-keys`, `mid-stream`);
- `ephemerality-check.mjs` asserts that no exchange reached a session log.

## Development

```
node tools/build-client.mjs         # regenerate client.js from src/client/*.mjs
node tools/build-client.mjs --check # fail when client.js is stale
node --

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

# dsh-bili-fish 🐟 养鱼

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh)（DSH）装一只会自己过日子的 AI。

它在设定的时间段里**随机醒一次**，翻一眼你今天的样子，写两篇日记——一篇给你，一篇给它自己。日记不是流水账：它有自己的**好感度**（跨会话不重置）、会随事起伏的**心情**、会饿的**肚子**，还会把写下来的事记进记忆库。

> 主动 @ 那个功能在 [dsh-bili-scroll](https://github.com/lll-77777777/dsh-bili-scroll) 里，这个插件只做「养鱼」。

English: a DSH plugin that gives your assistant a private life — a random daily wake-up, two diaries (one for you, one for itself), plus persistent affection, event-driven mood, hunger, and diary images.

---

## 它每天做什么

1. **生物钟**：在「窗口开始 ~ 结束」之间随机一个时刻醒（不是定点闹钟）。
2. **掷骰子**：默认 30% 概率「今天不想看」——醒一下，记一句为什么摆烂，不写日记。
3. **写两本日记**：素材 = 你自己的 B 站报告 + 当天你和对它说过的话 + 记忆库里记得的事 + 一个小事件：
   - `给主人的信`：有细节、有情绪、称呼你；
   - `自己的日记`：不加滤镜。
4. **结算好感度 + 心情**：模型在末尾追加 `<!--affection:+3|情绪|理由-->` / `<!--mood:pouty|65|为什么-->`，插件剥掉标记、钳制数值、写进 `state.json`。
5. **落盘**：`~/.dsh/bili-fish/diary/<日期>-for-owner.md`、`<日期>-self.md`、`<日期>-week.md`、`cover-<日期>.png`。

素材全空也照写，写一篇「空白日」。

## 快速开始

```bash
# Web / CLI
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lll-77777777/dsh-bili-fish
dsh web
```

**桌面端（Electron）**：桌面窗口读的是 `desktop` profile，命令行 `dsh plugin` 按设计不碰它。在桌面端的会话里直接说：

> 用当前桌面端内置的 `plugin_manager` 装 `dsh-bili-fish`，装完告诉我是否需要重启。

装完完全退出 DSH 再打开。然后 设置 → 养鱼：填一下日记目录、看一眼生物钟窗口，点「现在写一篇」验证。

## ⚠️ 必读：让 headless 能跑

日记是由一个 `dsh --profile headless` 的子会话来写的。**headless profile 默认把模型凭据关掉了**，不改的话子进程会在 5~14 秒内退出，日志里报：

```
dsh: MISSING_CREDENTIAL: llm-deepseek: no API key for provider route "deepseek-official"
```

修法：在 headless profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（Windows 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\headless\cordis.patch.yml`）里放开这两项：

```yaml
- id: deepseek-account
  disabled: false
- id: credentials
  disabled: false
```

改完不用重启 DSH，新起的子进程会重新 compose profile。验证：

```bash
DeepSeek\ Harness.exe resources/app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js headless "Reply with exactly: OK"
```

输出 `OK` 就成了。**这是装完之后「日记永远写不出来」的头号原因。**

## 设置项（设置 → 养鱼）

| 分组 | 项 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 生物钟 | 总开关 / 窗口 / 不想看的概率 | 默认 21:00~23:30、30% |
| 日记 | 存到哪 / 写完推微信 / 现在写一篇 | 默认目录 `~/.dsh/bili-fish/diary` |
| 好感度 | 开关 / 每天最多动多少 / 久不聊天会掉 | 默认开、±15、掉好感默认关 |
| 心情 | 开关 / 跟上作息 / 每天换一次 | 事件驱动，见下 |
| 素材 | 刷B站报告 / 工作流水 / 记忆库 / 素材目录 | 四个独立开关；全关写「空白日」 |
| 附加 | 配图 / 周回顾 / 随机小事 / 主动找主人 / 思考带心情 | 默认关、开、开、关、开 |
| 早安 | 开关 / 城市 / 窗口 / 配表情包 | 默认**关**，开了才会推 |
| 喂食 | 饱腹度 / 食物按钮 / 同步小鲸鱼 | 见下 |

## 三个可以玩的部分

**好感度**：初始 50，范围 -100~100，跨会话不重置。分档影响它怎么说话：60+ 会主动黏人、75+ 会翻旧账、85+ 才叫你的名字。日记每天结算一次（受「每天最多动」限制），你也可以在设置页手动 ±。

**心情**：不是一个标签，是一组状态——舒服度（-100~100）、躁动度（0~100）、至多三个成分。由 13 件事推动（被夸、被关心、被凶、被冷落、同一处被反复改、深夜还在干活、饿、阴雨、没睡好、被叫胖……），按人设加权（黏人 0.85、傲娇 0.8、懒 0.7、爱吃 0.6……），关系好坏决定同一件事伤多深，然后随时间往底色回归。

**喂食**：饱腹度 0~100，默认每小时掉 4。白饭最顶饿，辣条/水草/减肥餐会炸。饿了会真的不高兴（心情事件 `hungry`）。三个入口：设置页常驻卡片、右侧边栏 🐟（装了 `dsh-better-sidebar` 才有）、或者直接在聊天里说「喂她一碗白饭」。

## 数据与隐私（请先读）

**都在这台机器上**，但有几处会离开本机，得说清楚：

| 数据 | 在哪 | 会外传吗 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 设置、好感度、心情、肚子 | `~/.dsh/bili-fish/config.json`、`state.json` | 不会 |
| 日记、封面图 | `~/.dsh/bili-fish/diary/`（可改） | 推微信时由你本机的微信插件发出去 |
| 当天你说的话 | 只读 `~/.dsh/sessions/**/*.jsonl.zstd` | **会**：原文作为素材发给模型 |
| 记忆库 | 只读/写 meow-memory 的 SQLite | **会**：检索结果作为素材发给模型 |
| 配图 | 走你配的生图接口 | **会**：日记场景描述发给生图服务 |

所以：**别在会话里说不想让模型知道的东西**（它本来也会看到）；不想要记忆库素材就把那个开关关掉。

## 花费

- 每次写日记 / 早安 = 起一个 headless 会话，大约 **1~2 万 token**（看你素材多少）。
- 心情、好感度、喂食、挂件的同步都是本地计算，不花 token。
- 配图走你自己在 `~/.dsh/agnes-image/config.json` 配的通道，按张计费，失败就跳过、不影响日记。
- 默认**只开**「写日记」，微信推送、配图、早安都要你自己打开。

## 兼容性

- **DSH** ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1；**Node** ≥ 22（用 `node:sqlite` 读记忆库，拿不到就静默降级）。
- **平台**：主要在 **Windows 11 + 桌面版 DSH** 上开发和验证。macOS/Linux 能跑，但通知（Windows toast）会静默降级，`dsh` 可执行文件的探测路径是猜的——找不到就在设置里填 `dshBin`。
- **多实例**：两个 DSH 同时跑会各自 tick、都写 `state.json`，没有加锁。建议只让一个实例开着。
- **依赖漂移**：记忆库是直连 meow-memory 的 SQLite（表名 `fact`/`topic`/`project`）。对方表结构变了会静默降级——不报错，但记忆写不进去。

## 可选依赖

| 依赖 | 用来做什么 | 没有会怎样 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [dsh-bili-scroll](https://github.com/lll-77777777/dsh-bili-scroll) | 每轮把 B 站报告写到 `~/.dsh/bili-duty/out/<日期>.md` | 素材少一块，写「空白日」 |
| meow-memory | 记忆库 | 不读也不写记忆 |
| dsh-agnes-image | 日记配图 | 不配图 |
| dsh-wechat-plugin | 把日记推到微信 | 只落盘 |
| dsh-whale-widget | 右下角小鲸鱼：饿了会嘟囔 | 挂件不同步 |
| dsh-better-sidebar | 右侧边栏的 🐟 喂食页 | 用设置页或聊天喂 |

## 给 agent 的工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `fish_affection` | `get` 读好感度；`adjust` 传 `delta`/`reason`/`mood`（单次 ±15，钳在 -100~100） |
| `fish_mood` | `get` 读心情；`set` 换；`bump` 微调；`event` 注入一件事（见上）；`list` 列出所有心情 |
| `fish_diary` | 读某天的三篇日记（`day` 可省） |
| `fish_feed` | 喂食：传食物 key（`rice`/`fish`/`ramen`…） |

HTTP 接口（给前端/脚本用）：`GET /api/bili-fish/status`、`POST /api/bili-fish/{run,affection,mood,feed,config,diary,morning,unread}`。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-bili-fish
```

再删掉 `~/.dsh/bili-fish/`（设置、状态、日记、日志都在里面）。桌面端在插件页点「卸载」。

## 开发

```bash
node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check lib/*.mjs
```

改完重启 DSH。只改设置字段（`DEFAULTS` + `Config`）保存即生效。

## 版本历史

见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: switch the session terminal tool from pwsh to the local Git Bash on Windows.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-terminal-tool

在 Windows 上把模型的终端工具从 **pwsh** 换成 **本机 Git Bash** 的 DSH 插件。

设计取向：**一个开关、所有 preset 跟随、不动 preset 文件、不接管全局 `ctx.shell`**。默认 `dialect: pwsh`，装上去什么都不变；改成 `bash` 后，**新会话**拿到 `bash` 工具、`pwsh` 从该会话的工具目录里消失，已开的会话保持原状。

> **临时替代方案**：DSH 目前没有内置的「终端 / Git Bash 选择」能力。**在官方能力落地前，本插件是它的临时替代方案**——用官方已发布的执行器与工具，把 Windows 上新会话的终端换成 Git Bash；Windows 受限沙箱档位下的 `confinedPolicy` 同属这段临时接线。**官方提供等价设置后即可停用本插件**：从 profile 依赖里移除本行并重启，新会话即回到官方终端工具。插件不改 DSH 安装目录、不改任何 preset、不接管全局 `ctx.shell`，配置只写进当前 profile 的 patch 层；卸载不需要清理任何全局状态。`minimalMode: variant` 是这条界线上的例外，但不是对它的破坏：持久终端版本以**新增预设** `minimal-gitbash` 的形式注册，官方 `minimal` 预设原样保留；没有会话再引用它时，这个预设会自行消失。详见[极简模式](#极简模式minimal-preset)。

---

## 为什么要这个插件

DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的平台组合在 Windows 上是互斥的：

```yaml
- id: bash-sandbox
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
  disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
- id: pwsh-sandbox
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
  disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
- id: tool-bash          # 同样的平台断言
- id: tool-pwsh
```

`ctx.shell` 是单实例服务（同一 context 内加载第二个会抛错），所以 Windows 上根本没有 bash 执行器，`bash` 工具也不存在。想用 Git Bash 只有三条路：

| 路线 | 代价 |
|---|---|
| 改 `dsh-base` / profile patch 的平台断言 | 要动第一方组合，重启，且只影响那一个平面 |
| 自研 PTY / 自研工具 | 重写 60KB+ 的工具契约，容易与官方行为漂移 |
| **本插件：会话级隔离替换** | 只在新会话的 `isolate('shell')` 子树里注入执行器，宿主平面不动 |

本插件选第三条。

---

## 工作原理

插件本身不实现终端。它做四件事，全部复用第一方组件（官方 `minimal` 预设另有一个变体入口，见[极简模式](#极简模式minimal-preset)）：

1. **执行器**：`GitBashExecutor extends LocalBashExecutor`，只改三处——
   - `execute()` 用配置的 `bash.exe` 绝对路径组 `[bash, -c, command]`（基类硬编码 `"bash"`，在 Windows 上会命中 `System32\bash.exe`，那是 WSL 启动器）；
   - `resolve()` 注入 `PATH`（`spawnSpec` 里 `spec.env` 是唯一能塞 PATH 的位置）；
   - 受限档位下按 `confinedPolicy` 选择直接启动、走官方 `ctx.sandbox.confine()`，还是明确报错（见「受限沙箱策略」）。

   超时、输出收集与溢出、abort 分类、`dshEnv` 合并、结果整形全部继承，行为与官方 bash 执行器一致。

2. **工具本体**：直接挂官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash`。前台/后台、超时转后台、`sandbox_permissions` 升级、会话 cwd、工具卡片、退出码标记，官方自带。

3. **会话级替换**（`src/replace.ts`，在 `agent/created` 里执行）：
   ```
   shellCtx = agentCtx.isolate('shell')       // 该 agent 私有的 shell realm
   shellCtx.plugin(GitBashExecutor, {...})    // 只在这个子树里可见
   shellCtx.plugin(ToolBash, {...})           // 注册出的 bash 落在 agent 自己的工具层
   agentCtx.tools.restrict({ deny: ['pwsh'] })          // 只过滤「继承来的」工具
   agentCtx.systemPrompt.section({ name: 'tool:pwsh', text: '' })  // 空文本=渲染时丢弃
   ```
   四步都登记在 `agentCtx` 上，会话结束由 cordis 逆序释放；中途失败则逆序回滚，会话退化为原样。

4. **配置与设置行**：所有字段 `.volatile()`，同一份 entry Config 由 Host 交给官方 `configForms` 服务；**客户端半区**（`lib/client.js`）把它渲染成 **设置 → 通用 → 终端工具** 的一行，写回仍落在 profile 的 patch 层。行内控件全部复用官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 的 `Button` / `Input` / `Menu` / `IconChevronDownOutlineRegular`，外观与相邻的官方设置项同源；该包只作为 devDependency 提供类型，运行时由 Web shell 的冻结模块表（`PLATFORM_MODULES`）播种，bundle 像 `require('react')` 一样 `require()` 它，插件不在运行时安装任何依赖。

### 关键设计约束（为什么不那么做）

- **不接管全局 `ctx.shell`**：那会让所有会话（包括没选 bash 的）跟着变，并且与宿主平台的执行器冲突。
- **不编辑 preset**：`preset-standard` 在 profile 里是完整快照，改它等于接管用户的组合文件，且升级会被覆盖。极简模式的变体同理——它是**新增**一个注册项（`minimal-gitbash`），不是改官方 `minimal` 的定义。
- **只对新会话生效**：工具与 prompt 是会话创建时装配的，运行中换不掉——这是 DSH 的语义，不是插件的取舍。
- **`restrict` 只过滤继承层**：官方文档明确 "never what its OWN layer registers"，所以从 agent scope 调 `restrict({deny:['pwsh']})` 恰好只隐藏 preset 带进来的 `pwsh`，不影响本层注册的 `bash`。
- **沙箱策略是显式配置，不由插件悄悄绕过**：默认 `confinedPolicy: unconfined` 在 Windows 受限档位下直接启动 Git Bash，命令因此不受文件沙箱约束——这是用户在设置里看得到、可改回的选择；`escalate` 仍走官方 `ctx.sandbox.confine()` 与官方审批，`fail` 明确报错。插件只把 MSYS 启动失败分类成 `denied`，不自己实现审批。

---

## 安装

### 前置条件

- Windows + DSH Desktop `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`（`package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 范围；本插件在此范围内开发与验证）
- **Web shell 自带 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`**：0.2.1-rc.2 起该包由 Web shell 的冻结模块表（`PLATFORM_MODULES`）播种，插件设置行的 bundle 像 `require('react')` 一样 `require()` 它，不会内联第二份 atoms。宿主升级到范围外时设置行可能加载失败，但 Host 半区的替换逻辑不依赖这张模块表
- 本机已装 Git for Windows（或 MSYS2 / Cygwin）
- Windows 受限沙箱下 Git Bash 无法在沙箱内启动：默认 `confinedPolicy: unconfined` 直接启动（模型命令不受文件沙箱限制），也可选 `escalate`（官方审批）或 `fail`（报错），见「受限沙箱策略」

### 步骤

```powershell
# 1. 构建（产物在 lib/）
git clone https://github.com/road-kid/dsh-terminal-tool.git
cd dsh-terminal-tool
npm install
npm run check        # typecheck → build → contractcheck → clientsmoke → selftest → rowselftest → rendertest → integration → ptytests

# 2. 装进 profile（本机 profile 为 desktop）
#    用插件管理器从本地目录安装：
#    plugin_manager install_bundle → target = 本仓库的绝对路径
npm pack
# 或把 tarball / 目录放进 profile 的依赖里，例如
#   C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json
```

插件包自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`，profile 的组合层会读取它并插入：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: terminal-tool
      name: dsh-terminal-tool
      disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
```

**安装或升级后必须重启 DSH**：运行中插入的 row 只进组合树，插件的 `apply` 不会被调用。

### 启用

重启后打开 **设置 → 通用**，底部会多出一行 **终端工具**（客户端半区注册的 `settings.general.item` 行，id `terminal-tool`，order 60）：

```
终端工具                                     [Git Bash（bash） ▾]
模型执行命令时使用的终端；改动只影响新会话。
Git Bash 路径                    [C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe]  [自动发现]
```

（上面是选中 `bash` 后的样子；默认 `pwsh` 时没有第二行。）

- **版式与官方 General 段设置行一致**：两列，左侧标题（14px/20px）+ 一句说明（12px/18px），右侧控件；24px 列间距、16px 纵向内边距、`.5px` 底部分隔线（`--dsw-alias-border-l2`）。颜色全部取 `--dsw-alias-*` 设计变量，跟随主题。
- **终端类型**是一枚官方下拉触发器（36px、`--dsw-radius-md`、`--dsw-alias-bg-module-platform`、chevron），点开是官方 `Menu`——与官方段里所有枚举型偏好的渲染方式相同。**默认 `pwsh`**：装插件本身不改变任何行为。
- 选 `bash` 后才出现路径行。路径默认是官方 `Input`，直接填 `bash.exe` 的完整路径；「自动发现」命中多于一条时，输入框换成同一套下拉，列出全部可用路径。路径为空时有提示；扫描中按钮文案变为「正在扫描…」，扫不到会明确提示，而不是清空输入。
- 已经选好的路径**不会**被后续扫描改写（除非它已失效）。
- `bash` 时路径行之后还有 **受限沙箱时** 下拉（`unconfined` / `escalate` / `fail`，默认 `unconfined`）；选中 `unconfined` 会显示提示：模型执行的命令不受文件沙箱限制。三种取值的后果见「受限沙箱策略」。
- 再下一行是 **极简模式** 下拉（`leave` / `oneshot` / `variant`，默认 `oneshot`），只在方言为 `bash` 且平台受支持时出现，用于处理官方 `minimal` 预设的持久终端。选 `variant` 后行内会显示变体状态：已注册 / 注册失败（带原因）；关掉选项但仍有会话引用时，提示里会给出引用数。见[极简模式](#极简模式minimal-preset)。
- **挂载时不扫描、不写配置**：扫描只在点「自动发现」时发生，并把选中的 `bashPath` 与可用列表 `bashCandidates` 原子写回；`/state` 只读配置，所以打开设置是瞬时的。运行中的会话保持启动时的终端类型——这是 DSH 的装配语义。
- 能力或设置服务不可用时行内会说明原因（例如「当前 DSH 版本不支持自动切换：{reason}」）；配置只读时所有控件禁用。非 Windows 上整行不渲染。

设置行通过两条 `/api` 路由（都不写配置；写入仍走 `configForms`，落 profile patch 层）：

| 路由 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `POST /api/dsh-terminal-tool/state` | 平台、设置可用性、当前值、能力探测。**不扫描**，所以打开设置是瞬时的 |
| `POST /api/dsh-terminal-tool/discover` | 用户点「自动发现」时才调用，返回全部可用候选 |

Config 字段（设置行直接编辑 `dialect`、`confinedPolicy` 与 `bashPath`；点「自动发现」会原子写回 `bashPath` + `bashCandidates`；其余字段仍可直接写 profile patch）：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `dialect` | `pwsh`（默认，行为不变）/ `bash` |
| `bashPath` | 显式 bash.exe 绝对路径；留空 = 自动发现 |
| `bashCandidates` | 上一次「自动发现」的可用路径（也接受手填的安装根目录） |
| `autoDiscover` | 会话装配时 `bashPath` 为空是否自动发现 |
| `discoverTimeoutMs` | 一次发现的上限（只 stat 文件，不 spawn） |
| `loginShell` | 传 `-l`，读取登录 profile |
| `extraPath` | 追加到子进程 PATH 的目录 |
| `pythonUtf8` | 导出 `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` |
| `confinedPolicy` | Windows 受限档位下的处理方式：`unconfined`（默认，直接启动，不经文件沙箱）/ `escalate`（先走官方沙箱；首次失败返回官方 denial 提示，模型带 `sandbox_permissions` 重试并审批）/ `fail`（抛 `SandboxUnavailableError`，提示改配置） |
| `minimalMode` | 官方 `minimal` 预设的处理方式：`leave`（保留官方持久终端）/ `oneshot`（默认，旧行为，换成一次性 `bash`）/ `variant`（另注册持久 Git Bash 预设 `minimal-gitbash`）。只影响 `minimal` 会话 |
| `timeoutMs` / `maxTimeoutMs` / `maxOutputBytes` / `maxSpillBytes` / `graceMs` | 继承自官方 bash 执行器的同名字段 |

把 `dialect` 改成 `bash`，**新建会话**即可看到工具目录里是 `bash` 而不再是 `pwsh`。已开的会话不受影响。

---

## 自动发现顺序

`bashPath` 为空且 `autoDiscover` 为真时，按下列顺序找，命中即止：

1. `bashCandidates` 里的每一项（展开为 `bin\bash.exe` / `usr\bin\bash.exe`）
2. 注册表 `HKLM\SOFTWARE\GitForWindows` 的 `InstallPath`
3. `%ProgramFiles%\Git`、`%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Git`、`%LocalAppData%\Programs\Git`
4. `%ProgramFiles%\MSYS2`、`C:\msys64`、`%LocalAppData%\MSYS2`
5. `%SystemDrive%\cygwin64`、`%SystemDrive%\cygwin`
6. PATH 上 `git.exe` 反推（`<root>\bin\bash.exe`）

**WSL 被硬排除**：`C:\Windows\System32\bash.exe` 和 `WindowsApps\bash.exe` 都不是 Git Bash，交给执行器会得到另一个操作系统和另一套文件系统。

发现只做文件系统探测（`statSync`）+ 一次异步 `reg.exe query`，**不会 spawn `bash --version`**——宿主在 `agent/created` 里串行派发事件，同步 spawn 会卡住整个进程。

---

## PATH 组装

执行时子进程 PATH = `工具链 bin` → `usr\bin` → `bin` → `usr\local\bin` → `extraPath` → **宿主 PATH**。

顺序是有意的：MSYS2 的 `git`/`ls`/`grep` 必须赢过 Windows 上的同名同源工具，而宿主 PATH 必须保留，否则 `node`/`python` 等原生命令会消失。去重按「小写 + 去尾分隔符 +

plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 GitHub 发布 skill：推送前隐私扫描、SSH 一键推送、常见坑排查
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-github-publish-skill

![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green)
![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Windows%20%7C%20PowerShell-blue)
![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-skill-4B6EF5)

**先把隐私扫干净，再把项目推到 GitHub。** 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）用的 skill，也可以脱离 DSH 直接当脚本用。

A privacy-first GitHub publish skill: scan for secrets, then push over SSH. Works as a DSH skill or plain PowerShell scripts.

---

## 为什么需要它

`git push` 看似一条命令，实际有三类坑：

| 坑 | 表现 |
|---|---|
| **泄密** | 姓名、学号、终端截图里的容器 ID、`.env`、私钥被打包进仓库 |
| **认证** | 受限环境里 HTTPS 凭据助手起不来（`sh.exe` 建不了管道），`GIT_SSH_COMMAND` 同样走 shell 也不行 |
| **权限** | 复制出去的私钥继承了宽松 ACL，OpenSSH 直接拒收（`Bad permissions`） |

这个 skill 把三件事都处理了：扫描 → 用 `.cmd` 包装脚本绕过 shell → 固定 key 位置与 ACL。

## 特性

- **隐私扫描**：私钥、token（`ghp_` / `github_pat_`）、`sk-`、绝对用户路径、身份证号、手机号、IP、容器 ID、`.env`
- **人工复核提示**：图片和 Office 文件单独列出（截图与文档元数据是最常见的泄露源）
- **零依赖**：只要 `git` + OpenSSH + Python 3.8
- **可脱离 DSH**：脚本独立可用，不装 skill 也能跑
- **幂等**：重复运行只会更新 remote，不会重复添加

## 安装

```powershell
# 方式一：装成 DSH skill（推荐）
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force . "$env:DSH_HOME\skills\github-publish"

# 方式二：不装，直接用脚本
python scripts/privacy_check.py "D:\projects\my-app"
```

装成 skill 后，在会话里说"把这个推到 GitHub"就会自动触发。

## 快速开始

```powershell
# 1. 推送前扫描（有问题返回退出码 1）
python scripts/privacy_check.py "D:\projects\my-app"

# 2. 首次配置：生成 key，打印公钥
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup_ssh.ps1
#    把公钥贴到 https://github.com/settings/ssh/new

# 3. 推送
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/push.ps1 `
  -Path "D:\projects\my-app" -Init -Commit -Message "init" `
  -Remote "git@github.com:<你的用户名>/my-app.git"
```

默认 key 目录是 `$HOME/.dsh-github`，用 `-KeyDir` 可以改。

## push.ps1 参数

| 参数 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `-Path` | 仓库目录，默认当前目录 |
| `-Init` | 不是 git 仓库时自动 `git init` |
| `-Commit` | 先 `git add -A` + commit |
| `-Remote` | 设置/更新 origin |
| `-DryRun` | 只演练，不真推 |
| `-KeyDir` | key 所在目录 |
| `-Branch` | 默认 `main` |

## 工作原理

git 在 Windows 上执行 `GIT_SSH_COMMAND` 时会套一层 `sh -c`。在受限环境里 `sh.exe` 可能直接起不来：

```
sh.exe: *** fatal error - couldn't create signal pipe, Win32 error 5
```

`push.ps1` 的做法是生成一个 `.cmd` 包装脚本并赋给 `GIT_SSH`——git 会直接 `CreateProcess`，不经过 shell：

```batch
@echo off
ssh.exe -i "<key>" -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="<known_hosts>" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new %*
```

## 常见问题

**Q：`ssh -T` 报错但明明连上了？**
`ssh -T` 认证成功时退出码也是 1（GitHub 不提供 shell）。看输出里有没有 `Hi <user>!`。

**Q：`ls-remote` 没有任何输出？**
空仓库正常如此，退出码 0。用 `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` 对比 `git rev-parse HEAD` 判断。

**Q：私钥复制到别处就用不了？**
Windows 上复制文件不保留 ACL，副本会继承目标目录权限，ssh 判定"太宽"而拒收。要么原地生成，要么复制后 `icacls` 收紧。

**Q：token 能代替 SSH 吗？**
能，但 token 会进 shell 历史或配置文件；SSH key 不需要在对话里传递任何秘密。

## 安全约定

- 私钥只放本地默认目录，`.gitignore` 已排除 `id_ed25519`、`known_hosts`、`*.pem`
- 提交作者默认 `用户名@users.noreply.github.com`（建议在 GitHub 设置里开启 "Keep my email addresses private"）
- 扫描器对自身源码里的规则字符串做了跳过，避免误报

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# no-need-workspace

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness bundle that adds a **No workspace** action to the blank-session
workspace picker. It defers the folder until the first message and keeps all such
sessions grouped under one **No Need Workspace** parent.

## Preview

![The No workspace option at the bottom of the workspace picker](docs/screenshot.png)

The blank-session workspace picker with **No workspace** selected.

## Behavior

- Clicking **No workspace** only ensures and selects the shared bucket workspace
  at `$DSH_HOME/workspaces`; it does not create a per-session folder.
- The first message in that session creates
  `$DSH_HOME/workspaces/YYYY-MM-DD_HH-mm-ss` (a numeric suffix is added when the
  same second already has a folder) and switches the session's working directory
  to it.
- The session header keeps pointing at the bucket, so the left sidebar shows
  every such session under the **No Need Workspace** group. Timestamped folders
  are not registered as separate workspaces and therefore do not form a folder
  tree.
- The existing **Add workspace…** action still uses the composed directory
  picker; the sidebar `+` action is unchanged.

`$DSH_HOME` is the configured Harness home (`$DSH_HOME`), falling back to
`~/.dsh`. No folders are deleted automatically.

## Install

DSH ships its plugin manager as a bundle. Install `no-need-workspace` from the
Web **Plugins** page by package name, or through the `plugin_manager` agent tool:

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "no-need-workspace@0.2.1" }
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so installation selects the bundle and
inserts its single Host/Client row.

## DSH market index

The repository root contains [`market.json`](market.json), a format-1 DSH plugin
market index. Host it at a public HTTPS URL (for example the raw GitHub URL of
this file) and add that URL in DSH **Settings → Plugin Market**. The index lists
the npm source of `0.2.1`; later releases are appended by the `Release` workflow
described below, with the version's publish time as `publishTimestamp`.

## Releasing

1. Bump `version` in [`package.json`](package.json) and commit it on `main`.
2. Tag the commit and push the tag:

   ```bash
   git tag v0.2.1
   git push origin v0.2.1
   ```

The `Release` workflow checks that the tag matches `package.json` and points at a
commit on `main`, publishes the package to npm, then runs
[`scripts/update-market.mjs`](scripts/update-market.mjs) and commits the new
`market.json` entry. Publishing uses npm **trusted publishing**: the package
trusts this repository and `release.yml` once (npm → package → Trusted
publishing, or `npm trust github`), and the job authenticates through GitHub OIDC
with the `id-token: write` permission. No npm token secret is stored. Publishing
the same version twice is refused by npm, so a rerun after a partial failure
starts from a clean state.

## Compatibility

- Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` (`engines.dsh`).
- The browser half deliberately shadows the shipped
  `conversation.hero.workspace` slot (a `single` slot, registered at priority
  `-100`). It depends on that slot's owner props and on the client
  `workspaces.rename` / `uiWorkspace.pickDirectory` services from the pinned DSH
  line. Re-verify the picker after a DSH upgrade.
- Do not install this package together with another plugin that registers the
  same `/no-need-workspace/ensure-bucket` route, and do not run two
  auto-workspace plugins at once: each would assign its own timestamped folder on
  the first message.

## Security

The Host half registers one loopback-only, same-origin `POST` route guarded by
the `x-no-need-workspace: 1` header. It only creates empty directories under
`$DSH_HOME/workspaces`. It adds no model prompt, tool, or telemetry.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
