plugins.readme_text:
# dshx-ai-approval

> Adds an "AI approval" permission preset to DeepSeek Harness: one-time sandbox escalations are first reviewed by an LLM; only the ones it rejects reach you.

给 DSH 增加一个 **「由 AI 审批」** 权限预设：工作区内照常操作，越权操作（一次性沙箱提权）先交给一个 AI 审核模型判断。

- AI 回答 **ALLOW** → 直接放行；
- AI 回答 **DENY**、超时或出错 → 照常弹给你人工审批，不会因为 AI 出问题而自动放行。

沙箱、权限策略和审批记录仍由 DSH 自己负责，插件只在 DSH 现有的审批通道前面加一层自动审核。

## 用法

1. 安装后重启，新会话默认使用「由 AI 审批」预设（在设置里另选默认权限时以你的选择为准）；
2. 在 **设置 → AI 审批** 里选择审核用的 provider / model，可再配置一个备用审核模型（主模型报错、冷却或答非所问时使用），并可一键测试连通性；
3. 每次审核记录在 `~/.dsh/dshx-ai-approval.log`（设 `DSHX_AI_APPROVAL_NO_LOG=1` 关闭）。

## 配置（`cordis.patch.yml`）

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` / `model` | 空（用默认模型） | 审核模型 |
| `fallbackProvider` / `fallbackModel` | 空 | 备用审核模型 |
| `systemPrompt` | 空（用内置规则） | 自定义审核规则 |

> 注意：本插件的 patch 会重写 `permission` 行的预设列表（保留内置三档并新增 `ai-approval`）。如果你自己也改过权限预设，请安装后检查。

## 安装

```sh
# Web profile
dsh plugin --profile web add github:callaumyan-design/dshx-ai-approval
# Desktop（用 DSH Desktop 自带的 dsh 命令，先从托盘完全退出 Desktop）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:callaumyan-design/dshx-ai-approval
```

安装后重启 DSH。卸载：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dshx-ai-approval`。

## 兼容性

在 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2（desktop / web profile）上开发和使用。纯 JavaScript，无构建步骤，无安装脚本。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH plugin: fill custom-provider model metadata from models.dev through an explicit, pre-declared mapping — no guessing, fail-closed. Includes a graphical settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-autofill-model-metadata

Fill a DSH gateway route's model metadata (`name`, `contextWindow`, `maxTokens`,
`input`, `reasoningEfforts`) from the [models.dev](https://models.dev) catalog —
**using only the mappings you declare by hand**.

This is a port of the `pi-autofill-model-metadata` Pi extension: the same
explicit-mapping philosophy, moved onto the DSH settings seam.

## Why explicit mapping

DSH has no native metadata filling. The plugins that do it fall into two camps:
provider-level refresh (`dsh-models-dev`: `sources: { route: <models.dev-provider> }`)
and loose name matching. Both guess. This plugin refuses to:

- You write down, per route and per local model id, exactly which models.dev
  model it is: `mapping.<route>.<localModelId> = "<modelsDevProvider>/<modelsDevModel>"`.
- No fuzzy match, no case folding across providers, no searching another
  provider when a lookup fails.
- Anything unmapped, unknown, or ambiguous is a **refusal**, not a guess. A route
  whose plan refuses is not written at all — you never get a half-filled array.

Declared fields always win: the plugin only fills fields the profile leaves
`undefined`.

## Install

Requires DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`. From the plugin checkout:

```sh
DSH="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh"
"$DSH" plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-autofill-model-metadata
```

Then restart DSH Desktop (plugins mount at startup).

## Configure

The config accepts these fields (the graphical page edits the mapping, the
rest stays in the settings document):

```jsonc
{
  "mapping": {
    // route name as it appears in Settings → Models
    "my-gateway": {
      // local model id on the wire  ->  models.dev provider/model
      "claude-opus-4-5": "anthropic/claude-opus-4-5",
      "gemini-3-pro": "google/gemini-3-pro-preview"
    }
  },
  "modelsDevUrl": "https://models.dev/api.json",
  "cacheTTLHours": 24,
  "applyOnStart": true,
  "dryRun": false,
  "requireCompleteMapping": true,
  "builtinSettingsForm": "auto"
}
```

| field | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mapping` | `{}` | the declared table; empty means the plugin does nothing at all |
| `modelsDevUrl` | `https://models.dev/api.json` | catalog endpoint |
| `cachePath` | `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-autofill-model-metadata/models.dev.json` | catalog cache |
| `cacheTTLHours` | `24` | cache lifetime; `0` refetches every time |
| `applyOnStart` | `true` | apply once when the plugin mounts |
| `dryRun` | `false` | plan and log, write nothing |
| `requireCompleteMapping` | `true` | undeclared models on a mapped route are an error |
| `builtinSettingsForm` | `"auto"` | `auto` / `always` / `never` — see [Settings](#settings) |

Manual run, from any local browser session (`<port>` is the DSH web server):

```sh
BASE=http://127.0.0.1:<port>/api/dsh-autofill-model-metadata
curl -X POST $BASE/apply   -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}'   # {"route":"..."} to narrow
curl $BASE/status                                                        # mapping state, no catalog fetch
curl $BASE/inspect                                                       # same, resolved against the catalog
curl "$BASE/catalog?q=gpt-5.4&limit=10"                                  # candidate mapping targets
curl -X POST $BASE/mapping -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"mapping":{"my-route":{"fast-model":"openai/gpt-5.4"}},"apply":true}'
```

Every endpoint is loopback-only and answers `403` to anything else; `/apply`,
`/mapping` and `/page-live` are `POST`, the rest are `GET`.

`/mapping` answers `200` once the write lands, even when a requested fill is then
refused: the mapping really was saved, and a failed pass is reported separately in
`applyError` rather than disguised as a failed save. `/status` and `/inspect`
answer with the mapping read from the settings document, not from the volatile
copy the loader refreshes a moment after a write.

## Settings

The plugin ships a graphical settings page, and it also honours the host's
`autoGenerate` flag for the schema above — so a host that renders generated
forms, now or in a later version, keeps showing one whenever this page is not
there.

| `builtinSettingsForm` | behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `"auto"` (default) | the generated form stays available until the browser half loads and reports in (`POST /page-live`) |
| `"always"` | the generated form is never suppressed |
| `"never"` | the generated form is suppressed as soon as the plugin mounts |

`true`/`false` are accepted as aliases for `always`/`never`.

**What "the original form" means in 0.2.0-rc.2.** It is worth being exact here:
the shipped client contains no generic schema-driven form renderer at all. Every
official settings page (`Models`, `Shell`, `Agent loop`, …) is a hand-written
companion package, and `autoGenerate` is carried by the settings transport but
consumed by nothing yet. So on this version the surfaces for a plugin config are:

1. this page, when its bundle loads;
2. the profile's own configuration document, always — hand-editable, and the
   thing the page writes back to;
3. a generated form, on any host that starts rendering one.

The `auto` policy is what keeps (3) honest: it does not suppress the flag until
the page has actually reported in, so a page that never loads never costs you a
surface. The page's own failure banner says the same thing when its host
endpoints are unreachable.

The page appears as **Settings → Model metadata**. It lists only *relevant*
routes — a route the profile configures, or one that appears in the mapping — so
the dozens of providers the host advertises but nobody configured cannot bury
the ones that matter. A mapped route the host does not offer is still listed,
with its reason, so a typo cannot hide. Each card shows: every declared model, the fields it declares by hand (never overwritten),
what a pass would fill, the mapping source in an editable field with catalog
search, and the refusals that would apply. **Save mapping** writes the whole
table in one revision-fenced op; **Save and fill** does that and runs a pass.
Nothing is written until you save, unsaved edits survive a reload, and a dry run
or an already-complete route is reported as exactly that rather than as a fill.

Both the page and the config document end up in the same settings service. The
page reads the settings revision along with its state and sends it back when
saving, so an edit made in the config document while the page sat open makes the
save **fail closed** — the page is told the mapping moved and to reapply — rather
than replacing the whole table with what the page happened to be showing. A fill
pass re-reads and re-plans the route inside the same fence, so a model added by
hand between planning and writing is never dropped: the pass refuses instead.
Without a revision from the caller there is nothing to compare against, so the
freshest one is used and the write proceeds.

## What gets filled

| local field | from models.dev | rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `model.name` | |
| `contextWindow` | `limit.context` | written only when `> 0` |
| `maxTokens` | `limit.output` | written only when `> 0` |
| `input` | `modalities.input` | `image` present → `['text','image']` |
| `reasoningEfforts` | `reasoning_options` (`effort` values) | see below |

`reasoningEfforts` follows the pi-ai schema, where a map containing only `off`
is invalid:

- effort values present → map them, including `none` → `off`;
- only `off` usable, or `reasoning: false` → `false`;
- catalog says nothing → field left absent, so the profile's own default stands.

A model is eligible only when `tool_call === true` and `status !== 'deprecated'`.
Eligibility is checked but never written — the plugin does not flip `tool_call`.

## Refusals

Per route, all-or-nothing. A refused route writes nothing.

| kind | when |
| --- | --- |
| `malformed-source` | the mapping value is not `provider/model` |
| `unknown-provider` | that provider id is not in the catalog |
| `unknown-model` | that model id is not under that provider |
| `ambiguous-source` | several catalog models match case-insensitively |
| `not-agent-

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). No API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencode-free **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@dsh-opencode-free%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dsh-opencode-free/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@dsh-opencode-free%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- dsh-opencode-free registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `dsh-opencode-free`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. > **Upgrading from `opencode2dsh`?** This project was renamed. The plugin now > installs as `@dsh-opencode-free/dsh-plugin` with the provider, settings entry > and data directory all under the new name. Your saved IP-pool settings and the > old `~/.opencode2dsh` cache are copied once on first start — see > [Renamed from opencode2dsh](#renamed-from-opencode2dsh). ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install Installs from a prebuilt release, so no build step and no toolchain is needed. **Read the three steps in order** — doing the install before step 2 fails silently, in a way that looks like success (see below). **1. Make sure the profile exists.** Any `dsh plugin` command initializes it: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web list ``` **2. Approve two build scripts *before* the first install.** They are `@google/genai` and `protobufjs`, pulled in transitively by `@earendil-works/pi-ai`; pnpm blocks dependency build scripts by default. Append this to the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml`, under `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\` on Windows): ```yaml allowBuilds: '@google/genai': false protobufjs: false ``` `false` keeps the scripts disabled — it records the decision pnpm is waiting for, which is all that is needed. (Upstream ships the same two as `false`.) **3. Install:** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free/releases/latest/download/dsh-opencode-free-dsh-plugin.tgz ``` The version-free link is a stable bookmark for the *first* install. It is deliberately **not** the update command: pnpm records the URL it resolved in `pnpm-lock.yaml` together with the tarball's integrity hash, and a URL that never changes is treated as already resolved ("Lockfile is up to date, resolution step is skipped") — re-adding it keeps the version you have. Use the tag-scoped asset for updates (see [Updating](#updating)). ### Why step 2 comes first Skip it and the first install stops at `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` — but pnpm has already written the dependency into the profile's `package.json`. DSH registers a newly installed package as a profile *bundle* only when that pnpm run exits 0 **and** the package is a new dependency. So the retry is no longer "new", the registration is skipped, and the run exits **0** with the plugin present on disk in `node_modules` but never added to `dsh.profile.bundles` — meaning it never loads and no models appear. Nothing in the output says so. If you have already hit that, recover with a remove and re-add: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove @dsh-opencode-free/dsh-plugin dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free/releases/latest/download/dsh-opencode-free-dsh-plugin.tgz ``` To confirm the plugin is really registered, check that the profile's `package.json` lists `@dsh-opencode-free/dsh-plugin` under `dsh.profile.bundles` — not just under `dependencies`. ### Other ways to install **In the Web UI**: **Settings → Plugins → Install**, and paste the same tarball URL. The Web page writes the same kind of approval and has its own bundle selection; the CLI steps above are the path verified here. **From GitHub directly** (no registry involved): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free ``` This works because the repository root *is* the installable plugin: it carries the `dsh` manifest, and the built output is committed under `packages/plugin/lib/`. A git install cannot run a build — pnpm blocks prepare scripts for git dependencies — so shipping the build is what makes this path work. Pinning a tag is recommended for stability: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free#v0.4.0 ``` **From npm** (once the package is published): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-opencode-free/dsh-plugin ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **dsh-opencode-free** group. ### Updating Pick the source you installed from; each updates in place. **Release tarball.** Use the tag-scoped asset, not the version-free one: ```sh # replace 0.4.2 with the release you are moving to dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free/releases/download/v0.4.2/dsh-opencode-free-dsh-plugin-0.4.2.tgz ``` The version-free `releases/latest/download/...` URL does **not** update an existing install: pnpm resolved it once and pinned the URL plus its integrity hash in `pnpm-lock.yaml`, so re-adding it is a no-op ("Lockfile is up to date, resolution step is skipped") — even with `--force`, `pnpm update`, `pnpm install --force`, or a deleted `node_modules`. Only a URL that differs per release re-resolves. If you are stuck on an older build that predates the versioned asset, do the one-time move with an explicit remove + add (or the versioned URL, which works even then): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove @dsh-opencode-free/dsh-plugin dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free/releases/latest/download/dsh-opencode-free-dsh-plugin.tgz ``` **git install**: follow master (a git spec re-resolves each time): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free ``` **npm install**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-opencode-free/dsh-plugin@latest ``` Then restart DSH. To confirm the new version landed, compare the profile's `node_modules//package.json` with the release you expected, and check the health snapshot at `~/.dsh-opencod

plugins.description: DSH /btw side questions — ask about the current session without adding the exchange to conversation history
plugins.readme_text:
# `/btw` side questions for DSH

[中文](#中文) | [English](#english)

## 中文

Claude Code 的 `/btw` 让你在会话运行期间随时提一个快速问题，且这段问答不会进入会话历史。这个 bundle 把同样的行为带到了 DSH。

### 它做什么

在输入框输入 `/btw <问题>`：

1. 读取接收会话的派生历史（`session.deriveMessages()`），即模型自己看到的那些消息；
2. 用会话当前的 provider/model 路由额外问一个问题，以上述转录为上下文，**不带任何工具**；
3. 答案作为命令结果返回，渲染在聊天记录中。

问题和答案只记录为仅日志的 `command/run` 和 `command/done` 事件，不会追加到模型可见的界面上，因此下一次模型请求不包含它们。

### 用法

```text
/btw 现在这个项目的抓取流程是什么？
/btw What did we change in the parser so far?
```

智能体运行中也可以提问。空输入会打印用法说明。

### 限制

- 旁路调用使用会话最近一次 `request/header` 的路由；尚未发过模型请求的会话回落到 `agentDefaultModel`。
- 转录上限 24,000 字符（优先保留最新消息），每条工具结果截断到 400 字符，答案上限 1,200 tokens。
- 图片被替换为 `[图片]`；工具结果以文本形式呈现。
- 旁路调用不触发 `agent/request`，因此不计入 token 统计，也不出现在请求头里。

### 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host 插件：注册 `/btw`，构建转录，流式返回旁路答案 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch，插入 `btw` 行 |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | 插件管理器中的标题与描述 |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标 |
| `test/btw.test.mjs` | Fake-context 单元测试（无需 DSH） |

### 开发

```bash
node test/btw.test.mjs
```

用 `plugin_manager install_bundle` 指向本目录安装；bundle 是纯 ESM 包，无构建步骤，不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`（这些包在 `app.asar` 内，profile 插件无法解析）。

## English

Claude Code's `/btw` lets you ask a quick question about the ongoing session
while it works, and the exchange never enters the conversation history. This
bundle brings the same behavior to DSH.

### What it does

Typing `/btw <question>` in the composer:

1. reads the receiving session's derived history (`session.deriveMessages()`),
   i.e. exactly the messages the model itself saw;
2. asks the session's current provider/model route one extra question with a
   transcript as context and **no tools**;
3. returns the answer as the command result, rendered in the chat transcript.

The question and answer are recorded only as log-only `command/run` and
`command/done` events. They are not appended to the model-visible surface, so
the next model request does not contain them.

### Usage

```text
/btw 现在这个项目的抓取流程是什么？
/btw What did we change in the parser so far?
```

A question may be asked while the agent is running. Empty input prints usage.

### Limits

- The side call uses the route of the session's latest `request/header`; a
  session with no model request yet falls back to `agentDefaultModel`.
- The transcript is capped at 24,000 characters (newest messages win), each
  tool result is capped at 400 characters, and the answer at 1,200 tokens.
- Images are replaced by `[图片]`; tool results are represented as text.
- The side call does not fire `agent/request`, so it does not appear in token
  accounting or request headers.

### Files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host plugin: registers `/btw`, builds the transcript, streams the side answer |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch inserting the `btw` row |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | Plugin Manager title and description |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin icon |
| `test/btw.test.mjs` | Fake-context unit tests (no DSH needed) |

### Development

```bash
node test/btw.test.mjs
```

Install with `plugin_manager install_bundle` pointing at this directory; the
bundle is a plain ESM package with no build step and no imports from
`@deepseek-ai/*` (those packages live inside `app.asar` and do not resolve for
profile plugins).

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-recycle-bin（回收站）

把工作区里的会话移入回收站，保留 14 天后自动永久删除；也可以随时恢复或立即删除。

## 安装（给其他人）

仓库地址：<https://github.com/EnhydraLutristus/dsh-recycle-bin>

要求：DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x（本插件在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上开发和验证；用到的是 `sidebar.panellist`、`main`、`sidebar.session.row.hover`、`shell.overlay` 四个槽位和 `webServer` 路由，老版本可能没有这些槽位）。

**方式一：直接按 GitHub 地址安装**（Harness 支持 pnpm 的 `github:` 规格）

在 Harness 里调用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，target 填：

```
github:EnhydraLutristus/dsh-recycle-bin
```

安装完成后条目为 `include:dsh-recycle-bin`，侧边栏底部会出现回收站图标。若没出现，按 `Ctrl+R` 刷新页面；仍未出现就把它禁用再启用一次。

**方式二：先克隆，再从本地目录安装**（想改代码或锁定版本时用）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/EnhydraLutristus/dsh-recycle-bin.git
```

然后 `install_bundle` 的 target 填克隆目录的**绝对路径**（例如 `D:\plugins\dsh-recycle-bin`）。本地安装是链接（`link:`），改完代码禁用/启用一次即可生效。

**更新**

```bash
git pull            # 本地目录安装时
```

或重新执行一次 `install_bundle`（GitHub 规格）；更新后在插件管理器里禁用再启用。

## 界面在哪里

侧边栏底部、Settings 之上的图标区（`sidebar.panellist`）多了一个回收站图标，排在其它面板图标之后。点击它，主区域会切换到回收站面板。

## 怎么把会话放进回收站

有三种方式：

1. **拖拽**：把侧边栏工作区里的会话行拖到回收站图标上——现在整个侧边栏条目（图标 + 文字区域）都是投放目标，不要求精准对准图标。
2. **大投放区**：一开始拖动会话，屏幕底部中央会浮出一个 236×52 的「松手移入回收站」提示块（`shell.overlay` 图层，盖在所有列之上），把会话拖进去松手即可；松手后提示块自动消失。放在底部中央而不是左下角，是为了不挡住侧边栏最后几行会话——否则想把会话拖到列表末尾时会误落进回收站。
3. **拖进面板**：回收站面板打开时，把会话拖进面板空白处。
4. **悬停按钮**：鼠标悬停在某个会话行上，浮层里点「移入回收站」。

放入时底层会调用官方的 `workspaceRegistry.archiveSession`，所以会话会先从工作区列表里消失（和官方「归档」一致），再进入回收站。**当前正在跑回合的会话会被拒绝**（提示「该会话正在运行，请先停止它再移入回收站」），不会打断正在进行的任务；**已经打开、但没在跑回合的会话**才会自动停掉界面占用后归档。

失败不会再只闪一下红灯：底部投放块会把原因显示 6 秒，同时写一行到 `<DSH_HOME>/recycle-bin/host.log`；跨站校验失败会记成 `guard-reject`，带完整请求头，便于排查。

## 回收站里能做什么

- **恢复**：把会话取消归档，重新回到原来的工作区。
- **立即删除**：需要点两次（第二次是「确认永久删除」，5 秒内有效）。
- **清空回收站**：同样需要二次确认。
- **自动删除**：每小时扫描一次，超过 14 天的条目会被永久删除；应用启动 5 秒后也会扫一次，补上关机期间到期的条目。

## 删除到底删了什么

DSH 目前没有「删除会话」的 Host API（`sessionPersistence` 只有 create/open/flush/stat/list，`sessionController` 与 `workspaceRegistry` 都没有删除会话的方法），所以这里的「永久删除」是文件级删除：

1. 如果该会话还在跑回合，直接拒绝并提示「该会话正在运行，请先停止它再删除」，不会取消、也不会打断任务；
2. 用 `sessionPersistence.open(id, 'write')` 抢占写句柄（重试 3 次、每次间隔 200ms）。**抢不到不再报错**：应用打开过的会话（启动时默认打开的那个、刚新建的对话、界面里还开着的归档行）会一直占着写句柄，直到页面关闭或应用重启——以前这就是「不重启就删不掉」的原因。现在抢不到就降级为直接删文件，并在 `recycle-bin/host.log` 里记一行 `force-delete`；
3. 删除 `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<工作区桶>/<sessionId>/`（会话日志，可能是 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd`），删完再检查目录确实消失，否则整次删除判为失败、条目留在回收站；
4. 删除 `<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<sessionId>.json`（预览缓存）；
5. 把该会话从所有工作区的 `sessionIds` 里 detach；抢占成功时再从归档集合里移除，抢占失败（会话仍活在内存里）时**保留归档标记**，这样重启前它也不会以「未分组」的空壳重新冒出来；
6. 发出 `api-session/removed` 事件，界面立刻把这一行从工作区列表（含「未分组」）里移掉，不会留下空壳。

## 状态文件

`<DSH_HOME>/recycle-bin/state.json`，记录每个被移入会话的 id、标题、所属工作区、移入时间。删除该文件等于清空回收站记录（不会恢复已删除的会话）。

## 已知限制

- **没有官方删除接口**：删除是文件级操作，属于绕过 API 的做法，未来 Host 若给会话加锁/改存储格式，需要同步调整 `lib/index.js` 的 `purgeFiles`。
- **搜索索引**：`session-query-sqlite` 的索引不在删除范围内，历史搜索命中可能仍指向已删除会话，点开时可能提示会话不存在。
- **正在运行的会话不能移动、也不能删除**：会提示先停止，不会打断任务。等回合结束后再操作。
- **打开的会话可以直接删除**：启动时默认打开的那个会话、刚新建还没重启过的对话，都能立即删除——写句柄被占用不再阻止删除，改删文件。代价是内存里仍留着它的对象，直到应用重启；因为保留了归档标记，它不会重新出现在列表里。
- **不可撤销**：删除就是真的删除，没有第三方工具无法恢复。
- **回收站里的会话仍归档在工作区**：这是有意的（不出现在会话列表），恢复时自动取消归档。
- **拖拽是否生效取决于会话行实际写入 `dataTransfer` 的负载**：插件会依次尝试 UUID、纯 id、JSON 里的 `sessionId`；优先采信 UUID 和非 `text/plain` 的私有类型，避免把会话标题误当 id。识别不到时不会报错，也不会误删。识别不到就退回用悬停按钮。
- **底部投放块只在拖动会话时出现**：拖动文本或系统文件（`Files` 类型）不会弹出，也不会被拦截。

## 排查：重启后侧边栏图标消失

`package.json` 的 `exports` 必须包含 `"./package.json": "./package.json"`。客户端模块扫描会在冷启动时通过包的导出表解析清单文件；缺这一条时，Host 半照常加载（路由可用、删除照常工作），但客户端半会被**静默跳过**，表现就是“重启后图标不见了、界面里没有任何入口”。这类“热装能用、重启就没”的现象，先查导出表。

同一条冷启动链路上还有第二个陷阱：`dsh.client.immediately`。声明了它，这个客户端半就被编进「首屏批次」，而首屏批次是在应用自己的静态清单里算好的——用户后装的插件挤不进去，于是静默丢失，只有开关一次插件（走重新扫描）才会出现。对照两个能稳定冷启动的第三方插件（`dshmarket`、`dsh-context`）都没有声明它，所以本插件也移除了这项声明，改为普通按需批次加载。

## 安装与验证

已通过 `plugin_manager` 安装为 profile bundle，Loader 条目为 `include:dsh-recycle-bin`。

- 重新启用：`plugin_manager` `set_plugin`，target `include:dsh-recycle-bin`。
- Host 逻辑自测：`node test/harness.mjs`（在临时 `DSH_HOME` 里跑真实的 route handler，覆盖 list/trash/restore/delete/sweep/鉴权与错误路径）。
- 客户端结构自测：`node test/client-smoke.mjs`（用假 `window.__ModuleLoader__` / React 执行 `lib/client.js`，断言模块契约与 4 个槽位注册）。
- 线上自检：`GET http://127.0.0.1:<当前 GUI 端口>/dsh-recycle-bin/list`，带请求头 `x-dsh-recycle-bin: 1`，应返回 `{"ok":true,"retentionDays":14,"items":[...]}`；不带该头会返回 403（路由挂在鉴权之前，这个头用来挡跨站伪造请求）。GUI 端口每次启动可能不同，以运行时上下文里的 URL 为准。

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: Provider-aware DeepSeek peak/off-peak badge for DSH. 在输入框工具栏显示 DeepSeek 峰谷时段，只在选中的模型属于 DeepSeek provider 时出现。
plugins.readme_text:
# DeepSeek 峰谷提示（dsh-provider-peak）

[![test](https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak/actions/workflows/test.yml)

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 插件。在会话输入框工具栏常驻一枚小徽章，显示 DeepSeek API 当前按**高峰**还是**空闲**价计费；徽章跟随当前选中的模型，只有模型属于 DeepSeek 的 provider 时才出现。

- `● 空闲`（绿点）：空闲时段，价格为高峰价的 5 折
- `● 高峰`（黄点）：高峰时段，按标准价计费
- 悬停或键盘聚焦：徽章出现底色反馈，并弹出详情浮层（当前模型、距下次切换多久、切换时刻、计费规则、节假日数据覆盖年份）
- 选中 Xiaomi 等其他 provider：徽章自动隐藏
- 模型信息尚未解析或加载失败：灰色 `未知`
- 中英双语，跟随界面语言；零依赖、免构建，装上即用

## 安装

### 插件页（推荐）

1. 打开 DSH Web。
2. 进入 **设置 → 插件**，在安装框粘贴仓库地址：

   ```text
   https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak
   ```

3. 安装后刷新页面。

### 命令行

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak
```

`desktop` 配置档由 Electron 独占，只能走界面。安装后刷新页面。

### 本地开发

```sh
git clone https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-provider-peak
```

目录安装是 `link:`，改完 `client.js` 刷新页面即可，不必重装。

## 峰谷规则

| 时段 | 北京时间 | 价格 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 高峰 | 周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日） | 标准价 |
| 空闲 | 其余全部时间，含周末与法定节假日全天 | 高峰价的 50% |

规则与价格以 [DeepSeek 官方价格页](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing) 为准（核对于 2026-10-18）。

## 哪些 provider 会显示

| 选中的 provider | 徽章 |
| --- | --- |
| `deepseek-official` / `deepseek-account`（内置 DeepSeek） | `高峰` / `空闲` |
| 名称为 `DeepSeek` 的 provider（如 pi-ai 里配置、指向 api.deepseek.com 的 `deepseek` 路由） | `高峰` / `空闲` |
| 其他 provider（`xiaomi-token-plan-cn`、名称不是 DeepSeek 的第三方中转等） | 隐藏 |
| 模型信息尚未解析 / 加载失败 | `未知` |

判定逻辑在 `client.js` 的 `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_IDS` 与 `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_NAME`。

## 法定节假日

内置 2026 年国务院办公厅公布的 7 段假期（元旦、春节、清明、劳动节、端午、中秋、国庆），落在工作日的假期会让当天全天空闲。2027 年安排通常在 2026 年 11 月公布，届时更新 `client.js`：

```js
const HOLIDAY_RANGES = [/* ... */];
const HOLIDAY_COVERAGE = '2026';
```

节假日数据未覆盖的年份仍按“周一至周五 + 两个高峰窗口”判断，不会报错，只是不识别新年份的假期。

## 自定义

| 想改什么 | 位置 |
| --- | --- |
| provider 白名单 | `client.js` 的 `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_IDS` / `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_NAME` |
| 高峰窗口 | `client.js` 的 `PEAK_WINDOWS` |
| 节假日 | `client.js` 的 `HOLIDAY_RANGES` / `HOLIDAY_COVERAGE` |
| 文案 | `client.js` 的 `DICT`（zh / en）；插件卡标题在 `locale/*.json` |

修改后刷新页面（目录安装）或重新安装（GitHub 安装）。

## 结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `client.js` | 全部浏览器端逻辑：槽位注册、locale 文案、选中模型读取、峰谷计算与徽章渲染 |
| `index.js` | Host 端空插件（渲染全部在 Client） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 安装时插入的插件行 |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | 插件管理页的标题与描述 |
| `test/policy.test.mjs` | 峰谷与 provider 判定的单元测试 |
| `docs/verification.md` | 验证记录与限制 |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标 |

## 开发与测试

```sh
node --check client.js
npm test
```

测试使用 `node:test`，从 `client.js` 的 `// --- policy logic` 标记块中取出纯函数执行，不依赖浏览器。

## 兼容性

- 在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 上开发与验证。
- 使用 Harness 自带能力：`conversation.input.left` 槽位、`ctx.modelDirectories` 服务、`ctx.locale`、`--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token。
- 只引用主题 token，深浅色主题都跟随宿主；没有引用任何 Harness Client 包。
- DSH 若调整槽位名、模型目录服务或 locale API，需要跟着更新。

## 验证状态

见 [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)：逻辑单测、目录安装与 GitHub 安装、实时槽位注册均已覆盖；视觉外观在无浏览器控制的环境下未截图验证。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: 小蓝桌宠：DeepSeek Harness 侧栏任务伙伴插件，支持连贯点击动画、任务提醒与独立外观设置
plugins.readme_text:
# 小蓝桌宠 · DeepSeek Harness 侧栏插件 v0.2.1

沿用已认可的蓝发女仆与几何纸片风格。小蓝位于侧栏工作区列表下方的空白处，跟随真实会话状态：待机、思考、执行工具、等待确认、本轮结束和异常。

本地插件，无 npm 运行依赖、无需构建。适配本机 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`。聊天框和输入框使用原生布局；人物和设置仅由本插件管理。

## 使用

- 点击人物，轮流播放打招呼、开心点头与好奇回应三段完整动画；动作结束后恢复真实任务状态。
- 连点最多排一个后续动作，当前动作会自然演完。连续密集点击不会积压长队列。
- 拖动人物，在侧栏空白处移动。聚焦人物后，方向键可微调位置，Enter / Space 可触发互动。
- 点击状态或短句，返回对应任务会话；后台会话需要确认时优先提示。
- 点击侧栏底部的 **DeepSeek 图标**，打开设置。图标直接使用 DSH 自带的 `FishLogo`，与侧栏品牌标记一致。也可从 **设置 → 小蓝桌宠** 进入。
- 设置中可调整人物大小、不透明度、动效、安静模式、短句与任务提醒标记。
- 收起人物后保留 DeepSeek 入口。侧栏列表占满、窗口变矮或侧栏折叠时，人物自动避让；空间恢复后重新显示。
- 设置中的六个动作可随时预览；8 秒后自动恢复真实状态。预览不产生任务提醒。

默认大小为 148 px（图片宽度），不透明度为 100%；可调范围为 100–220 px、25–100%。实际大小自动适应空白高度。拖动位置保存在当前设备，并随窗口尺寸重新计算。

**安静模式**停止动画与闲聊短句，保留必要的状态及提醒标记。系统“减少动态效果”只暂停自动呼吸、眨眼等待机循环和装饰纸片；主动点击仍会播放有限时长的人物动作。窗口不可见时暂停所有动画。

v0.2.1 修复了 Windows 关闭界面动画时“短句变化、人物不动”的问题。v0.2.0 将系统减少动态效果同时作为点击动画的禁止条件，即使插件的“启用动效”已打开也不会播放。现在自动动效与主动点击分别处理，无需更改 Windows 设置。

## 点击互动

| 动作 | 连贯过程 | 时长 |
|---|---|---|
| 打招呼 | 回应 → 眨眼 → 抬手 → 来回挥手 → 放下手 → 微笑 → 恢复 | 3.20 秒 |
| 开心点头 | 回应 → 闭眼微笑 → 轻轻点头 → 睁眼 → 恢复 | 2.34 秒 |
| 好奇回应 | 倾身听你 → 眨眼 → 举手回应 → 微笑 → 恢复 | 3.06 秒 |

六张同位置、同尺寸的透明关键姿势配合短过渡与轻微缓动，每段都有开始和收尾。人物外形、服装与几何纸片画风保持一致。等待确认、任务异常或断线时，互动及后续队列会让位于真实任务提示。拖动不会触发点击动画。

关闭“启用动效”后仍可显示简短回应；安静模式同时关闭闲聊。升级沿用原有设置存储键，大小、透明度、位置和开关可以继续使用。

以下为已安装插件的实际页面录制，仅截取人物和底部入口：

![三种点击互动](docs/interaction-preview.gif)

## 状态和提醒

任务状态来自 DSH 的 `sessions.list`、`uiSession.sessionStatus` 与当前会话事件源：

| 状态 | 表现 |
|---|---|
| 待机 | 轻微呼吸，间歇眨眼 |
| 思考 | 小幅歪头，几何纸片缓慢浮起 |
| 执行工具 | 轻微起伏，纸片环绕 |
| 等待确认 | 一次短动作，提示“这里需要你确认” |
| 本轮结束 | 点头、举手打招呼，纸片短暂散开 |
| 异常 | 微微歪头，提示本次任务有问题 |

本轮结束使用真实运行状态的结束信号，稳定 700 ms 后提醒；手动停止也可能触发“本轮结束”，因此不宣称任务成功。正在等待确认或遇到错误时不会显示结束庆祝。刷新和重新连接会重新建立基线，避免补发旧任务的结束提醒。

全局状态覆盖当前窗口已加载的会话；当前会话可进一步区分思考与工具执行。未打开的后台会话显示通用执行状态。

提醒仅显示在 DSH 窗口中，没有声音或额外 Windows 通知。设置面板保留本次打开期间最近 12 条提醒，点击可返回会话。不会自动确认授权、回答问题、发送消息或调用模型。

## 安装与卸载

本地安装，在 PowerShell 运行：

```powershell
& "E:\DSH-DeskTop\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "E:\OpencodeProject\Project\DSH-Plugin\dsh-sidebar-pet"
```

本机已安装为本地链接，并已将当前运行的桌宠服务热更新至 v0.2.1，无需重装或重启 DSH。若桌面窗口仍显示旧效果，按 **Ctrl+R** 刷新。ZIP 使用者先解压整个文件夹，再将末尾路径替换为解压目录。保留插件目录，以便宿主提供图片。其他环境升级已经缓存的服务端模块时，可以在无任务运行期间重新启动 DSH。

卸载：

```powershell
& "E:\DSH-DeskTop\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-sidebar-pet
```

## 素材与维护

`assets/idle.png` 为已认可的半身稿；原有 `blink.png` 与 `wave.png` 保留。本次使用内置 `image_gen` 生图工具，以原图为编辑目标，新增 `lift.png`（抬手中间姿势）、`wave-in.png`（挥手另一端）和 `smile.png`（闭眼微笑）。六张图片均为 1024 × 1536 的透明 RGBA PNG，随插件本地提供。

完整提示词见 `assets/idle-prompt.txt`、`assets/action-prompts.txt` 与本次的 [interaction-prompts.txt](assets/interaction-prompts.txt)。运行期间不调用生图或模型服务。DeepSeek 入口使用原生矢量组件。

![人物与 DeepSeek 入口](docs/sidebar-detail.png)

验证覆盖状态、动画队列、图片服务和已安装页面。v0.2.1 增加“系统关闭动画、真实任务状态、不切换待机预览”的回归检查，直接以鼠标坐标点击人物，确认三段动作都切换到可见姿势并自然收尾；同时检查待机循环和装饰纸片仍暂停。检查也覆盖连点衔接、原生 Logo 路径、键盘、安静模式、任务提示、断线、拖动、设置持久化、列表避让、聊天布局和卸载。验证记录保存在 `docs/`；没有发送测试消息。动画预览为 v0.2.0 已安装页面录制，人物素材和动作脚本在此次修复中保持一致。

插件使用 `shell.overlay` 获取生命周期，通过侧栏 CSS 模块语义后缀定位空白区域；设置页和 DeepSeek 按钮使用原生插槽。动画仅在阶段切换时更新，不持续执行逐帧 JavaScript 循环。卸载清理人物、样式、设置入口、监听器与计时器。

设置保存在设备 `localStorage`，不会写入会话文件；提醒仅驻留内存。插件不修改其他插件源码、DSH 安装文件或聊天布局。

开发检查（Node.js 22 或更新）：

```powershell
npm run check
npm test
npm run verify
npm run preview
node tools/browser-check.mjs --fixtures
node tools/browser-check.mjs --installed
```

`verify` 需要本机 DSH 已启动、插件已安装。浏览器检查使用临时 Chrome 上下文；仅该临时浏览器关闭本地网络检查，以便连接本机 DSH，不调整正常 Chrome 或 DSH 的设置。浏览器工具需要本机 Codex 随附的 Playwright，可通过 `DSH_PET_NODE_MODULES` 指定其他本地模块目录。

`--fixtures` 在独立浏览器页面里使用与 DSH 同形状的临时任务来源验证动作和提醒；不发送测试消息、不执行真实任务，不改服务器会话。普通和 `--installed` 检查使用真实服务读取和原生界面。

诊断入口：`window.__dshSidebarPet.inspect()`，其中 `motion` 显示系统动效偏好、窗口可见性、自动动画状态及点击受限原因。可用 `.update({quiet:true})`、`.reset()` 和 `.openSettings()`；诊断不会输出认证信息或会话正文。

plugins.description: DSH plugin that cuts the prompt payload re-sent every request: slims oversized MCP tool JSON Schemas, attributes tool-result volume, and shows the token cost in a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# Cache Saver

[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-5b6ee1)](#install)
[![build](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-none-success)](package.json)

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A host + client bundle for DeepSeek Harness. Every request re-sends the whole
prompt prefix — tool JSON Schemas included. This plugin shrinks the oversized
ones (dispatch untouched) and then **shows you where the re-sent context goes**,
in a settings page.

Measured on a real profile — a fresh session's first request:

| | tools | prompt tokens |
|---|---|---|
| plugin off | 269 | **270,767** |
| plugin on | 270 | **69,559** (−74.3 %) |

Same tools, same calls. Only the manual got smaller.

## Install

Close DeepSeek Harness first (it holds the `desktop` profile), then one command:

```bat
"<install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:ium9khbep8834-maker/dsh-cache-saver
```

Or with npm — one command, then add `"@local/dsh-cache-saver"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`
in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` (npm cannot know about DSH bundles):

```bash
npm install github:ium9khbep8834-maker/dsh-cache-saver
```

Restart (or reload the page) once — the client half is imported at boot — then
open **Settings → Cache saver**. Other profiles: same command with
`--profile web` / `--profile dsh-tui` (plain `dsh`, no `.cmd`).

## What it does

### 1. Schema slimming — the same tools, a smaller manual

On a fresh agent the plugin copies each tool definition into that agent's scope
and replaces only `description` / `parameters`. `execute`, `output.render`,
timeout and safety flags are inherited, so dispatch is unchanged; DeepSeek
Harness does not validate arguments (the MCP server still does), so nothing is
rejected. Eight frequently used `rea` tools are on a `keepFull` allowlist.

Typical result with the default config: **158 tools, 740,692 → 121,190 chars
(−83.6 %)**, with the five monster schemas cut by 91–99 %
(`compare_web_captures`: 155,623 → 1,392). Add `mcp__github__` to
`shadowPrefixes` and it becomes 182 tools, 776,706 → 143,679.

### 2. Cost attribution — where the re-sent context actually goes

It records every tool result (chars → tokens, duplicates, errors) and every
billed step's `usage`, then derives the numbers that matter:

```
prompt       = input + cacheRead + cacheWrite
new content  = input + cacheWrite            ← paid at full price
equivalent   = 0.1 × cacheRead + new content ← comparable across requests
```

It also classifies the current context (user / assistant / tool call / tool
result / reasoning) by character share, so "history is the biggest line item" is
a measurement, not a guess.

### 3. A settings page

**Settings → Cache saver** shows cost per request, cache hit rate, new paid
content, tool-result volume, the schema savings table, per-session stats,
recommendations and a recent-events timeline. Data comes from
`GET /api/cache-saver/status` (same origin, read-only).

## Config

Put overrides in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` (the durable layer):

```yaml
- id: cache-saver
  name: '@local/dsh-cache-saver'
  config:
    shadowPrefixes: ['mcp__rea__', 'mcp__github__']
    maxSchemaChars: 800
```

| key | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `shadowPrefixes` | `['mcp__rea__']` | tool-name prefixes to slim |
| `keepFull` | 8 core `rea` readers | never slimmed |
| `maxSchemaChars` | `800` | target size per schema |
| `maxDescriptionChars` | `260` | target size per description |
| `bigResultTokens` | `6000` | "big result" threshold |
| `maxStepSamples` | `60` | step samples kept per agent |
| `dryRun` | `false` | measure only, do not shadow |

Fine-tuning: `minChars 700`, `maxDepth 3`, `topDescriptionChars 140`,
`nestedDescriptionChars 60`, `descriptionDepth 1`, `maxBranches 4`.

## Why not just raise the cache hit rate?

Because hit rate and spending move in opposite directions here. A hit rate of
99 % means almost every token is a cheap cache read — but the *denominator* is
whatever you keep re-sending. Deleting 136 K stable characters lowers the
ceiling while genuinely cutting the bill. Track **equivalent tokens**, not the
ratio.

## Safety and limits

- Dispatch, arguments and results are untouched; only the model-facing schema
  copy shrinks.
- Rare deep parameters can be folded away — add that tool to `keepFull`, or set
  `dryRun: true` to turn the whole thing off.
- v0.3.1 still ships one payload measurement caveat: tool-result volume is
  attributed by `chars / 4`, while step costs use the provider's real `usage`.

## Development

```bash
npm test        # unit + client checks, no harness needed
npm run check   # syntax check
```

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Clamp every image sent to the model to a maximum side length (default 2000px) so Claude's many-image limit is never exceeded.
plugins.readme_text:
# dshx-image-clamp

> Downscales every image sent to the model so its long edge is at most 2000px (and under a byte budget), avoiding Claude's many-image limit that otherwise breaks the whole session.

Claude 在一次请求里图片超过 20 张时，任何一张边长超过 2000px 就会整条请求被拒。DSH 的附件归一化只限制总像素，单边仍可能超过 2000（例如 2730×1536），之后每一轮都会重放这张图，整个会话就卡死了。

本插件包装 `attachments.readImage`，在图片发给任何 provider 之前**实时**缩小到长边 ≤ `maxSide`，并压到单张 `maxBytes` 以内。磁盘上的原图不改动，停用插件即完全还原。

## 配置（`cordis.patch.yml`）

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `maxSide` | `2000` | 长边上限（像素） |
| `maxBytes` | `184320` | 单张编码后字节上限（180 KB） |

依赖宿主已有的 `sharp`（DSH 自带）；找不到时插件会记录警告并不做处理。

## 安装

```sh
# Web profile
dsh plugin --profile web add github:callaumyan-design/dshx-image-clamp
# Desktop（用 DSH Desktop 自带的 dsh 命令，先从托盘完全退出 Desktop）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:callaumyan-design/dshx-image-clamp
```

安装后重启 DSH。卸载：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dshx-image-clamp`。

## 兼容性

在 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2（desktop / web profile）上开发和使用。纯 JavaScript，无构建步骤，无安装脚本。

## License

MIT
