plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-task-board · 个人任务管理 DSH Web GUI 的个人任务管理面板：双月日历、日常清单、每天工作视图与可拖拽的 24 小时时间轴，并支持用自然语言让 AI 提取任务。

## 功能 - **双月日历**：连续两个月网格；每个长期任务按起止日期画成一条彩色时间条，当天的定时任务也会作为单日条画在对应日期上（长期任务优先排布，每周最多显示 5 行，点「还有 N 项」可展开显示全部；日常任务不显示在日历上）。跨周自动分段；双击长期任务线条进入拖动模式（拖线身移动日期、拖两端改长度）；已度过的日期段用浅灰雾面 + 细斜纹 + 白色毛玻璃描边标出；单击任一条线可查看该任务的子任务。 - **日常任务**：每天重复的习惯清单，圆角方块勾选框（完成时绿色实心 + 白色对勾）；可增删改。 - **每天工作**：按钮切换两种视图。 - **任务列表**：周一至周日 7 个竖列，左右翻页切换周；已过去日期背景为 `#E5ECFD`；只列非日常任务（定时任务与跨天长期任务），每行带完成勾选框。 - **具体当天**：左侧「当天日常」与「当天任务」两个清单，右侧 24 小时纵向时间轴；方块可拖动移动、拖上下边缘改起止（15 分钟吸附），双击时间轴空白处快速新建；点方块可编辑。 - **AI 提取**：页面顶部输入一段中文安排（例如「下周一至周五完成季度报告；每天锻炼 30 分钟；今天 14:00-15:30 开例会」），点击提取后调用当前默认模型解析为可编辑的任务草案，确认后写入日历 / 日常清单 / 当天安排。模型不可用、超时或返回格式异常时自动降级为本地规则解析，并给出提示。 - **子任务**：长期任务和当天定时任务都可以带**有序子任务**；AI 提取时缩进行会自动归到上一行任务名下。选中日历上的任务可查看其子任务，周视图显示子任务数量；子任务只能在「具体当天」页增删改，顺序固定、不支持拖动重排。 - **持久化**：改动自动保存到 `/task-board/data.json`；写入前做字段校验与原子重命名，读取失败时暂停自动保存以免覆盖原文件。 ## 安装 插件需要 DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`。任选一种： ```sh # 从 npm 安装（发布后可用） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-task-board # 或直接从 GitHub 安装 dsh plugin --profile web add github:GinoXiang/dsh-task-board ``` 安装后重启 DSH 或刷新 Web GUI，侧边栏会出现「任务」图标，点开即进入任务面板。 ## 数据与权限 - 只读写 `/task-board/data.json` 一个 JSON 文件（默认 `~/.dsh/task-board/data.json`）；卸载插件不会删除该文件。 - AI 提取只在点击「AI 提取」时调用一次当前配置的默认模型，不会后台自动请求；不发送文件内容，只发送输入框里的文本。 - Host 端提供三个本地 HTTP 接口（`/task-board/load`、`/task-board/save`、`/task-board/extract`），仅接受回环地址与同源请求，只支持 POST，请求体上限 2 MB。 - 无第三方运行时依赖；客户端使用 DSH Web GUI 自带的 React 与主题 token。 ## 开发 ``` index.js Host 半：三个本地接口、JSON 存储、LLM 提取 + 本地降级解析 client.js Client 半：侧边栏图标与整页 UI（plain JS，无需构建） cordis.patch.yml 插件插入补丁 locale/en.json 插件显示名与描述（英文） locale/zh.json 插件显示名与描述（中文） icon.svg 插件图标 ``` 修改 `client.js` 或 `index.js` 后，在插件管理中禁用再启用该 bundle 即可让客户端半重新加载。 ## License MIT --- --- # dsh-task-board · English A personal task board for the DSH Web GUI: a two-month calendar, a daily checklist, week and day work views with a draggable 24-hour timeline, and AI extraction of tasks from natural language. ## Features - **Two-month calendar** — every long-term task is drawn as a colored timeline bar across its date range, and a timed day task is drawn as a single-day bar on its date (long-term tasks pack first, five lanes per week row with an expand button to show every task; recurring daily tasks are not drawn on the calendar). Bars are split per week, double-clicking a long-term bar enters drag mode (move the body, drag either end to resize), and days before today are rendered as a hazy gray band with fine diagonal hatching and a white glass-like outline. Selecting any bar shows that task's subtasks. - **Daily tasks** — recurring daily habits in a rounded-square checkbox list (green filled with a white check when done); add, rename and delete. - **Daily work, two views** — a seven-column week list (Monday to Sunday, page between weeks, past days tinted `#E5ECFD`, completion checkboxes for timed tasks and long-term projects) and a specific-day view with the day's daily tasks, the day's tasks, and a 24-hour timeline whose blocks move by dragging and resize by dragging their edges (15-minute snapping, double-click empty space to add). - **AI extraction** — paste a Chinese schedule into the top bar, click extract, review the editable task drafts, then confirm to write them into the calendar, the daily checklist or a day plan. When the default model is unavailable, times out, or returns malformed output, a local rule-based parser takes over with a notice. - **Subtasks** — long-term tasks and timed day tasks can carry ordered subtasks; indented lines in an extracted outline become subtasks of the task above them. Selecting a task on the calendar shows its subtasks and the week view shows a subtask count; subtasks are added, renamed, checked and deleted only on the specific-day page, in their stored order (no drag reordering). - **Persistence** — autosave to `/task-board/data.json` with validation and atomic writes; autosave pauses if the file cannot be read, so a corrupt file is never overwritten. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-task-board # or dsh plugin --profile web add github:GinoXiang/dsh-task-board ``` Requires DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`. Restart DSH or refresh the Web GUI after installing; a "任务" (Tasks) icon appears in the sidebar. ## Data and permissions - Reads and writes only `/task-board/data.json` (default `~/.dsh/task-board/data.json`). - The default model is called once per explicit AI-extract click; nothing is fetched in the background and no file content is sent. - Three local HTTP endpoints (`/task-board/load`, `/task-board/save`, `/task-board/extract`) accept loopback, same-origin POST requests only, with a 2 MB body cap. - No third-party runtime dependencies; the client uses the React instance and theme tokens provided by the DSH Web GUI. ## License MIT --- ## 吉祥物 / Mascot

> 仅供图一乐，与插件功能无关。/ Just for fun; not related to the plugin itself.

plugins.description: Free, local, unlimited screenplay formatting for AI agents — open-source MCP server & DSH plugin from the Narracore toolkit (narracore.cn)
plugins.readme_text:
English | [Español](README.es.md) | [Français](README.fr.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [한국어](README.ko.md) | [繁體中文](README.zh-Hant.md)

# Narracore Format **Free, local, unlimited screenplay formatting for AI agents.** An open-source MCP server (and [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin) that turns raw or loosely formatted screenplay text into professionally structured screenplay blocks and typeset plain text — **Chinese, English, or mixed — including Japanese broadcast-drama format and Chinese colon-style dialogue scripts. The layout engine picks the right track automatically: a 33-char × 38-line CJK grid or a 61 × 55 Latin grid**, the same fixed typewriter character grid as [narracore.cn](https://narracore.cn?utm_source=github-plugin). - **Free forever** — runs on your machine, no account, no key, no quota, no network calls - **Deterministic** — pure rule-based engine, no LLM inside; same input always yields the same output, byte for byte - **Agent-native** — machine-readable diagnostics, evidence-anchored scene scoring, typed-blocks chaining contract across tools Part of the [Narracore](https://narracore.cn?utm_source=github-plugin) toolkit — the long-form co-writing workbench. Looking for print-ready **PDF export** or the full story-continuity tooling? See [the ecosystem](#ecosystem) below. ## Example Rough text in — typeset screenplay out. Both directions below are real engine output.
中文（CJK 33×38 字格轨） Input — loosely formatted text, one element per line: ```text 第 1 场 内 老式放映厅 - 夜 放映机的光柱切开黑暗，尘埃在光里悬浮。 常家青坐在最后一排，手里攥着一张褪色的电影票。 常家青 （低声） 如果胶片还在，就能证明那晚的一切。 检票员从阴影里走出来，把手电筒照在票面上。 检票员 这张票，二十年前就该作废了。 常家青站起身。光柱突然熄灭。 切至黑暗 ``` Output — `plain_text` from `format_screenplay` (scene heading, action, character, parenthetical, dialogue, right-aligned transition — all on the fixed grid): ```text 第 1 场 内 老式放映厅 - 夜 放映机的光柱切开黑暗，尘埃在光里悬浮。 常家青坐在最后一排，手里攥着一张褪色的电影票。 常家青 （低声） 如果胶片还在，就能证明那晚的一切。 检票员从阴影里走出来，把手电筒照在票面上。 检票员 这张票，二十年前就该作废了。 常家青站起身。光柱突然熄灭。 切至黑暗 ```
English (Latin 61×55 grid) Input: ```text INT. PROJECTION BOOTH - NIGHT The projector beam cuts through the dark. CHANG (quietly) If the reel still exists, it proves that night was real. CUT TO BLACK. ``` Output: ```text INT. PROJECTION BOOTH - NIGHT The projector beam cuts through the dark. CHANG (quietly) If the reel still exists, it proves that night was real. CUT TO BLACK. ```
The same call also returns typed `blocks` (scene / action / character / parenthetical / dialogue / transition / shot / note), page stats, and machine-readable diagnostics — feed those blocks back to any other tool in this package for analysis or conversion. ## Install ### DSH (DeepSeek Harness) — primary channel ```sh dsh plugin add narracore-format ``` That's it. Your agent gets five tools under the `mcp__narracore__*` namespace. ### Any MCP client (Claude Code, Cursor, …) The package is a standard stdio MCP server, so any MCP client can run it directly: ```jsonc // Claude Code: claude mcp add narracore-format -- npx -y narracore-format@latest // Cursor / generic MCP config: { "mcpServers": { "narracore-format": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "narracore-format@latest"] } } } ``` Requires Node ≥ 22. ## Tools (5) | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `format_screenplay` | Parse screenplay text (or typed blocks) into 8 semantic block types, typeset plain text, page stats, and diagnostics. `output="validate_only"` checks structure without formatting. | | `analyze_screenplay` | Deterministic statistics: scene list with structured headings (number / location / time of day / INT-EXT), per-scene word count, dialogue ratio, action density, character share table. | | `diagnose_scenes` | Scene-level "shootability" diagnosis: the agent cites evidence per scene, the tool validates it verbatim and computes exact 0–100 scores (severity-weighted coverage, BigInt arithmetic — never fakes a score). | | `convert_fountain` | Convert between Narracore typed blocks and [Fountain](https://fountain.io), the plain-text screenplay interchange format. | | `about_narracore` | Ecosystem overview — what else Narracore offers. | **Chaining contract:** to run another tool on the same screenplay, pass back the `blocks` you received (`input_format="blocks"`), not the formatted plain text — blocks parse deterministically; text re-parses. ## Ecosystem - **[narracore.cn](https://narracore.cn?utm_source=github-plugin)** — the full long-form co-writing workbench this toolkit comes from: screenplay and story writing with the same typesetting, plus story-window continuity tooling that goes beyond a local formatter. - **[narracore.app](https://narracore.app?utm_source=github-plugin)** — the hosted MCP service built on the same pipeline, adding a print-ready **PDF export** with embedded fonts (cover page, running headers, signed download links). You can buy N uses of the formatting service there if you want the PDF pipeline without installing anything. ## Engine provenance The layout engine in `src/format/` is the same single source of truth used by narracore.cn. It is ported verbatim from the Narracore codebase (provenance hashes in [`src/format/README.md`](src/format/README.md)), and **snapshot tests pin it byte-for-byte** — green snapshot tests are the machine proof that this package lays out text identically to the narracore.cn web app. The analysis layer (`src/analysis/`) is a TS port of the Narracore analyzer, locked by golden tests generated from the original implementation. ## Development ```sh npm install npm test # 162 tests: snapshots, golden samples, tool layer, stdio e2e, billing-free guard npm run build # esbuild single-file bundle → dist/index.js npm start # run the stdio server ``` Guard test: the package must stay free of any billing / license / payment code — `test/tools/guard.test.ts` fails if such references appear in `src/`. ## License [MIT](LICENSE). The layout engine is © Narracore; see the provenance notes above.

plugins.description: Device pairing, scoped authorization and message transport for the DS Bot native mobile client. An independent DSH plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# DS Bot Mobile Bridge 原生 App 与现有 DS Bot 团队之间的设备认证和消息传输插件。

[English](README.en.md) · [文档](docs/README.md) · [安装与配置](docs/configuration.md) · [开发](docs/development.md) · [下载](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-bridge/releases) · [反馈](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-bridge/issues)
DS Bot Mobile Bridge 是安装在电脑 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）中的独立插件，为 [DS Bot Mobile App](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-app) 提供设备配对、受限授权、Bot／群文字历史、消息提交和回执。它使用现有团队的公开会话接口，无需另建团队。 当前版本为 **0.0.6 独立插件预览**，适配 DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** 与提供兼容 Bridge 接口的 DS Bot。这里维护传输服务；手机界面和电脑上的配对管理界面由 App 仓库维护。仅用手机浏览器时，请安装 [Mobile Web](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-web)，无需 Bridge。 ## 架构 ```mermaid flowchart LR App[手机原生 App] -->|HTTPS／设备凭据| Bridge[Mobile Bridge] Owner[电脑 App 配套插件] -->|DSH 所有者认证| Bridge Bridge -->|公开会话接口| Team[现有 DS Bot 团队] ``` Bridge 与电脑管理界面独立启停。手机只能访问协商后明确支持的能力，电脑所有者负责批准与撤销设备；团队、Bot 和群会话继续由 DS Bot 管理。 ## 能力与边界 | 能力 | 行为 | | --- | --- | | 设备配对 | 请求经电脑批准后发放可撤销的设备凭据 | | 会话与历史 | 可见 Bot／群、分页文字历史、完整消息与重连状态 | | 稳定提交 | 请求标识、回执查询和冲突重试拒绝 | | 受限操作 | 按宿主声明提供模型、用量、自己的记忆、日程、队列和取消 | | 数据边界 | 明确字段投影、群会话作用域与上游已知值脱敏 | 本版不提供逐 token 事件、原生审批或密钥提交、媒体与语音传输、系统推送或群管理。完整能力取决于兼容宿主，详见[兼容说明](COMPATIBILITY.md)。 ## 安装与配对 1. **确认宿主兼容。** 现有 DS Bot 需要 `bridge.describe`、稳定 `bridge.submit` 和 `bridge.redact`。原版 npm DS Bot `0.1.7` 缺少完整接口；需要时使用 [App 发布页](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-app/releases)明确标识的兼容包。 2. **安装 Bridge。** 从 [Bridge Releases](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-bridge/releases) 下载 `.tgz` 插件包，在电脑的 DSH 官方插件管理器安装、启用。 3. **配置独立状态与 HTTPS。** 按[配置指南](docs/configuration.md)设置专用绝对 `home`、监听端口和已有的手机可达 HTTPS 地址。Bridge 不创建隧道、证书或公网入口。 4. **扫码并批准。** 安装 App 配套插件，从电脑 **手机访问 → App** 生成配对码；手机扫描后，在电脑核对设备名称并批准。 `.tgz` 安装在电脑上。手机需要 App 仓库提供的原生客户端；目前仍需自行构建，没有公开可直接安装的 IPA/APK。扫码不会自动得到设备权限。 ## 三个独立组件 | 仓库 | 职责 | 什么时候需要 | | --- | --- | --- | | [Mobile Web](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-web) | 浏览器界面、会话导航、Web 登录入口 | 手机直接用浏览器访问 | | [Mobile App](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-app) | 原生客户端、SDK、电脑配对与设备管理界面 | 使用原生 App | | **Mobile Bridge** | 设备认证、受限会话访问、HTTP／WebSocket 传输 | 原生 App 连接电脑 | ## 更新与迁移 保留原 Bridge `home`，其中保存设备与回执身份。先停用旧实例并释放端口，再用同一状态目录启用新包；不要让两个实例同时使用同一目录。停用 App 配套插件只移除管理界面；要停止设备传输，应停用 Bridge。要撤销某台手机，在电脑的已授权设备列表中撤销访问。 ## 文档与开发 | 文档 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | [安装与配置](docs/configuration.md) | 状态目录、TLS、反向代理、配对、升级 | | [所有者接口](docs/owner-api.md) | 认证载体与允许的管理命令 | | [架构](docs/architecture.md) | 服务边界与运行时结构 | | [兼容与能力](COMPATIBILITY.md) | 适配版本和未提供的功能 | | [验证范围](docs/validation.md) | 单元、隔离集成、精确包交付的证据边界 | | [开发](docs/development.md) | 独立依赖、测试、打包与 CI | | [贡献](CONTRIBUTING.md) | 提交要求与问题报告 | | [来源](docs/provenance.md) | 原仓库提交、许可与同步方式 | 开发使用 Node.js 24。可在独立 checkout 中执行 `npm ci --ignore-scripts`、`npm run test:prepare`、`npm run check` 和 `npm run test:integration`。无需 App/Web checkout、手机、真实模型密钥或用户 DSH 配置。 ## 安全与来源 配对码、完整配对资料和设备令牌只给自己的设备。反馈时使用合成数据，移除凭据、私人域名和聊天内容。漏洞处理见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。 [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE)。Bridge 运行时代码从 App 仓库的固定公开提交独立提取，原 [NOTICE](NOTICE) 与来源保留。精灵和上游 DS Bot 代码来自 Fei2411 及贡献者；开发用 SDK、mock 与兼容补丁有明确出处，且不进入插件安装包。本项目是独立社区项目，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) language pack for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): registers a zh-Hant locale and 2,699 generated dictionaries across every namespace the web GUI uses
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zh-hant

繁體中文 language pack for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH). It adds a third language to the web GUI — `zh-Hant` — next to the shipped
`zh` (Simplified) and `en`, and puts it in **Settings → General → Language**.

![Settings panel in Traditional Chinese](screenshots/zh-hant-settings.png)

Nothing in DSH is patched, no bundle is forked, and no other plugin is modified.
The locale service in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale` is explicitly extensible,
so Traditional Chinese is a plugin: it registers one language definition and one
dictionary per namespace, and the running app picks both up immediately.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-zh-hant            # from npm
dsh plugin add file:./plugins/dsh-zh-hant   # from a local checkout
```

Then choose **繁體中文** in Settings → General → 語言.

**The `dsh web` host must be running with the plugin already installed.** A
server started *before* `dsh plugin add` keeps serving the client module graph it
built at boot, so the language does not appear until it is restarted. If the
Plugins panel lists the plugin but the Language menu does not, that is why.

## What it covers

62 namespaces, 2,699 keys, ~90 KB — every dictionary the installed web GUI
registers, including the experimental features and the third-party plugins that
opt into `ctx.locale`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Settings | 設定 · 通用設定 · 模型 · 外觀 · 字號大小 · 快捷鍵 … |
| Conversation | 發送 · 插話發送 · 排隊發送 · 停止生成 · 軌跡 · 差異 |
| Sidebar | 摺疊側邊欄 · 新建會話 · 封存 · 刪除會話 · 工作區 |
| Files / preview | 檔案預覽 · 影像預覽 · PDF 預覽 · 沒有可預覽的檔案類型 |
| Plugins, schedules, agents | 外掛 · 提醒 · 子代理 · 預設權限 · 軌跡檢視 |

## What it does not cover

This is a language pack for DSH's **own** interface. It deliberately does not
reach into anything else:

- **Other plugins' hardcoded copy.** `dshmarket` never calls `ctx.locale`, so its
  panel title stays 「插件市场」. Editing that plugin's source is not this
  package's business — a plugin that wants Traditional Chinese registers its own
  dictionaries.
- **Copy captured outside the dictionary** — plugin titles from package
  manifests (`ctx.locale.resolveText`), command descriptions read once at
  registration time.
- **Model output, file contents, and anything the user typed.**

## How the dictionaries are built

The web GUI has ~2,700 keys and DeepSeek ships new ones every release, so the
dictionary is generated from the `zh` values the **installed** build already
contains, never hand-maintained:

```
scripts/extract-locales.mjs   read every ctx.locale.register() call site out of
                              the installed client bundles (shorthand consts,
                              esbuild-renamed consts, object spread and all)
        │
        ▼
scripts/build-dictionaries.mjs  OpenCC cn → tw → twp, per value
        │
        ▼
lib/client.js                 src/client.js with the literal spliced in
```

Rebuild after a DSH upgrade:

```bash
npm install                      # opencc-js, build-time only
npm run build                    # → lib/client.js
npm test                         # behaviour + conversion checks
```

`npm run build:tw` and `npm run build:t` produce the character-only variants if
you prefer 設置/文件 to 設定/檔案.

Two details that are easy to get wrong:

- **A single `cn → twp` pass is not a fixed point.** `STPhrases` rewrites 发送 to
  發送 and `TWPhrases` then finds nothing Simplified left, so 待发送附件 comes out
  as 待發送附件 and only becomes 待傳送附件 on a *second* pass. Running
  `cn → tw` to completion and applying the variant pass afterwards is both more
  idiomatic and idempotent.
- **`fallback` is `zh`, not `en`.** A key this pack does not cover falls back to
  Simplified rather than English, which is the right failure mode for a
  Traditional reader — and it means a namespace added by a future release
  degrades instead of breaking.

## Tests

`npm test` checks the registration contract (one language, one dictionary per
namespace, the three-argument register form), that a `zh-Hant` id already owned
by another pack is a warning rather than a boot failure, that the key set matches
the installed bundles exactly, and that **no Simplified-only character survives**
the conversion.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Composer-dock widget for DeepSeek Harness: account balance + session token usage.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-balance-usage-widget

A tiny composer-dock widget for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. It shows your DeepSeek account balance and the current session's token usage in one line:

```
¥12.34 · 12.3K tok
```

Hover for the breakdown: topped-up balance, granted balance, uncached input, cache reads, cache writes, output tokens and cache-hit rate.

> Community plugin. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

## 中文说明

在 DSH 输入框下方的状态行显示“账户余额 + 本会话 token 用量”。

- 左边：DeepSeek 账号的充值余额（多币种用 `/` 分隔；低于 0.01 显示 `<0.01`）。
- 右边：本会话累计 token（未命中输入 + 缓存命中 + 缓存写入 + 输出）。
- 悬停：充值余额、赠金余额、本会话 token 分项和缓存命中率。
- 未登录或余额查询失败时显示 `余额 --`，token 仍正常显示。

### 安装

从 npm 安装（`desktop` profile 由桌面端独占管理时，请在界面里安装）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-balance-usage-widget
```

或在 **侧栏 → 插件 → 添加插件** 中填写包名 `dsh-balance-usage-widget`，安装后重启 DSH。

本地开发时可在安装对话框里粘贴本目录的绝对路径。

### 隐私与边界

- 余额通过 DSH 客户端已有的 `ctx.remote.account.getBalance` 读取，与 **设置 → 账号** 同源；只读，不写文件。
- Token 来自 DSH 的 `tokenUsage` 会话投影，与“性能与用量 → 详细”同源。
- 不发起额外网络请求、不读取会话正文、不写任何文件。
- 余额每 60 秒刷新一次，页面重新可见时也会刷新。

## How it works

- Host half: an empty bundle patch that inserts one row.
- Client half: a browser module that registers a `conversation.composer.dock` entry.
  - balance: `ctx.remote.account.getBalance({ version, locale, timezoneOffsetSeconds })`
  - tokens: `useProjection('tokenUsage')`
- No build step; `client.js` is the published browser artifact.

## Compatibility

- DSH Web / Desktop `0.2.x` (`dsh.client` bundle).
- Balance requires a DeepSeek account login. API-key-only setups show `余额 --`, because the built-in account service does not expose balance for API keys.

## Development

```bash
# local install into a throwaway profile
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-balance-usage-widget
```

The package is plain ESM plus one browser module; there is nothing to compile.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: 归档工作台（DeepSeek Harness 插件）：在侧边栏会话菜单中永久删除会话，并提供归档会话面板，可一键恢复或删除已归档会话。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archive-workbench

**归档工作台** — DeepSeek Harness 的会话删除 + 归档管理插件。

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness 官方只能**归档**会话（隐藏，不删盘），也没有一个方便的地方查看已归档的会话。这个插件补上这两块：

1. **永久删除会话** —— 侧边栏会话行的「...」菜单里多一项「删除会话」，真正删掉磁盘上的日志，而不是只隐藏。
2. **归档会话面板** —— 侧边栏底部多一个归档图标，点开是一整页已归档会话列表，每行可**恢复归档**或**删除**。

---

## 截图

**归档会话面板** —— 侧边栏的「已归档会话」，每行可恢复归档或删除：

![归档会话面板](assets/archived-panel.png)

**删除确认弹窗** —— 从会话菜单或面板删除时都会弹出：

![删除确认弹窗](assets/delete-confirm.png)

---

## 功能

### 1. 会话菜单：删除会话

在任一会话行的「...」菜单最下方（`复制 Session ID` 之后，带分隔线）：

> 置顶 → 重命名 → 分叉 → 归档 → 复制 Session ID → **删除会话**

点击后弹出确认框，确认即永久删除：

- 删除该会话**自己的**日志目录（`~/.dsh/sessions/<项目>/<会话ID>/`）
- 清理它的投影缓存（`~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<会话ID>.json`）
- 把该 id 从归档/置顶集合里移除（避免重启后出现"幽灵行"）
- 通知前端**立即移除该行**（无需刷新页面）

**已归档的会话同样支持** —— 菜单项不区分状态。

### 2. 归档会话面板

侧边栏底部图标栏（与「插件」「定时」并排）多一个**归档图标**，点开后在主区域显示整页列表：

```
已归档会话  2
归档的会话会显示在这里，可随时恢复或删除。

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 会话标题                              [恢复归档] [删除]   │
│ session-cf676d08-1890-427e-aa64-34a910d31600            │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- 每行显示**标题 + 原始会话 ID**（取不到标题时显示「未命名」）
- **恢复归档**：调官方 `unarchiveSession`，该行立即消失，会话回到原工作区位置
- **删除**：复用同一个确认框，永久删除
- 顺序：**最近归档的在最上**
- 空状态：「暂无已归档会话」

> 顺便说明：官方其实也有查看归档会话的入口（侧边栏顶部「视图选项」→ 全部对话（显示已归档）），但入口较深，且那里没有恢复/删除按钮 —— 恢复还得回到会话行的「...」菜单。本面板把这两件事集中到一个地方。

---

## 安装

**方式一：插件市场**（推荐）

在 DeepSeek Harness 里打开 设置 → 插件，搜索 `dsh-archive-workbench`。

**方式二：命令行**

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-archive-workbench
```

**方式三：从 GitHub 直接安装**

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/CHYMZXS/dsh-archive-workbench
```

**方式四：本地开发目录**

```bash
dsh plugin add /path/to/dsh-archive-workbench
```

安装后**重启一次 DeepSeek Harness**（插件含 Host 端代码，首次安装需要重启生效）。

---

## 已知限制

### 正在运行的会话（重要）

DeepSeek Harness **没有**任何公开 API 能让一个会话从内存中退出。因此对于**本次运行中打开过、还驻留在内存里**的会话，删除文件不够 —— 它可能立刻把日志重新写回来。

插件的处理方式是：

1. 先调用官方 `archiveSession({ stopActivity: true })`，停掉它正在跑的工作并封住后续写入
2. 等它空闲（最多 8 秒）
3. 再删文件
4. 删完**反复复查**（最多 6 次）确认文件没有重新出现

如果文件仍然被重建，插件会**明确报错**（而不是假装成功）：

> the session is still resident in this application and keeps recreating its log; restart the application and delete it again

**建议**：如果要删的是"当前正在用/刚用过"的会话，**先重启一次应用再删** —— 重启后它变成冷会话，删除是干净的。

### 附件不会被删除

`~/.dsh/attachments/` 里的图片/附件**不会**被删除。它们按内容哈希全局共享，多个会话可能引用同一个对象 —— 按会话去删会破坏其他会话。

### 子智能体会话

子智能体（subagent）产生的会话**不会**出现在侧边栏，因此无法从 UI 删除。这是官方行为。

---

## 工作原理

插件完全建立在官方扩展点上，**不修改官方任何一行代码**：

| 部分 | 用到的官方扩展点 |
|---|---|
| 删除菜单项 | `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` 槽位（官方为插件预留，order 500） |
| 确认弹窗 | `shell.overlay` 槽位 + 官方 `Modal` / `Button` 组件 |
| 归档面板图标 | `sidebar.panellist` 槽位（order 20） |
| 归档面板页面 | `main` 键值槽位（key = `dsh-archive-workbench-archived`） |
| 删除动作 | Host 端 `ctx.webServer.register()` 注册私有路由；客户端 `fetch` 调用 |
| 前端移除行 | 发官方 `api-session/removed` 事件（在官方转发白名单内） |
| 恢复归档 | 官方 `uiWorkspace.unarchiveSession()` |
| 清理投影缓存 | 官方 `storageDomain` 的 `table.delete()` |

删除逻辑在 Host 端（`index.js`），UI 在客户端（`client.js`），通过一条私有 HTTP 路由通信。

---

## 开发

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CHYMZXS/dsh-archive-workbench
cd dsh-archive-workbench
dsh plugin add .
```

改完 `client.js` 会自动热重载；改 `index.js`（Host 端）需要重启应用。

---

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-relay-reasoning

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Real reasoning levels — **off / low / medium / high / max** — on every model of your OpenAI-compatible relay, right in the DSH model picker.

## The problem

Relays such as a self-hosted gateway fronting many models accept the `reasoning_effort` request parameter, but DSH offers no reasoning control for them. The reason is structural: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` only publishes selectable levels for a model whose `reasoningEfforts` field declares them, so a route configured by hand shows nothing.

Declaring those levels by hand means repeating seven lines for every model — and re-doing it whenever the model list changes.

## What this plugin does

It writes `reasoningEfforts` into the `llm-pi-ai` profile entry for every model on the configured providers, and the picker immediately offers those levels. No restart, and no editing of your model list.

**It keeps up with your configuration.** The first pass runs at activation, and every later profile configuration reload — adding a relay or a model from the settings UI, editing a route — runs it again and fills in whatever is missing. A relay you connect while DSH is running gets its levels without a restart.

## Why these five levels

pi-ai understands seven levels, but a relay does not distinguish all of them. Measured over three prompts and two passes on one relay route, median reasoning tokens per level:

| Level | median reasoning tokens |
|---|---|
| off | 0 |
| minimal | 108 |
| low | 122 |
| medium | 155 |
| high | 142 |
| xhigh | 125 |
| max | 359 |

`max` is roughly double every other level, so it is a genuinely stronger tier and is included by default.

The five middle levels (`minimal` through `xhigh`) land within each other's noise on this route, so publishing them would only duplicate choices. They stay out by default but can be requested through `levels` if a route of yours does distinguish them.

If your relay turns out to ignore `max`, drop it with `levels: [off, low, medium, high]` so the picker does not offer a level that does nothing.

## Install

From the DSH workshop (Settings → Workshop → Plugins), or directly:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle → dsh-relay-reasoning
```

Development builds can also be installed from a checkout:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle → <path to this repository>
```

## Configuration

The plugin row takes an optional config:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: relay-reasoning
      name: dsh-relay-reasoning
      config:
        target: llm-pi-ai                 # profile entry id to configure
        providers: []                     # empty = every provider on that entry
        levels: [off, low, medium, high, max]  # published levels, ascending
        force: false                      # true = rewrite once at activation even if already correct
        debugLog: ""                      # optional file path for diagnostics
```

`providers: []` means the plugin covers every provider on the entry, so adding a new relay needs no plugin change.

`levels` defaults to `off, low, medium, high, max`. Narrow it if your relay ignores a level:

```yaml
levels: [off, low, medium, high]
```

Any subset of `off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max` is accepted; names are published in ascending order and unknown names are dropped.

## Idempotent

A pass writes nothing when every model already declares exactly the configured levels; it inspects and stops. Updating the package, and the configuration reload caused by the plugin's own write, therefore never churn your configuration, and any leftover declaration from a manual setup is detected and rewritten.

Changing `levels` does rewrite the affected models, because their current declaration no longer matches.

`force: true` is honoured at activation only — it rewrites once, including declarations that are already correct. Later reloads ignore it, because honouring it every time would rewrite the same declaration and reload in a loop.

## How it works

Three details are worth knowing if you read the source.

**It does not override the `llm-pi-ai` row.** A Cordis loader patch replaces a row's `config` wholesale rather than merging it, so a patch that added `reasoningEfforts` would erase `baseURL`, the credential reference, and the whole model list. The plugin instead calls `settings.mutate()` with path-scoped operations, touching only `providers.<name>.models[i].reasoningEfforts`.

**It writes outside the transaction.** The HMR config editor refuses to nest transactions, and its guard reads an `AsyncLocalStorage` store that survives awaits and timers, so deferring is not enough. The plugin runs the write through `hmr.executing.exit()` — the same mechanism `dsh-hmr` uses when wiring a config watcher from inside a transaction.

**It listens to `app-boot/config-reload`.** Every successful profile reload emits that event — including a relay added from the settings UI. The plugin inspects once shortly afterwards; a reload caused by its own write only finds everything already correct and stops, so there is no loop, and a burst of events collapses into one inspection.

## Compatibility

- Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.1`.
- No runtime dependencies: only `node:fs` and Host-provided services.
- Works with any OpenAI-compatible route declared on the `llm-pi-ai` entry, not just one relay.

## License

MIT

DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect. plugins.description: SOLIDWORKS for DeepSeek Harness: dsh models parts, assembles them, checks interference, counts the BOM and makes drawings in a running SOLIDWORKS 2016+, on the same PC or in a Windows VM. Your files read-only by default.
plugins.readme_text:
``` ___ _ __ dsh-solidworks / __| \ / / \__ \\ \/\/ / SOLIDWORKS for DeepSeek Harness: |___/ \_/\_/ model, assemble, check, draw and export, in the SOLIDWORKS on your desk ``` **dsh drives the SOLIDWORKS you already have open: 2016 and later, on the same PC or in a Windows VM on your Mac.**

21 tools · verified on SOLIDWORKS 2016 SP1 and 2019 SP0 · one bridge exe, no runtime to install, no admin · your files read-only by default · MIT

Watch it · Get started · Tools · What it will not do · How it works · Proof · When to skip it · llms.txt · 中文

---

**One paragraph in, a flange out.** You describe the part; dsh models it in the SOLIDWORKS on your desk, checks the volume against its own arithmetic (158,983.493 mm³ both ways), and looks at it from four sides. It can also put parts together, check them for collisions, count a bill of materials, make the drawing, and work on the files you already have, read-only unless you say otherwise. ## Watch it Every clip is a real session: dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 with `deepseek-flash`, SOLIDWORKS 2019 SP0 in a Parallels VM, recorded from the SOLIDWORKS window. The captions are the session's own tool calls and results, and its own closing words. Time spent thinking is fast-forwarded; nothing is cut or reordered. [How the clips are made](scripts/clips/README.md). ### Point at it You select a face in SOLIDWORKS and say what to do with it. dsh reads your selection (the flange's top face, 8 edges), rounds every edge of it at 2 mm, and explains why the volume went down by 360.218 mm³ even though one fillet adds material.

### Put parts together, check they fit A shaft is modeled, both parts saved, and assembled with the shaft through the bore and the flange 40 mm up. Interference: 0 pairs. dsh also counts faces that only touch, and points out that a 30 mm shaft in a 30 mm bore is a line-to-line fit. Then the bill of materials.

### Draw it The drawing lays its views out in projection at the largest standard scale that fits, brings in the model's dimensions, and comes back to your workspace as a PDF.

Left: the PDF as exported. Right: sw_view, four views on one picture, which is how dsh looks at what it made.

## Get started You need dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 or later (its `dsh plugin add` uses pnpm, so pnpm on the PATH) and a running SOLIDWORKS 2016 or later. ### dsh and SOLIDWORKS on the same Windows PC ``` dsh plugin --profile web add @dshworks/dsh-solidworks ``` Start SOLIDWORKS, start dsh, ask. The plugin runs its bundled `swbridge.exe` on the first SOLIDWORKS question; there is nothing to pair or install. ### dsh on a Mac, SOLIDWORKS in a Windows VM 1. On the Mac: `dsh plugin --profile web add @dshworks/dsh-solidworks`, then start dsh once. It listens for the bridge and writes a pairing kit. 2. In the VM, signed in as the person who uses SOLIDWORKS, open `\\Mac\Home\.dsh\dsh-solidworks\windows\` (Parallels shares your Mac home folder there) and double-click `pair.cmd`. That installs the bridge for that Windows user, connects it to dsh, and starts it at every sign-in. No administrator, no firewall rule: the bridge dials out to dsh, so Windows never opens a port. If you ask dsh before pairing, the answer says where the kit is. On VMware, another PC, or a Mac without Parallels sharing, copy the `~/.dsh/dsh-solidworks/windows/` folder to the Windows machine and run `pair.cmd` there. If the VM reaches your Mac on an address the kit did not list, set it: ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: dsh-solidworks config: advertise: ['10.211.55.2'] # Parallels' usual host address ``` Undo it in the VM with `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-solidworks\swbridge.exe uninstall`. ### Any other MCP client, on the Windows PC `swbridge.exe mcp` is a plain stdio MCP server with the same 21 tools: ``` claude mcp add solidworks -- C:\tools\swbridge.exe mcp ``` The exe is in this package at `bin/swbridge.exe` and on every [GitHub release](https://github.com/dshworks/dsh-solidworks/releases) with its SHA-256. ## Tools Lengths are millimetres, angles degrees, mass kilograms, whatever units the document uses; field names say so (`value_mm`, `mass_kg`). Geometry is addressed in one space everywhere: model-space points `[x, y, z]` in mm, Y up, the front plane at z = 0, top at y = 0, right at x = 0. Faces and edges are picked by a point on them. `doc` is a path, file name or title of an open document and defaults to the active one.
All 21 tools | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `sw_status` | Release (2016 SP1, 2019 SP0, ...), every SOLIDWORKS instance, the open documents, and any dialog SOLIDWORKS is waiting on. Called first. | | `sw_open` | Open a `.sldprt`, `.sldasm` or `.slddrw`, read-only unless asked, and activate it. | | `sw_new` | A new, empty part or assembly from SOLIDWORKS' default template. | | `sw_inspect` | Type, units, configurations, material, custom properties, bounding box, body and component counts. | | `sw_features` | The feature tree with suppression state and rebuild errors. | | `sw_parameters` | Every dimension (`D1@Sketch1`, value, unit, driven or not) and equation, global variables marked. | | `sw_components` | An assembly's component tree: file, configuration, state, fixed, position. | | `sw_mass_properties` | Mass, volume, surface area, density, centre of mass. | | `sw_probe` | What is at a point: the face, edge or vertex there, with its surface or curve, area or length, normal or axis, diameter and the feature that made it. Without points, whatever the user has selected in SOLIDWORKS right now. Two entities also give the distance and angle between them. | | `sw_edit` | In memory, then one rebuild: configuration, suppress/unsuppress, global variables, dimensions, custom properties. Each change comes back with before, after and its own outcome. | | `sw_build` | Model a part in steps: sketch (lines, polylines, rectangles, circles, arcs, centerlines) on a plane or a face, extrude or cut (blind, through all, mid-plane, draft), revolve, fille

plugins.description: A permanent 'Delete session' action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a confirmation dialog.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-clean-delete

A permanent **Delete session** action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a
confirmation dialog that tells you what is about to go.

DSH ships a *Archive* action, which is reversible and keeps the session in the
Archived list. This plugin adds the irreversible counterpart, and — unlike a
naive `rm` of the session log — it actually makes the row disappear.

## What it does

Adds one row to the per-session `…` menu in the left sidebar, ordered after
Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive. Choosing it opens a modal that reports:

- whether the session is **still open on this machine** (it cannot be reopened afterwards),
- the **log size** about to be removed,
- **running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders** bound to the session,
- how many reminders are deleted with it.

Confirming stops the session's work, unlinks its session directory and projection
checkpoint, and releases the id from every registry that would otherwise keep
listing it. Then the sidebar refreshes and the row is gone.

There is **no undo and no trash folder**. The dialog says so.

## Why it is not just `rm`

A session's directory is not the only thing that makes it appear. The Host's
session corpus is `persistence ∪ live`, so a session the Host still holds live
keeps coming back after its log is deleted:

1. the browser drops the row,
2. the next `sessions.refresh()` rebuilds the rows from the Host list and folds
   the live summary back in,
3. the row **returns**.

The visible symptom of this is that deleting several sessions in a row makes the
earlier ones reappear, and that archived rows come back stuck in Archived forever
(the old id was never removed from the archive set, so it accumulated dead ids).

`release()` therefore detaches through the same teardown the owning fiber uses,
in the order the agent loop's own disposal uses — **agents first, then
sessions** — plus `unarchiveSession(id)` and `workspace.detachSession(id)`. The
browser keeps its own `retired` set and re-applies every retirement after each
refresh, so rows stay retired until the Host's `api-session/removed` agrees.

## Install

This package ships a `dsh.bundle` manifest, so `dsh plugin` installs it as a
profile layer by itself — **you do not need to edit `cordis.patch.yml`**. Bare
`@deepseek-ai/*` imports are resolved by the host itself, so the package declares
**zero dependencies** — do not add them.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-clean-delete
```

That is the npm name, and it is also the repository name.

From a source clone, `dsh plugin` is a pnpm passthrough, so a `file:` path works
too:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-session-clean-delete
```

That command does two things: it adds the package as a dependency, **and** it
appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`. The second
half is the one people miss — without it the package is just an unused
dependency, because the bundle patch in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)
is only read for packages the bundle list names.

Verify it joined the tree — the entry must appear under a banner naming the
plugin's own `cordis.patch.yml`, which is the part that is easy to miss:

```bash
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | grep -B1 session-clean-delete
```

```
# == …/dsh-session-clean-delete/cordis.patch.yml
- id: session-clean-delete
  name: dsh-session-clean-delete
```

A row under a banner for the *profile's* `cordis.patch.yml` means something
inserted this plugin by hand and it is **not** installed as a bundle — the
dependency is present but the layer never composes. `--dump-config` never
mounts, so it is safe against the live profile.

Finally **restart the harness**. The bundle is composed at boot, so there is no
partial effect: until it restarts, the menu row is not there.

### If nothing happens

- **Re-running the same add is a no-op** — same spec, same version.
  `rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-clean-delete` first, or
  the profile keeps serving the old copy forever.
- pnpm **copies** the package into the profile rather than symlinking it, so
  editing your clone does not change the running plugin. Copy
  `lib/*.js` into `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-clean-delete/lib/`.
  `client.js` hot-reloads; `index.js` is host-side and needs a restart.
- `dsh plugin` needs `pnpm` on `PATH` (`corepack enable pnpm`), or it fails with
  "pnpm was not found".
- pnpm installs a version **older** than the registry `latest` when a release is
  less than 24 h old — that is `minimumReleaseAge`, a supply-chain guardrail, not
  a stale cache. Wait, or use a `^x.y.z` range so the newer release arrives on
  its own.

## Design notes

**A Typert `Remote` service, not an HTTP route.** The host half registers one
`TypertRemoteService` named `sessionDelete` with `describe` and `deleteSession`.
The Gateway auto-claims every endpoint a live `TypertRemoteService` declares, and
the browser calls it over the ordinary channel:

```js
ctx.connection.rpc.call('/api', `sessionDelete/${method}`, { args: { request } })
```

So there is no route to register and no permission to grant — the browser peer is
the owner principal.

**It deliberately does not check `Origin`.** In the desktop app the renderer
origin is the custom scheme `dsh-app://app`, and the shell's `protocol.handle`
strips `origin`, `host`, `cookie` and `sec-fetch-site` before forwarding to the
Host. A plugin route that validates `origin === 'http://' + host` therefore 403s
*every* request from the desktop app while working fine under `dsh web`. The
Remote-service path avoids the question entirely.

**The postcondition is checked against the disk.** A successful `rm` is not
treated as proof; `removeLog()` stats the path afterwards and throws
`delete/failed` if it survived.

## Files

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: `TypertRemoteService`, the delete sequence, registry release. |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: the menu row and the `shell.overlay` confirmation dialog. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch named by `dsh.bundle`; inserts this plugin into a profile. |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Plugin titles for the Plugins panel. |

The in-app dictionary lives in `lib/client.js` (`zh` is the key-set source of
truth, `en` is checked complete against it); `locale/*.json` is the metadata the
Plugins panel reads.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.readme_text:
---
description: "Gemini subagent: drive the official Google Gemini CLI as a one-shot coding subagent inside DeepSeek Harness (subagent_gemini delegation tool)."
kind: "package-bundle"
---

# dsh-subagent-gemini

> **发布状态：暂未发布到 npm / DSH 插件市场。**
> Gemini CLI 目前尚未提供 Gemini 4，且本插件需要用户自备 Gemini API key 才能完成端到端验证；
> 在验证通过前不提交市场收录，避免把未经验证的插件放给用户。代码、测试与 CI 均已就绪，验证后可发布。
>
> 想用 Gemini 4 请安装 [`dsh-subagent-antigravity`](https://github.com/PipeDream941/dsh-subagent-antigravity)。

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Adds a **Gemini subagent** to DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a parent session can call
`subagent_gemini` to run a Google Gemini CLI coding agent in a **separate process**
inside the parent workspace, let it edit files and run commands on its own, and
get only the final answer back.

The shape is the same as the official Codex subagent (`subagent_codex`) and the
community Cursor subagent (`cursor_code`):

- **Fresh process, fresh session** — every delegation spawns a new `gemini --acp`;
- **Final answer only** — the child's thoughts, tool calls and stderr never enter the parent conversation;
- **One task per run** — no follow-up input or continuation (use the native `subagent`/`fork` backends for those);
- **Safe diagnostics** — failures report fixed stage/category facts, never stderr, paths or credentials.

> Community plugin; not affiliated with Google. Gemini CLI is Google's official CLI — this plugin only drives it from DSH.

## How it works

```
parent session (DeepSeek model)
   │  calls tool subagent_gemini({ description, prompt })
   ▼
DSH subagent seam (ctx.subagents)
   │  provider: gemini (registered by this plugin)
   ▼
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp (official ACP subagent backend)
   │  spawn, ACP handshake, auto-answered permissions, process-range cleanup, safe diagnostics
   ▼
gemini --acp --skip-trust  (separate process, parent cwd)
   │  uses Gemini CLI's own tools (file edits / shell / search / MCP …)
   ▼
final answer → parent conversation
```

This plugin owns the Gemini-specific parts — **locating the executable**, **validating configuration**
and **detecting credentials at load time with actionable guidance**. Process lifecycle and the ACP
protocol are handled by DSH's official backend, so a DSH upgrade does not require rewriting the protocol here.

## Requirements

| Dependency | Version / notes |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1-rc.2` series (provides `ctx.subagents` and the ACP subagent backend) |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24` |
| Google Gemini CLI | a build that supports `--acp` (`0.60+`, latest recommended) |
| Gemini credential | Gemini Developer API key (recommended), or Vertex AI / Code Assist variables |

Install the CLI:

```bash
npm install -g @google/gemini-cli
gemini --version
```

## Install the plugin

**From the DSH plugin market (recommended):** search for `dsh-subagent-gemini`, install and enable it.

**From the command line:**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-subagent-gemini
```

Then add the package to that profile's `package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart (or let the
profile recompose):

```json
"dsh": {
  "profile": {
    "bundles": ["…", "dsh-subagent-gemini"]
  }
}
```

Once enabled, every agent sees the global tool `subagent_gemini` (a running session picks it up on its next request).

## Credentials (important)

Gemini CLI needs its own credential. **Google account browser login (OAuth) no longer works**: Google retired
the individual Gemini Code Assist OAuth client for Gemini CLI, and the CLI reports
*"This client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals"*.
Use an **API key** instead:

1. Create a key at <https://aistudio.google.com/apikey>;
2. Store it where Gemini CLI looks (no plugin config required):

```bash
printf 'GEMINI_API_KEY=your-key\n' > ~/.gemini/.env
chmod 600 ~/.gemini/.env
```

Gemini CLI loads `~/.gemini/.env` automatically. Environment variables also work:

- `GEMINI_API_KEY` — Gemini Developer API;
- `GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=true` + `GOOGLE_API_KEY` — Vertex AI;
- `GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_GCA=true` — Google Code Assist license.

To pass variables to the child explicitly, use the plugin's `env` config (see below). The plugin never reads,
logs or returns secret values.

## Usage

The model calls it like any other delegation tool:

```json
{
  "name": "subagent_gemini",
  "arguments": {
    "description": "Fix login timeout",
    "prompt": "In the workspace, find the login request timeout and raise it from 5s to 15s, run the related tests, and reply only with what you changed and the test result."
  }
}
```

- `description` — 3–5 word task name shown in the subagent list;
- `prompt` — a **self-contained** task; the child cannot see the parent conversation, so include paths, constraints and acceptance criteria.

When the run finishes the parent receives a completion notice with Gemini's final answer or a safe failure
diagnostic. The child's tool traffic and reasoning stay out of the parent session.

## Configuration

Override the `subagent-gemini` entry's `config` in a profile patch:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `providerName` | `gemini` | Name registered on `ctx.subagents`; must be unique in one profile |
| `command` | empty (auto-detect) | Path to the `gemini` executable; empty searches `PATH`, then `~/.local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, … |
| `args` | `['--acp', '--skip-trust']` | CLI arguments; `--acp` is always kept, `--skip-trust` is present by default |
| `model` | empty (CLI default) | Fixed model id such as `gemini-2.5-flash`; becomes one `--model` argument |
| `permission` | `allow` | Auto-answer for child permission requests: `allow` approves (edits/shell), `reject` declines (read-only) |
| `env` | `{}` | Extra environment variables layered over the credential-scrubbed parent environment |
| `disposeEofGraceMs` | `6000` | Time the child gets to flush after stdin EOF before escalation |
| `disposeGraceMs` | `3000` | Failure-observation and SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation grace |

Example — fixed model, read-only child:

```yaml
- id: subagent-gemini
  config:
    model: gemini-2.5-flash
    permission: reject
```

## Security and permissions

- `permission: allow` means **unattended**: the child may edit workspace files and run commands without a human
  approval prompt. That is what makes delegated coding tasks possible; use it in trusted workspaces and review
  `git diff` afterwards.
- `--skip-trust` trusts the parent workspace for the child session only, so a delegation never stalls on an
  interactive trust prompt.
- The child is a separate process with its own credential environment: DSH's subprocess seam scrubs credential-like
  variables from the parent environment; only variables in `env` are forwarded.
- No telemetry. No credential is read, logged or returned by this plugin; the key is managed by Gemini CLI itself.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| Delegation fails with a `process-start` diagnostic | `gemini` not found. `npm install -g @google/gemini-cli`, or set `command` to an absolute path |
| `Gemini API key is missing or not configured` | No credential. Write `~/.gemini/.env` as above (`chmod 600`) |
| `This client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals` | The retired OAuth login is in use. Switch to an API key |
| Child starts but never answers / times out | Check network reachability of the Gemini API; if it needs a proxy, put `HTTPS_PROXY` in the plugin's `env` |
| Want to check the machine setup | Run `npm run smoke` in the plugin checkout (costs one API request and prints PONG) |

## Compatibility and development

- Depends on the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp@0.2.1-rc.2`, so protocol work tracks the official backend;
- Unit tests: `npm test` (32 cases: config normalization, executable discovery, credential detection);
- End-to-end self-check: `npm run smoke` (requires an API key);
- Reference implementations: the official Codex subagent (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex`) and the official ACP
  backend (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp`); all three share the same `ctx.subagents` contract.

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile des

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-hud

> **English summary** — A session-status desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`).
> A small animated pet sits in the bottom-right corner; clicking it opens a bubble with three live
> counts: **running** sessions, **completed-but-unread** sessions, and sessions **waiting for your
> choice** (approval / plan review / question). Clicking a count jumps to that session; clicking the
> same row repeatedly cycles through the sessions in that group.
> Zero npm dependencies, no host-side behaviour: everything is one self-contained client bundle
> (`lib/client.js`, pet animations inlined as base64). Build with `node tools/build.mjs`.
> Third-party content and licensing: see [`NOTICE.md`](./NOTICE.md). MIT.

DSH 会话状态挂件：右下角一只安静的宠物角标，单击展开气泡，实时显示你要的三个数字 ——

```
🌊 3 个在跑
✅ 1 个没看          ← 后台跑完、你还没打开过的
⚠️ 2 个等你选 (1 确认 · 1 提问)   ← 需要你手动做选项选择的
```

单击任一数字行 → 直接跳进对应会话；同类多个会话时**连续单击依次轮换**（右下角会提示 `2/3，再点下一个`）。

---

## 一、数据从哪来（全部是 DSH 原生服务，事件驱动、零轮询）

| 数字 | 来源 | 判定 |
|---|---|---|
| **进行中** | `uiSession.sessionStatus` **＋** `sessions.list.projectionsBySession` | 会话自己 `running === true`，**或**它名下还有 running 的**直接**子代理（`runningChildCount > 0`） |
| **完成未读** | `uiSession.sessionStatus` | 会话自己的 `completionUnread === true`（**只**看主会话；子代理跑完不算） |
| **待你选择** | `uiSession.sessionStatus` | 会话自己的 `pendingInteraction !== undefined`，**或**它名下**直接**子代理的 `pendingInteraction`（v0.6.0，**与侧栏有意分叉**，见 §1.2） |

`sessionStatus.getSnapshot()` 返回 `Map<sessionId, { running, pendingInteraction, completionUnread }>`，
这是 DSH 0.2.0 的**统一会话状态面**（取代了旧的 pendingInteractions），实现在官方包
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session`（源码注释原文：*"Root source combining running,
pending-interaction, and completion-reminder facts"*）。

`pendingInteraction.kind` 的三分类（口径与 `dsh-activity-pane` 一致）：

| kind | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `approval` | 待确认授权 |
| `plan-review` | 待审查计划 |
| `question` | 待回答问题 |

其余服务：`sessions.list`（会话行，用于标题与排序）、`workspaces.list`（归档过滤）、
`uiWorkspace.openSession(id)`（跳转）。

**统计口径**：只算主会话 —— 排除 `origin === "subagent"`（子代理）、`blank`（空白会话）、
已归档会话。与官方侧栏及活动面板一致。

**「进行中」是聚合口径**（v0.4.0 修，之前只数主会话自己的 `running`，于是主智能体空闲、
子代理还在跑时侧栏转圈而桌宠报 0）。官方侧栏 `lib/.../Rows.js` 的表达式是：

```js
// runningChildCount(list, parentId, statuses)
list.projectionsBySession[parentId]?.values.subagentCatalog
  ?.reduce((n, child) => n + ((statuses.get(child.id)?.running ?? list.byId[child.id]?.running) === true ? 1 : 0), 0) ?? 0
// sessionStatuses(): node.running === true 或 runningSubagentCount > 0 → ongoing（转圈）
```

本插件用 `runningChildCount()`（`src/widget.js`）实现同一表达式，只数**直接**子级
（孙辈算在它自己的父会话上，而那个父会话不是侧栏的行 —— 与侧栏严格对齐）。
拿不到 `projectionsBySession` 或形状异常时返回 0，退化为原行为，不抛异常。

> `completionUnread` 的语义（v0.5.0 从 asar 逐行查清，官方实现）：
> ```js
> // 471629
> isMain(id) { return (this.sessions.list.getSnapshot().byId[id]?.retainedBy.mainView ?? 0) > 0 }
> // 718647  source:"mainView" 只在 uiWorkspace.openSession 里 retain
> const reference = this.sessions.retain(target, { source: "mainView" })
> // 471603-471609
> observeRunning(sessionId, running) {
>   const previous = this.running.get(sessionId)
>   const beforeBaseline = this.sessions.list.getSnapshot().phase === "pending"
>   this.running.set(sessionId, running)
>   if (running) this.completionUnread.delete(sessionId)
>   else if ((previous === true || previous === void 0 && beforeBaseline) && !this.isMain(sessionId)) this.completionUnread.add(sessionId)
>   this.publishStatus()
> }
> // 471620  reconcileStatus 只清除 isMain 的那一个
> for (const id of present) if (this.isMain(id)) this.completionUnread.delete(id)
> ```
> **`isMain` 不是「`origin === 'main'`」，而是「你当前打开的那一个会话」**（`mainView`
> 引用同一时刻只属于一个会话）。所以：
> - 你在会话 X 里，会话 Y 跑完 → **Y 置位** → 侧栏 Y 显示 `status.completed`「已完成」
>   （718135 / 719101，字典 721643），桌宠「完成未读」+1 ✅
> - 你正开着 Y、Y 跑完 → **不置位**（你已经在看了）
> - Y 重新跑起来 / 从列表消失 → 清除
>
> 这条曾被怀疑是「对主会话恒为 false 的死信号」，**已证伪**：它是有消费者的活信号。
> `tools/smoke.mjs` 有专门用例把它钉住（非主视图计数、主视图不计数）。
>
> ⚠️ **子代理的 `completionUnread` 谁都不显示**：子代理不是侧栏的行，
> `runningChildCount` 也只数 *running* 的子代理。所以「某个子代理跑完了」在官方 UI 里
> **没有任何信号**（侧栏状态字典 721633-721643 里没有这一项）。按用户裁决，桌宠**也不**
> 把它算进「完成未读」（规则②：只有**主代理**跑完才算），加了就违背裁决。
>
> 注意区分：子代理的 **pending**（在等你交互）**已经算了**（v0.6.0，规则③，见 §1.2）；
> 子代理的 **completion**（跑完了）**不算**（规则②）。

### 1.1 多状态组合矩阵（v0.5.0 穷举并钉住）

官方侧栏的状态词表就这 7 条（asar `721633-721643`）：
`status.running` 进行中 / `status.subagentsRunning` 子智能体运行中 / `status.idle` 空闲 /
`status.waitingApproval` 等待审批 / `status.planReview` 计划待审 / `status.waitingAnswer` 等待回答 /
`status.completed` 已完成 —— **没有「排队输入」之类的状态**（`QueueDock` 的 `queue.count` 属于对话区，418359）。

桌宠气泡是**三行独立计数**，不是 `if/else` 链，所以多状态共存时不丢信息。
唯一的 `if/else` 链是角标（只有一位数字），优先级与侧栏 `statuses[0]` 同序（719092-719108）。

| 组合 | 自身 running | 子代理 running | completionUnread | pendingInteraction | 进行中 | 完成未读 | 待选择 | 情绪 | 角标 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R | ✅ | — | — | — | 1 | 0 | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| S | — | ✅ | — | — | 1 | 0 | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| R+S | ✅ | ✅ | — | — | **1**（同一会话不重复计） | 0 | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| C | — | — | ✅ | — | 0 | 1 | 0 | celebrate | 1/done |
| P:approval | — | — | — | approval | 0 | 0 | 1 | waiting | 1/wait |
| **R+P:question** | ✅ | — | — | question | **1** | 0 | **1** | waiting | 1/wait |
| **S+P:plan-review** | — | ✅ | — | plan-review | **1** | 0 | **1** | waiting | 1/wait |
| **S+P(child 持有)**（v0.6.0） | — | ✅ | — | **子代理** question | **1** | 0 | **1** | waiting | 1/wait |
| **P(main)+P(child)**（v0.6.0） | — | ✅ | — | main approval **+** child question | 1 | 0 | **2** | waiting | 2/wait |
| S+C | — | ✅ | ✅ | — | 1 | **1** | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| P+C | — | — | ✅ | approval | 0 | 1 | 1 | waiting | 1/wait |
| R+P+C（官方不可能） | ✅ | — | ✅ | approval | 1 | 1 | 1 | waiting | 1/wait |
| P:unknown-kind | — | — | — | 未知 | 0 | 0 | 1 | waiting | 1/wait |
| 孙辈在跑 | — | 孙辈 | — | — | **0**（只数直接子级） | 0 | 0 | dozing | 0/— |
| 孙辈 pending（v0.6.0） | — | 孙辈 | — | 孙辈 question | **0**（只数直接子级） | 0 | **0** | dozing | 0/— |
| C(child 持有)（规则②） | — | — | **子代理** | — | 0 | **0**（子代理跑完不算） | 0 | dozing | 0/— |
| Q:排队输入 | ✅ | — | — | — | 1 | 0 | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| 混合 5 会话 | 3 个 | 1 个 | 1 个 | 2 个 | 3 | 1 | 2 | waiting | 2/wait |

### 1.2 规则③：子代理的待交互也算「等我选」（**有意与侧栏分叉**）

用户 2026-10-16 明确裁决：

> 我觉得桌宠显示的应该是，如果这个对话确实没进行完，**无论是主代理还是子代理，都应该挂着在跑**，
> 只有**主代理跑完了但我没点开**才会标明没看，**无论主代理或者子代理需要我交互选项卡来选择内容/一定需要我回复内容就算做等我选**

三条规则落地成：

| 数字 | 规则 | 与官方侧栏 |
|---|---|---|
| 进行中 | 主会话在跑 **OR** 直接子代理在跑 | **同口径**（`runningSubagentCount`） |
| 完成未读 | **只**看主会话自己的 `completionUnread`；子代理跑完**不算** | 同口径 |
| 待你选择 | 主会话自己的 pending **OR** 直接子代理的 pending | ⚠️ **有意分叉** |

**侧栏不显示子代理的 pending。** 依据是 `718128`：

```js
const pendingInteraction = visiblePendingKind(status?.pendingInteraction?.kind)  // 只看会话自己
```

而桌宠 v0.6.0 起把**直接子代理**的 pending 也算进来。分叉是**明示的取舍**，不是失手 ——
因为「子代理卡在问你问题」这件事，侧栏只会显示「N 个子智能体运行中」（`status.subagentsRunning`），
看不出它在等你。

**子代理的 pending 从哪读**（取证，全部 asar 行号）：

```js
// 336653  每个会话（含子代理会话）都有自己一个 scope，标签就是它的 session id
const { fiber, ctx } = createScope(this.rootCtx, id)      // ClientSessions.materializeScope(id)
// 336567  scopeOf 就是把那个标签读回来
scopeOf(ctx) { return scopeTagOf(ctx) }                    // import ... from "../scope.js"

// 386458  approval：登记在**请求方 agent 的会话**名下
const sessionId = ctx.sessions.scopeOf(owner)              // owner = $on 监听器的 scoped ctx
const pending = new PendingApproval(sessionId, {...})      // 386326 sessionId / 386353 kind="approval"

// 715845  question：同一模式
const sessionId = ctx.sessions.scopeOf(owner)
const card = cards.ensure(sessionId, request.questions, callId)   // 714228 PendingQuestion.sessionId
                                                                 // 714224 kind

// 471591-471596  公开 Map 按 interaction.sessionId 归档（**每个 sessionId 只留一个 pending**）
const precedence = domain.precedence(interaction)
if (previous === void 0 || precedence >= previous.precedence) next.set(interaction.sessionId, { interaction, precedence })

// 471631-471643  汇进同一张 uiSession.sessionStatus
const ids = new Set([
  ...Object.keys(this.sessions.list.getSnapshot().byId),   // ← 子代理行也在里面（336695-336741）
  ...this.running.keys(), ...this.pendingSnapshot.keys(), ...this.completionUnread
])
for (const id of ids) next.set(id, { running: ..., pendingInteraction: this.pendingSnapshot.get(id), completionUnread: ... })

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-balance-card

给 DeepSeek Harness 的一张**「余额与用量」浮层卡片**：图片按钮可拖动，**点一下从图片左侧滑出卡片、
再点一下缩回**（带点击回弹动画），显示官方账户余额（含赠金/充值拆分）与本地会话的 token 用量
（今日 / 近 7 天 / 本月）和人民币估算花费。

- 余额：先走官方 `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`（密钥由 DSH 的凭据服务**现读**）；
  API key 未配置或被拒时，**回退到 DSH 账号登录态**
  （`platform.deepseek.com/api/v0/users/get_user_summary`，令牌同样由凭据服务现读，
  请求头 `x-dsh-auth-token`），令牌永不落盘、永不出宿主。
- 用量：直接折 DSH 原生会话日志（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`），三段计价（缓存命中 / 未命中 / 输出），
  并按官方规则**逐条事件判定峰谷价**（北京时间工作日 9:00-12:00、14:00-18:00 为高峰，周末与法定节假日全天
  为空闲，空闲价是高峰价一半），**只统计当前工作区**。
- 形态：自己往 `document.body` 插一层浮层，**不进任何 slot** —— 官方 0.2.0 删过一个第三方插件在用的
  slot，这是实测教训。
- 卡片在图片**左侧**：图片与卡片都常驻，图片永远在最上层；开合是 `transform`/`opacity` 过渡，
  支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
- 客户端**不打包**：`exports["./client"]` 直接指向源文件，宿主原样伺服，改完刷新即可。
- 按钮图标是**位图**（黑塔戴巫师帽那张），经宿主白名单路由下发；取不到就退回内置 SVG。

> GitHub 仓库：<https://github.com/HerTa-st/dsh-balance-card>

## 按钮图标怎么换

按钮就是**角色本人的抠图**：没有圆形裁切、没有边框、没有底色，靠 alpha 站住，
显示尺寸 **192×236**（竖长，与抠图 239:268 同比，不拉伸；`button-size.json` 是唯一真相）。问号是保留的。

### 尺寸只有一个来源

**`button-size.json`**（仓库根）是唯一真相。三处需要知道尺寸 —— 客户端 CSS、出图脚本的像素、
验收脚本的断言 —— 靠"改的时候记得同步三处"必然有一天遗忘，所以：

```jsonc
// button-size.json
{ "width": 192, "height": 236 }
```

```powershell
# 改完尺寸跑一次：既重新出图，也会把数字写回客户端的标记区
& 'E:\node\node.exe' scripts\build-icon.mjs
```

`build-icon.mjs` 会按标记区（`// >>> BUTTON_SIZE_START` … `// <<< BUTTON_SIZE_END`）替换
`lib/client.js` 里的 `DOT_W`/`DOT_H`。**标记缺失就直接报错退出**，而不是"大致找个地方改" ——
静默改错地方会让 CSS 尺寸与图片像素不一致，表现为图被拉伸或模糊，极难查。

资产都在 `lib/assets/`：

| 文件 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `icon.png` / `icon@2x.png` | 实际下发的 192×236 / 384×472（`srcset` 自动选 2x） |
| `icon-source.jpg` | **原始素材存档**（296×279） |
| `character-cutout.png` | 抠图结果（紧贴包围盒裁切，带 alpha） |
| `character-full.png` | **未裁剪**的透明全图，用于核对取舍 |
| `character-*-preview-checker.png` / `-dark.png` | 棋盘格 / 深色底预览，用来确认透明与暗底可读性 |
| `icon-preview-*.png` | 显示尺寸放大 8×，肉眼确认小尺寸下认不认得出 |
| `icon-shot.png` | 验收时抓的实拍截图 |

### 从原图重做一遍

```powershell
$py = 'E:\deepseek Desktop\resources\runtime\primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe'
# 1) 抠图（保留主角 + 问号；丢掉左侧淡色残影与纸张杂点）
& $py scripts\extract-character.py lib\assets\icon-source.jpg lib\assets\character-cutout.png
# 2) 由抠图出按钮资产（按 button-size.json 的尺寸等比放进透明画布，并同步客户端尺寸）
& 'E:\node\node.exe' scripts\build-icon.mjs
# 3) 验收（解码 / 尺寸 / 2x / 不拉伸 / 抠图成立）
& 'E:\node\node.exe' scripts\verify-icon.mjs 'http://127.0.0.1:3210/?token=<token>'
```

**改尺寸只需改 `button-size.json` 一处**，然后重跑上面的第 2 步。

### 抠图的判定规则（是量出来的，不是拍的）

`scripts/list-components.py` 会把原图每个连通块的位置、均色、亮度列出来。实测：

| 块 | 面积 | 均色 | 判定依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 主角 | 35353 | `(135,121,141)` | 面积最大 |
| 问号弯钩 | 1080 | `(146,119,202)` | **紫调**（B−R=56）且离左边 > 40px |
| 问号下点 | 179 | `(144,124,191)` | 同上 |
| 问号第三小块 | 37 | 紫调 | 同上 —— **面积门槛必须 < 37**，否则问号缺一角 |
| 左侧淡色残影 | 7377 | `(201,193,198)` | 太靠左；且不是紫调（B−R=−3） |
| 顶部杂点 | 119–199 | `(210,210,210)` | 不是紫调 |

> 四个踩过的坑（都写进脚本注释了）：
> ① 「外圈全透明」这个判据是错的 —— 抠图紧贴包围盒裁，人物必然贴住右边/下边；
> ② 「四角 4×4 全透明」太敏感 —— 右下角恰好压到肩膀，一个像素就判失败；
>   正确判据是**整条边框里透明像素的比例**（实拍 69.7%，矩形白底图会是 0%）。
> ③ 截图里按钮周围的界面文字会被像素判定当成按钮的一部分 → 截图时把它停到**空白处**；
> ④ 靠心算坐标（pad / scale / ratio）取样，算错过三次 → 改成用**连通块自动定位**。

## 点开与缩回（交互与动画）

**形态**：图片按钮和余额卡片**都常驻**在同一个浮层 root 里，图片永远在最上层（`z-index:1`），卡片在它下面（`0`）。
点一下图片，卡片从图片**左侧**滑出；再点一下图片（或卡片右上角的 ✕），卡片缩回图片背后。

**点击动画**：图片按下时 `:active` 立刻缩到 `.96`（即时反馈），松手再跑一次 420ms 的 keyframe
（`.93 → 1.045 → 1`，带回弹）。keyframe 由 `data-tap` 触发、460ms 后复位，所以连点也能再触发。

**开合动画**：只碰 `transform` / `opacity`（不触发布局）。收起态 `translateX(60%) scale(.95)` + `opacity:0`，
展开态归位；展开 280ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.06)`（轻微过冲），收起 160ms。
`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` 下过渡与回弹都关掉，直接到位。

**落位**：卡片右边缘 = 图片**可见**左边缘 − 8px，垂直中心与图片中心对齐；视口四周留 8px。
卡片（276px 高）比图片（236px）高，靠近视口底部时「居中」会被 8px 边距顶住 —— 这时贴边更优先，
中心会差几像素（实测 3.8px）。视口窄到左边放不下时，卡片会被夹进视口并压到图片上 ——
图片层级更高、仍然可点，所以「缩回」不会失效。

**为什么坐标写在卡片自己身上**：root 的定位只表示「图片在哪」（`localStorage` 里的 `x/y` 就是图片框左上角），
卡片是 root 的绝对定位子元素、用相对 root 的负 `left`。拖动图片时卡片自动跟随，只需要在拖动/尺寸变化时重算夹取，
不需要维护第二套坐标，也不会出现「刷新一下卡片被拽回原处」。

**给验收脚本的诊断属性**：`data-open`（root 上，唯一的展开真相）、`data-dot-box`（图片 viewport 矩形
`left,top,w,h`）、`data-place-info`（`paintedLeft=… card=WxH left=… top=… gap=8`）。
旧版的 `data-align`（`above-button` / `below-button`）随「卡片在按钮上方」的落位一起删了。

## 为什么这么做（每条都有理由，不是随手定的）

| 决定 | 理由 |
|---|---|
| 余额走官方 `/user/balance`（主）| `total_balance / granted_balance / topped_up_balance` 一次给全，且与浏览器登录态无关。DSH 自己那条账号链不是唯一来源。 |
| 余额回退到 DSH 账号链 | 桌面版默认用 `deepseek-account` 账号登录，很多环境里 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 没配或已失效（实测：DSH 里存的那把 key 被官方 401）。DSH 账号链在 0.2.1 里返回 `normal_wallets`（充值）与 `bonus_wallets`（赠金），**同样能拼出拆分**（`total = 充值 + 赠金`），所以 API key 不可用时没有理由让卡片空着。令牌取自凭据服务记录 `deepseek-account-platform/default`，只读不删 —— 卡片不会因为一次查询把用户登出。 |
| 用量走原始会话日志 | 官方给第三方插件的 `ctx.sessionQuery` / `sessionProjections` 只有**会话累计**，没有按天、没有按模型分桶。要「今日 / 近 7 天 / 本月」+ 按 provider 拆分，只能自己折叠。 |
| **逐帧**解压 zstd | 会话文件是**拼接的 zstd 帧**（每追加一次一个帧）。整文件一次 `zstdDecompressSync` 只解出第一帧（约 202 字节的会话头），静默丢掉几 MB 事件。 |
| 三段分开计价 | 实测缓存命中 1.82B、未命中 12.5M。`deepseek-flash` 命中价只有未命中的 1/50，不分段会把花费估到 5 倍以上。 |
| 只读当前工作区 | 本机有两个工作区（`HerTa` 与它的上级目录），混算会分不清「这个项目花了多少」。会话目录名是 cwd 的不可逆编码，用来精确比对。 |
| 增量缓存（mtime+size，只解新增帧） | 全量重算一次实测 **约 2.5 秒**（70 文件 / 45 MB / 34,350 帧 / 63,689 行）。剖析显示瓶颈**全在 CPU**：zstd 解压 59%、JSON 解析 34%、读盘只有 1.6%（帧平均 1.3 KB，小帧固定开销叠加）。同步跑会卡住宿主事件循环。 |
| 已解析事件**落盘缓存** | 进程重启后第一次打开也要快。缓存的是**原始事实**（不是派生结果），键带 `size + mtimeMs + 已消费字节`，文件一变只重解新增部分 → **不可能陈旧**。实测 2571 ms → 23 ms（约 110×）。`cachePath` 设 `-` 可关闭。 |
| 不进 slot | 官方 slot 都是固定座位，做不了「随意拖动」；且 0.2.0 真的删过 slot。 |
| 不打包客户端 | 没有构建步骤，改完刷新页面就生效；文件由 `exports["./client"]` 原样伺服。 |
| 失败不写缓存 | 一次断网不该把「半死」状态锁住 5 分钟。 |
| 峰谷价按官方规则**逐条事件**折算 | 不是按「现在」判峰谷：每条事件用**自己的时间戳**判（固定 UTC+8，与机器时区无关），否则今日 / 近 7 天 / 本月会随查看时刻漂移。官方规则逐字：「北京时间周一至周五（不含中国法定节假日）9:00 - 12:00、14:00 - 18:00 为高峰时段；其余时段，包括周末及中国法定节假日全天均为空闲时段」「空闲时段价格为高峰时段价格的一半」。窗口左闭右开（12:00 整算空闲）；峰谷定价 2026-08-16 16:00 UTC 才生效，**更早的事件按空闲价**（等于旧版平铺价，历史口径不变）。节假日表收录 2026 年 33 天，来源国办发明电〔2025〕7 号。 |
| 无单价就不算钱 | 小米 token 套餐 / bailian 的 qwen 系列没有公开单价，`estimateCost` 返回 `null` 而不是 0 —— 0 会被误读成「免费」。 |
| 按钮用角色抠图（位图），不用自绘轮廓 | 用户要的是原画里的角色。宿主侧白名单只放两条 `icon.png` / `icon@2x.png`，**写死文件名**，所以不存在路径穿越，不需要写 `../` 过滤。取不到图时客户端退回内置 SVG，按钮不会变空白。 |
| 抠图**保留问号**、丢掉淡色残影 | 问号是画面的一部分（用户明确要）；残影是原画的水印式重复人物。判据用「紫调 + 离左边 > 40px」（实测问号 B−R=56、残影 B−R=−3，分得很干净），不是靠眼睛挑。 |
| 展开后卡片落在**图片左侧** | 用户要的落位：点图片后卡片从图片左侧弹出、再点缩回。卡片右边缘对图片**可见**左边缘（`object-fit: contain` 的实画区，192×236 的框里实画 192×215）留 8px 缝，垂直居中。 |
| 图片和卡片**都常驻** DOM | 旧版展开时把图片换成卡片，于是「再点一次图片缩回」无处可点；而且卡片要从图片背后滑出，就必须让图片压在它上面。现在图片 `z-index:1`、卡片 `0`：图片既不会被盖住，点它也永远命中它。 |
| 点击动画用 CSS keyframe | 按下 `:active` 缩到 `.96` 给即时反馈，松手跑一次 420ms 回弹。用 `data-tap` 触发、定时器复位 —— 不靠 JS 逐帧算 transform，掉帧也还是合成器的事。 |
| 开合动画只碰 `transform`/`opacity` | 不触发布局、不重排卡片内容。收起态只是 `visibility:hidden` + `pointer-events:none` + `inert`，**DOM 不卸载**：动画可以反向、数据不丢、再点开立刻有内容。 |
| 卡片坐标用**相对 root 的负 left** | root 的定位就是图片位置（也是拖动持久化的 `x/y`），卡片跟着 root 走 ⇒ 拖动时自动跟随、刷新不会被「拽回自动位置」。视口夹取在 `onMove` 里每帧重算。 |
| 视口窄时允许卡片压住图片 | 卡片比图片宽（320 > 192），图片贴着屏幕左边时左侧放不下。夹到视口 8px 内、宁可重叠：图片层级更高仍可点，缩回不会失效。 |
| 落位量 **root**、不量按钮 | 点开那一瞬间按钮正在跑点击回弹 keyframe（scale .93→1.045），量它得到的是**缩放后**的框 —— 实测据此落位卡片整体偏高 9～12px，而且动画结束后不会自动纠正。root 不参与动画，`offsetWidth/Height` 就是未缩放的外框。 |
| 窗口缩小后把按钮夹回视口 | 拖动坐标在窗口变小 / 换分辨率后可能落在视口外，按钮就再也点不到了（实测 1400×1500 拖到 x=1188，缩到 400×700 后整块出屏、`elementFromPoint` 返回 null）。所以 resize 时**先**夹 root 并写回 `x/y`，**再**重算卡片。 |
| 「等数据到位再落位」已删 | 新落位只依赖图片位置与卡片尺寸，与数字无关；卡片变高由 `ResizeObserver` 重算。 |
| 「记住收起态矩形」已删 | 图片常驻、随时能量，`lastDotRectRef`/尺寸校验那一套补丁都不需要了；`data-dot-box` 留作诊断。 |

# B) 或者克隆源码后从本地路径装（本仓库用 herta-lab 验证过）
