plugins.description: Account balance, session spend and turn estimate pill for the DeepSeek Harness composer dock
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-account-balance

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的会话输入框下面加一条余额统计：
**余额 · 会话消耗 · 本轮估算**，点一下展开明细面板。

![统计行](docs/dock.png)

![明细面板](docs/panel.png)

> 截图是示意图，数字为虚构值。

## 功能

- **余额**：`ctx.remote.account.getBalance`，与「设置 → 账号与余额」同一个 Host 接口，金额为充值余额 + 赠金余额的合计。
- **会话**：这个会话累计消耗，按「余额相对打开本会话时的减少量」计算；基线按 sessionId 存在 `localStorage`，切换会话、刷新窗口都不串不清零，充值会把基线抬高，不会出现负数。
- **本轮**：本轮 token ÷ 全会话 token × 会话消耗。Host 没有逐轮账单，这一项是分摊估算；分母用全日志的 `tokenUsage` 投影，翻页和压缩都不会让比例跑偏。
- **低余额变红**：低于 5（`LOW_BALANCE_CENTS = 500`，按各币种最小单位，即 ¥5 / $5）时「余额」那一段变红，用的是 DSH 自己的 `--dsw-alias-state-error-primary`。
- **点击面板**：真 `<button>` + portal，Escape / 点面板外 / 再点一次关闭；面板里能刷新，并跳到「查询用量 / 去充值」（链接与设置页同源）。
- 未登录、接口失败或没有钱包时整条隐藏，不留空占位。

## 安装

### 方式一：插件页

1. 下载 `dsh-plugin-account-balance-1.0.0.tgz`（或直接 `git clone` 本仓库）。
2. DSH → 侧栏 **插件** → **添加插件** → 选这个包 / 本地目录。
3. 安装完成后点 **立即启用**，刷新一次窗口。

### 方式二：命令行

```bash
node install.mjs                   # 装到 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
node install.mjs --profile web     # 装到指定 profile
node install.mjs --uninstall       # 卸载
```

脚本会把包复制进 profile 的 `node_modules`，把包名写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，
并清掉早期手工安装留在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的那一行（避免同一入口装两次）。

> 两种方式不要叠加：包已经在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里后，就不要再往 `cordis.patch.yml` 加 `ui-account-balance` 行。

## 配置

| 想改什么 | 改哪里 |
| --- | --- |
| 变红的阈值 | `lib/client.js` 的 `LOW_BALANCE_CENTS`（500 = ¥5） |
| 刷新频率 | `lib/client.js` 的 `REFRESH_MS`（默认 60000） |
| 文案 | `lib/client.js` 里的 `t("中文", "English")` |
| 上报的客户端版本 | `lib/client.js` 的 `CLIENT_VERSION` |

改完跑一次 `node install.mjs`，再刷新窗口（profile 配置会热加载，但浏览器 bundle 不会自己热更）。
不想刷新可以在插件页把这一项关掉再打开，让条目重新挂载。

## 开发

```bash
node test/client.test.mjs     # 11 项单测：注册、渲染、面板、金额格式化、低余额、未登录降级
```

结构：

| 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | `dsh.bundle.patch`（bundle 层）+ `dsh.client`（web 客户端半侧） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 层插入 `ui-account-balance` 行 |
| `lib/index.js` | Host 半侧，无行为 |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器 bundle：注册 `conversation.composer.dock` 条目、读余额、算会话/本轮、渲染面板 |
| `test/client.test.mjs` | 用 Node 跑的最小渲染测试 |
| `install.mjs` | 命令行安装/卸载 |

## 兼容性

在 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`（桌面版）上验证。插件依赖 `remote.account` 服务，只对 DeepSeek 账号模式生效。
包里硬编码了 `CLIENT_VERSION`；如果 DSH 大版本变化后连「设置 → 账号与余额」都打不开，把它改成对应版本再试。

## Known limitations

- 「会话」是余额差，不是账单：同一时间跑的其它会话、后台任务、子智能体的消耗也算在当前这条里。
- 「本轮」按 token 占比分摊：cache 命中、未缓存输入、输出单价不同，均摊会抹平差异，适合看量级不适合对账。
- 打开旧会话时基线从此刻起算，历史消耗不追溯。

## License

MIT

--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## Install & uninstall - **git channel** (latest `main`): `dsh plugin --profile web add github:PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules` — the `prepare` script builds with production dependencies only. - **npm channel** (published releases): `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-permission-rules`. - **tarball channel**: `pnpm pack` in this repo, then `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-permission-rules-.tgz`. - **uninstall**: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-permission-rules`. ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（95 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 95 plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Workflow diagram for dsh-permission-rules: request → policy / review → verdict.](docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-flow.svg) *Workflow overview: request → policy / review → verdict. The examples below use the real command surface.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any ne

plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.

# dsh-markboard · conversation marks for DSH

[中文](./README.zh.md) | English

A **conversation markboard** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web UI: turn any conversation turn into a named task card, jump straight back to it later, or quote its answer into the composer and keep working. Marks live in your browser.

> Stop scrolling through history to find "that conclusion from earlier". Mark it once, then pick from a handful of rows.

## Screenshots

| Mark action on each turn + header count | The markboard in the right Sidebar |
|---|---|
| ![marked](docs/e2e/02-marked.png) | ![panel](docs/e2e/03-panel.png) |

| Fill the composer from a card | Jump back to the turn |
|---|---|
| ![filled](docs/e2e/04-filled.png) | ![jump](docs/e2e/05-jump.png) |

## Features

- **Mark a whole turn** — a Mark action under every completed answer records the turn (your prompt plus this turn's answer) and names it from the prompt's first sentence. Click again to remove it.
- **Header count** — the Session header shows how many turns are marked; click it to open the board.
- **Right-Sidebar page** — its own tab beside Files and Browser, with "this session" / "all sessions" scopes and search over labels, content, and turn numbers.
- **Rename and delete** — click a card's title to rename it; deletion comes with an undo.
- **Jump back** — opens the owning session and scrolls the turn into view. When that turn is outside the loaded window, history is paged in first through the kernel's exact `loadThrough(seq)`, and the landing row flashes once.
- **Fill the composer** — writes the turn's answer into the current draft as a plain-text quote (`> 标记 · session · turn N`) that you can keep editing or delete; the previous draft is restorable.
- **Cross-tab sync** — another tab of the same origin writing marks updates this one.
- **Bilingual** copy that follows the interface language.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-markboard
```

Then restart `dsh web`. The plugin adds itself to the profile's bundle layer; nothing else to configure.

From a local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-markboard
```

## Usage

1. Find the turn you want to keep and click **Mark** in the action row under the answer.
2. The header shows a count; click it (or press `Ctrl+Alt+M`) to open the markboard.
3. Each card offers **Jump** (back to the turn), **Fill composer** (quote the answer into the draft), and **Delete** (undoable).
4. Click a card's title to rename it — the label is your task name.

## Shortcut

`Ctrl+Alt+M` (`⌘+Alt+M` on macOS) toggles the board. The binding is editable under Settings → Shortcuts.

## How it works

Two halves, like any DSH surface plugin:

- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`): an empty `apply`. It only makes the package an ordinary Loader entry, which is what lets `client-modules` discover the `dsh.client` declaration in `package.json` and compose the browser half into `window.__DSH_BOOT__`.
- **Browser half** (`src/client`, built to `lib/client.js`): registers three existing extension seats plus a `ctx.markboard` service.

| Place | Seat | What it adds |
|---|---|---|
| Turn action row | `conversation.chat.turnTail` | the Mark / Marked button |
| Session header | `conversation.session.header.utilities` | the mark count entry |
| Right Sidebar | `ctx.sidebarRightTabs` + `sidebar.right.pane.tab` | the markboard page |
| Notices | `shell.overlay` | mark / fill / delete toasts with undo |

The data model is pure functions (`src/shared/marks.ts`); `sessionId + turn` is the identity, so marking the same turn twice edits that card instead of adding a second one. Marks persist in `localStorage['dsh-markboard.v1']`. A failed write (quota, private mode) only reports — it never throws, and the in-memory list keeps working.

**Why not Host storage**: a personal board does not need cross-device sync, and the cost of localStorage is only that a different browser or origin starts empty — which the panel says out loud.

**Why the fill is plain text**: `insertText` / `setDraft` are the kernel's public action face. A rich quote chip would need kernel support for reference fragments — a different order of change that would also drift across kernel upgrades.

## Development

```sh
npm install     # esbuild, build-time only
npm run build   # src/client → lib/client.js (wrapped as window.__ModuleLoader__.load)
npm test        # data model and persistence rules (Node's own test runner)
```

End-to-end (**opens a real browser window** so you can watch the flow):

```sh
# 1. boot a disposable DSH home so your own sessions stay untouched
DSH_HOME=/path/to/disposable/home dsh --profile e2e --port 3099 --no-open

# 2. in another shell, hand the printed token URL to the script
node tests/e2e-headed.mjs --url "http://127.0.0.1:3099/?token=…" --slow 700
```

The script walks through: open a session → mark → open the panel → rename → fill the composer → jump back → reload → search → delete and undo, writing one screenshot per stage to `docs/e2e/`. Add `--headless` for CI.

## Known limitations

- **Turns only.** No per-message or text-selection marks; a per-sentence grain makes the card list unreadable fast.
- **Local to this browser.** No cross-browser or cross-origin sharing, and no export.
- **Jumping depends on the turn's row existing**: a turn outside the loaded window triggers one exact history page-in first; if that fails the UI says so instead of failing silently.
- **The fill is a plain-text quote** and does not carry the original message's attachments or images.
- **The page is bound to a Session**: it follows session switches, and "all sessions" is a view inside the same page.
- **`Ctrl+Alt+M` only.** The shell's shortcut registry rejects a Web default that lacks the platform primary on Linux, so the Linux Web profile stays unbound rather than registering a rejected key.

# dsh-life-decision-guide

把 [eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter](https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter) 的 `skills/life-decision-guide` 移植成 DeepSeek Harness 插件：注册一个同名 Skill + 三个查询工具，让模型**先查书再回答**，每条注明第几节第几条，查不到就说书里没写。

全书 765 条正文随包内置，装好即用，不需要联网、不需要 clone。

## 组成

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `skill/SKILL.md` | 指令层：安全分流 + 检索步骤 + 写作纪律 + 边界 |
| `lib/corpus.js` | 语料加载、解析、检索、性价比档计算（纯 ESM，零依赖） |
| `index.js` | 插件入口，注册 skill 与三个工具 |
| `vendor/HowToLiveBetter/` | 语料快照（book 34 节 + README + 版本记录 + 许可） |
| `tools/check.mjs` | 快照完整性校验（765 条 + 证据/性价比分布） |

工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `life_guide_toc` | 34 节目录（节号 / 节名 / 问题 / 条数） |
| `life_guide_find` | 关键词 + 可选节号检索，返回紧凑命中（含性价比档） |
| `life_guide_read` | 按 id 取整条原文（含备注、来源），数字照抄用 |

## 安装

**npm（推荐）**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-life-decision-guide
```

**GitHub 直装**（npm 不可用时的备选）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:MonkeyGarry/dsh-life-decision-guide
```

或在 DSH 的 **Settings → Plugin Market** 里搜 `dsh-life-decision-guide`。

**本地开发**

让 Agent 用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`target` 传本目录绝对路径（本地目录会以链接方式安装，改代码立即生效）。

装好后新会话的 skill 编目会出现 `life-decision-guide`，也可用 `/life-decision-guide` 显式触发。

## 语料

发布包已内置 `vendor/HowToLiveBetter`，普通用户不需要做任何事。

维护者更新快照（注意：快照目录已**不含 `.git`**，不能 `git pull`）：

```bash
# 1) 克隆到临时目录
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter.git "$tmp/hltb"

# 2) 只覆盖运行时需要的文件
cp "$tmp"/hltb/book/*.md vendor/HowToLiveBetter/book/
cp "$tmp"/hltb/README.md vendor/HowToLiveBetter/

# 3) 更新版本记录（短 sha · 日期）
git -C "$tmp/hltb" rev-parse --short HEAD
printf '%s · %s\n' "<短sha>" "$(date +%F)" > vendor/HowToLiveBetter/VERSION

# 4) 校验
node tools/check.mjs
```

期望输出 `校验通过：34 节 / 765 条，证据与性价比分布吻合。` 分布不符说明正文变了，先核对再发版。

PowerShell 版对应命令：

```powershell
$tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP "hltb"
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter.git $tmp
Copy-Item "$tmp\book\*" vendor\HowToLiveBetter\book\ -Force
Copy-Item "$tmp\README.md" vendor\HowToLiveBetter\ -Force
git -C $tmp rev-parse --short HEAD
```

## 发布与维护

### npm 发布

本项目**默认源是国内镜像（npmmirror，只读）**，发布必须显式指向官方源：

```bash
npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
```

账号开了 2FA 时，二选一：

- 验证器 App（TOTP）：`npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --otp=六位码`
- passkey / 安全密钥：命令行给不了码，改用 **Granular Access Token**，在 npm 网页上勾选 *Allow this token to bypass 2FA*，然后写进 `~/.npmrc`：
  ```
  //registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=npm_你的token
  ```
  首包发布时 token 的包范围要选 **All packages**（包还不存在，选不到具体包）。

### 审核与占位版本

新账号首发可能进入 staged review：registry 上先出现 `0.0.0-stage` 占位版本（345 字节空壳），真实版本待审。查状态：

```bash
npm view dsh-life-decision-guide versions
npm view dsh-life-decision-guide dist-tags
```

`0.1.0` 出现在 `versions`、`latest` 变成 `0.1.0` 即通过。期间**不要重复发同一版本**，审核通过前也别装 npm 版（会装到空壳）。

> 本包 `0.1.0` 已通过审核上线：fileCount 50、unpackedSize 2.58 MB，`vendor/` 语料在包内。

### 发新版本

```bash
# 1) 改 package.json 的 version（如 0.1.1）
# 2) 更新快照（见上一节）并跑 tools/check.mjs
# 3) 提交
git add -A && git commit -m "chore: refresh corpus to <sha>" && git push
# 4) 发布
npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
```

### 提交到插件市场

市场读的是 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 的注册表，PR 加一条：

```yaml
- name: dsh-life-decision-guide
  owner: MonkeyGarry
  url: https://github.com/MonkeyGarry/dsh-life-decision-guide
  category: skill
  description:
    en: Answers real-life decisions from the 高性价比人生指南 book: looks up entries first, ranks by cost and benefit, cites section and item.
    zh: 按《高性价比人生指南》正文回答人生决策：先查条目、按成本与收益排序，每条注明第几节第几条。
  npm: dsh-life-decision-guide
  install: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-life-decision-guide
```

### 关于 engines.dsh

未声明 `engines.dsh`：DSH 当前版本号带预发布标签（如 `0.2.1-rc.2`），semver 范围容易误判，而 `engines.dsh` 不满足会**直接阻断安装**，所以首版不写。插件在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上验证通过。

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（95 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 95 plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goes

plugins.description: DSH 右侧栏可编辑画布 + AI 绘图工具的增强 fork：新增 vtracer 高质量矢量化引擎（贝塞尔样条 / 每通道位深 / 一半核心并行）
plugins.readme_text:
<!-- 待补：社交预览图。放好 docs/social-preview.png（1280×640）后，把下面这行的注释去掉即可。
![Social preview](docs/social-preview.png)
-->

# dsh-drawai-vectorizer-hq

> **这是 [fourzkw/dsh-drawai](https://github.com/fourzkw/dsh-drawai) 的增强 fork（v0.4.0，基于上游 0.3.2）。**
> 保留上游全部功能，新增 **vtracer 高质量矢量化引擎**。上游版权与 MIT 许可完整保留。
> 变更详情见 [FORK-CHANGES.md](FORK-CHANGES.md)。

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-brightgreen)](package.json)

## 本 fork 新增了什么

上游的矢量化走「调色板量化 + k-means → 连通域 → marching squares → Douglas-Peucker **折线**」，
没有曲线拟合，工作分辨率上限 499px（图片 887px）。本 fork 增加一条 **vtracer** 路线：
分层颜色聚类 + **三次贝塞尔样条** + 每通道位深控制，在原生分辨率上工作。

### 双引擎（UI 可选）

视频「绘制复刻」与单图「绘制」面板都新增 **「矢量化引擎」** 下拉：

| 引擎 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `plugin`（默认） | 上游自研描边，快、体积小，适合视频全片 |
| `vtracer` | 高质量，适合单图；可选保真档位 |

### 三档保真度（实测，同一 1920×1080 帧，渲染到 1920）

| 档位 | 关键参数 | SVG 体积 | 绘制步骤 | 耗时 | PSNR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fast` | cp6 fs2 ld8 spline | 1.6 MB | 4,060 | 1.4s | ~18 dB |
| **`hifi`**（默认） | cp8 fs0 ld8 spline | 9.9 MB | 35,069 | 2.8s | **~38 dB** |
| `pixel` | cp8 fs0 ld1 none | 15.9 MB | 173,479 | 3.7s | **~46 dB** |

对照：上游 `plugin` 引擎同帧约 18 KB / 584 步 / **~26 dB**。

> 参数含义：`cp`=`colorPrecision`（每通道位深）、`fs`=`filterSpeckle`、`ld`=`layerDifference`、
> `mode`=`PathSimplifyMode`。**`colorPrecision` 6→8 是画质主因**（实测 18→34.6 dB）。

### 并行度：一半核心

原策略 `min(4, 逻辑核-1)`（16 核机器只用 4）。本 fork 改为 **`floor(逻辑核/2)`**
（16 核 → **8**），叠加内存收敛（每 worker 512MB 预算，上限 32）。

### `traceImage` 也支持引擎

```json
{ "op": "traceImage", "image": "ref.png", "removeBg": false,
  "engine": "vtracer", "vtraceLevel": "pixel" }
```

可选覆盖：`colorPrecision`(4-8) / `filterSpeckle`(0-16) / `layerDifference`(1-64) /
`maxLayers`(8-256，默认 48) / `mode`(spline|polygon|none)。

### 绘制过程展示与原版一致

vtracer 后端完整对齐上游的 `drawing` 契约（`{viewBox, fills, steps[]}`，`steps` 按面积降序），
客户端渐进绘制回放**一行未改** —— 观感仍是「大色块 → 细节 + 进度条 + 自动回放」。

### ⚠️ 什么时候不要用 vtracer

| 场景 | 建议 |
| --- | --- |
| 视频全片 | **用 `plugin`**。vtracer 体积是数百倍（实测 2209 帧约 80 亿字符） |
| 单图 / 短视频片段 | ✅ 推荐 |
| 源分辨率 < 800px | vtracer 位深优势发挥不出来，`plugin` 够用 |

## 安装

```powershell
npm install
npm run build     # src/ → lib/
npm test          # 25 项自测
```

装进 DSH profile：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本仓库路径或 tgz>
```

> 装完需要**重启 DSH 主进程**才生效（实测热重载最坏延迟约 1 小时）。

---

# 以下为上游 README 原文

## 功能一览

`dsh-drawai-vectorizer` 把可编辑画布放进 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏，并给模型两个改图工具；人和 AI 读写的是同一份原生 `.drawio`。

1. **右侧栏可编辑画布** —— 打开 / 新建工作区 `.drawio`：画节点、连边、就地改字、分层、排序、对齐、导出；双击即可改标签。
2. **自然语言改图** —— 对话里说需求，模型用 `diagram_read` / `diagram_apply` 读现状、结构化改图、自动布局并原子写回。
3. **选区感知与回退** —— 你在画布上选中什么，模型就知道什么；模型改动最多可退 8 步。
4. **SVG 图形节点** —— 图标 / logo 可直接当节点内容，拼流程图与示意图。
5. **位图矢量化（`traceImage`）** —— 照着工作区图片逐像素描成 SVG 节点，不是凭印象手写近似图。
6. **原生 `.drawio` 载体** —— 无需导入导出；画布读不懂的单元逐字节保留，文件可直接用 drawio / diagrams.net 继续编辑。
7. **视频复刻** —— 选中已导入视频，点击悬浮工具条「绘制复刻」自主设置画质、帧率、完整视频或起止范围，自动抽帧并绘制成 SVG 视频；显示预计帧数、实际进度与帧预览，支持取消，原视频保留。支持 SVG 帧序列包，以及保留原帧率、白底和片段音频的 MP4 / WebM 离线导出；也可导出白底、循环播放的无声 GIF。渲染、编码和保存由宿主后台执行，切换标签或刷新网页后仍继续，完成文件自动保存到画布旁（编码需 FFmpeg）。详见[视频节点说明](docs/video-nodes.md)。

![整体界面：右侧栏画布与多标签](docs/picture/整体界面图.png)

![从对话到改图的逻辑流程](docs/picture/drawai逻辑图.png)

![用 SVG 节点拼的流程图与图标](docs/picture/图标绘制.png)

![位图矢量化复刻对比](docs/picture/大肥鱼复刻图.png)

## 安装 / Install

```sh
# 从 npm 安装（推荐：预构建，跳过 allowBuilds 构建授权）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-drawai-vectorizer

# 或者直接从 GitHub 装（仓库里没有 prepare 脚本，同样不需要构建）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:fourzkw/dsh-drawai
```

然后**重启 `dsh web`** —— 宿主侧只在启动时加载，这一步不能省。

> **更新到最新版**：`dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-drawai-vectorizer@latest`

重启之后，你会看到：

| 装好后的变化 | 出现在哪里 |
|---|---|
| 「DrawAI 画布」面板，负责打开 `**/*.drawio` | 右侧栏 |
| `diagram_read` / `diagram_apply` | 模型工具集 |
| `drawai-canvas` 技能 | 会话技能目录（模型按需取全文） |

- 两种装法都不需要 `allowBuilds` 构建授权：npm 包是预构建的；GitHub 源码包里 `lib/` 也已提交、没有 `prepare` / `postinstall` 脚本。
- 手动挂载的兜底写法，以及本地 link 的开发做法，见[设计文档的「安装」一节](docs/design.md#安装)。

## 使用 / Usage

一块画布、两个工具、一份文件：人改的、模型改的、drawio 改的，最后都落在同一个 `.drawio` 上。

| 入口 | 你能得到什么 |
|---|---|
| **右侧栏画布** | 打开或新建画布、画节点与连线、就地改字、图层、分区、顺序、多选对齐、查找、微移、多页切换、复制粘贴、导出 SVG / PNG / 透明 PNG（4×，含导出选中） |
| **`diagram_apply`** | 让模型按 ops 改图：增删改、重接边、复制、排序、分层、导出；支持 `ids` 批量、`as` 别名、`expectRevision` |
| **`diagram_read`** | 让模型看见图的结构与样式、图层与父级、页面尺寸、你此刻的选区、文件指纹 `revision` |
| **选中与回退** | 你选中什么模型就知道什么；模型的每一轮改动都能在界面上退回去 |

## 🗂️ 画布面板 / The canvas panel

刚打开面板时它是**空的**（不会替你预开一张图）：用 `文件 → 新建画布…` 或 `文件 → 打开…`（列出工作区里所有 `.drawio`）开始。

| 功能 | 它解决什么问题 |
|---|---|
| **画布外观** | 矩形 / 圆角 / 椭圆 / 菱形 / 圆柱 / 文档 / **SVG 图形** / **位图** 等形状族（右侧元素条按族放置）、8 色调色板、白纸 + 网格、正交折线 + 障碍避让、明暗切换 |
| **SVG 图形节点** | 节点内容直接是一段 **SVG 标记**（图标 / logo / 示意图这种形状词汇表里没有的东西）：右键「SVG 内容…」贴进去即可，或让模型用 `addNode {shape:"svg", svg:"<svg viewBox…>…</svg>"}`。落盘是 drawio **原生**的图片形状（`shape=image` + `image=data:image/svg+xml,<百分号编码>`），所以 drawio 桌面版打开同样画得出来；标记只喂给 `<image>`（独立文档，脚本不执行、也不碰页面 DOM） |
| **内嵌位图** | 从剪贴板粘贴或拖入 PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP，画布会**真的画出来**（同为 `shape=image` + data URI）。`diagram_read` 把 base64 省略成 `«image N 字符»`，不撑爆上下文 |
| **位图矢量化 traceImage** | 让模型照着工作区里一张图**逐像素**描成 SVG 内容节点（读像素 → 按必填的 `removeBg` 决定是否泛洪抠底 → k-means 调色板 → 3× 超采样归类 → 按颜色取像素级闭合轮廓 → 每色一条 nonzero path）。形状词汇表表达不了的照片 / 插画走这条，而不是让模型手写一段近似 SVG 冒充复刻 |
| **文本** | 双击节点就地改字。「T 文字」是独立的文字节点；支持字号与字色。图片和视频节点不显示文字 |
| **连线** | 四选一画法（直线 / 直角折线 / 圆角折线 / 曲线）× 线型（含虚线间距）× 箭头（单向 / 双向 / 无 / 反向）× 颜色 × 引出段长度；自环；悬空端（从节点脱开后成为自由端点，还能再拖回去） |
| **连线上的文字** | 双击改、按住拖（半格 + 贴线吸附）、右键「标签居中」；**线在文字的位置真的断开**（不盖白底） |
| **选中与移动** | 框选 / Shift 加选 / `Ctrl+A`；整体拖动（折点与自由端点跟着同一个位移走）；对齐辅助线；多选对齐与分布 |
| **图层** | 列出 / 新建 / 显示隐藏 / 锁定 / 重命名 / 删除（合并到邻层）/ 选中移层 / 设为当前层；隐藏与锁定写入文件 |
| **顺序** | 置顶 / 上移 / 下移 / 置底 —— 写回时**真的改动文件里单元的先后**（否则重新打开就变回去了） |
| **自定义数据** | 右键「编辑数据」，按 `key=value` 一行一项改单元属性；按 user object 存回文件，drawio 打开不会丢 |
| **导出** | SVG / PNG(4×) / 透明 PNG(4×)；「看一眼画布效果」走 DSH 附件服务，**不在工作区落文件** |
| **回退** | 「编辑 → 撤销 AI 改动」最多可以连着退 8 步 |

## 🤖 两个工具 / The two tools

### `diagram_apply` —— 模型怎么改图

结构化 ops，改完自动布局并**原子写回**（布局默认 `dagre-tb`，另有 `dagre-lr` / `grid` / `none`）：

| 类别 | ops |
|---|---|
| 增删 | `addNode` `addEdge` `remove` `duplicate` |
| 修改 | `setLabel` `setLabelPos` `setStyle` `setEdge` `move` |
| 结构 | `addLayer` `setLayer` `setLayerProps` `order` |
| 交互 | `highlight`（让画布替你选中，不改文档、不重排） |
| 输出 | `export`（`svg` 落在 `.drawio` 旁边；`png` 走浏览器下载） |
| 图像 | `traceImage`（把工作区里一张位图**逐像素**矢量化成 svg 内容节点） |

- **批量修改**：`setStyle` / `setLabel` / `move` / `remove` 都接受 `ids:[…]`，不必发 N 个 op。
- **`expectRevision`**：把上次 `diagram_read` 返回的 `revision` 传进来 —— 对不上（说明你在 drawio 里同时改过）就**报错，且一个字节都不写**，重读再改。
- **写盘之前就报错**：边引用了不存在的节点会直接失败，并列出已知 id。
- **不动手工摆好的版面**：ops 里自带几何时（`addNode` 给了 `x/y`，或者有 `move`）不会重排 —— 否则"挪 40px"会被布局立刻冲掉。
- **画图形用 `svg`**：`addNode {shape:"svg", svg:"<svg viewBox…>…</svg>", w, h}` 让节点内容就是那段标记（`setStyle {id, svg:"…"}` 换图、`svg:null` 清掉回到矩形）。标记**必须带 `viewBox`**，否则放大缩小时图形不会跟着变；缺 `xmlns` 宿主会补。
- **照着一张位图描矢量图用 `traceImage`**：

  ```
  diagram_apply({ op:"traceImage", image:"refs/角色.png", removeBg:false, x:40, y:40 })
  ```

  它**真的去读那张图的像素**，在宿主里跑一条完整管线：

  | 步骤 | 做什么 |
  |---|---|
  | ① 解码 | PNG 走**自带解码器**（零依赖，只用 `node:zlib`）；JPEG/GIF/WebP 需要宿主装了 sharp |
  | ② 去背景 | **`removeBg` 必填**（无 auto）：`true` = 抠（先识纯色底，否则近白泛洪）；`false` = 整图保留。由模型按图意判断后传入 |
  | ③ 调色板 | k-means（K 默认 12，k-means++ 初始化，多次重启取最优）；背景单独占一色 |
  | ④ 归类 | 3× 双线性超采样 → 3×3 众数滤波 → 降回原分辨率 → 小于 `minArea` 的碎块并进**颜色最接近**的邻色 |
  | ⑤ 轮廓 | 按颜色分 4 连通域，沿**像素格边**建"区域恒在左侧"的有向图，左转优先走闭合环（外环顺时针 / 洞逆时针） |
  | ⑥ 输出 | RDP 简化 + 相对增量编码 → 每色一条 `fill-rule="nonzero"` 的 `<path>`，按面积降序铺 |

  - 默认 **`w/h` = 原图像素尺寸**（裁剪时为裁剪块尺寸）；`viewBox` 使用工作图局部坐标，内容铺满节点框。裁剪时 `x/y` 默认取裁剪原点，按原图像素 1:1 放置；显式 `w/h` 表示裁剪块的目标尺寸。
  - 要更简洁：`colors` 调小、`scale:2|3`（先降采样）、`grid` 调小；要更保真：`epsilon` 调小（默认 2px）、`minArea` 调小（默认 10px²）。
  - 返回的 summary 会报**色数 / 路径数 / 轮廓环数 / 字符数 / 量化图轮廓是否无损**。`labelPartitionComplete` 只验证标签分区完整；`exactPixelCoverage` 还要求最终输出保留全部前景轮廓几何，两者都不代表与原图颜色、细节一致。简化后无法证明无损时 `drawnPixels` 为 `null`。
  - 字符预算充足时不额外按环面积删除小碎片；风格由减色、`epsilon` 与 `minArea` 等参数控制。预算紧时仍会进一步简化、删小环，回执中的 `attempts / appliedEpsilon / loopsDropped / budgetExceeded` 会报告降级与超预算情况。
  - 单次硬上限：SVG 标记 250000 字符（默认预算 248000）；宿主先收紧轮廓，仍超硬上限才报错让你调参。
  - 落盘仍是 drawio **原生**的图片形状（`shape=image` + `image=data:image/svg+xml,<百分号编码>`），drawio 桌面版打开同样

plugins.description: DSH pre-execute gate: ask before a tool call leaks a credential, stops a service, or rewrites host network/registry state.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-guard

DSH 的 `tools/pre-execute` 门禁：在工具真正执行前，把**可机械判定**的危险调用拦下来，交给用户决定。

它不试图做语义判断。像「诊断和修复要分开」「用户没提问先别动手」这类规则，任何正则都判不准，仍然只能写在 `AGENTS.md` 里靠模型自觉。这个插件只管那些一眼能看出来、也不该指望模型每次都记住的部分。

## 装

本包不走 npm（`private: true`，防误发）。两种分发方式：

**本地目录**——在 DSH 里用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，target 填 `file:D:\AgentGeneralWorkSpace\tools\dsh-agent-guard`。

**Git 仓库**——把仓库地址加进 profile 的依赖（`pnpm add dsh-agent-guard@git+https://…`），再把 `dsh-agent-guard` 加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

**装完必须重启 DSH。** host 插件代码不做热重载，改了文件不重启等于没改。

本机额外做了一步：`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-agent-guard` 已经是指向本仓库的目录联接，所以改完源码只需重启，不必重新安装。如果哪次 `pnpm install` 把联接冲掉、变回实体副本，重跑一次 `install_bundle` 即可。

## 拦什么

所有规则都返回 `ask`，从不硬性 `deny`——你看得到命中的是哪条、命中了什么，然后自己决定放不放。没有可用审批器时按框架规则会降级为拒绝，方向是安全的。

| 规则 | 触发条件 | 作用范围 |
|---|---|---|
| `credential` | 参数里出现 `sk-…`（16 位以上）、`ghp_`/`gho_`/`ghs_`/`ghu_`/`ghr_`、`AKIA…`、`xox?-…` | **任意工具**的任意字符串参数，含嵌套对象和数组 |
| `service` | `Stop-Service`、`Set-Service`、`Restart-Service`、`sc.exe stop\|config\|delete\|create` | 仅 shell 命令行 |
| `elevation` | `Start-Process … -Verb RunAs`、`runas` | 仅 shell 命令行 |
| `registry` | `reg.exe add HKLM…`、`New-ItemProperty … HKLM:` | 仅 shell 命令行 |
| `network` | `netsh … advfirewall\|firewall`、`Set-DnsClientServerAddress` | 仅 shell 命令行 |
| `driver` | `pnputil /delete-driver` | 仅 shell 命令行 |

shell 规则按命令边界锚定，所以 `Write-Host "Stop-Service is forbidden"` 这种把命令名写在字符串里的情况不会误报。

凭据命中时，弹窗里的片段会把密钥打码成 `sk-a…yz`，不会把明文再送回对话记录。

## 调

规则表就是 `lib/index.js` 顶部的 `VALUE_RULES` 和 `SHELL_RULES`，纯正则，直接改。改完跑一遍自检，再重启 DSH。

## 自检

```bash
node lib/index.js
```

跑 11 个用例，覆盖每条规则的命中与不命中（含上面那条字符串字面量的对照）。改规则后跑一遍，别只信正则写得对。

## 已知边界

- 只看工具参数，看不到你在对话里打了什么字。
- 只认得写死的模式。自己拼出来的等价命令（比如 `& 'Stop-Service'`、变量拼出来的服务名）拦不住。
- 短于门槛的 `sk-10086` 这类占位符不会触发，避免天天弹窗。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 自定义列表：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供来源分类、分层模型导航及 Our Free Model 四类型目录。
plugins.readme_text:
# 自定义列表 · dsh-custom-lists

**作者：YOUYA**  
**AI 辅助开发模型：GPT-6.1 Sol**

DeepSeek Harness 的本地界面插件。把冗长的平铺模型列表整理成来源、类型、渠道和模型目录，并在设置左侧提供独立配置页面。

> 非 DeepSeek 官方插件，不提供 API 服务，不附带账号或模型额度。
> 版本 1.2.1 为预发布候选：交互测试及用户当前页面检查通过，真实桌面端冷启动复测尚未完成。

## 功能

- 来源前缀：【官方】【插件】【中转】。当前会话选中来源的前缀绿色，其余灰色；不是请求正在执行的指示灯。
- 一级菜单只显示来源名称和模型总数，不展开冗长层级摘要。
- 官方／中转：来源 → 模型。
- 普通插件：来源 → 渠道 → 模型。
- Our Free Model：来源 → 四类型 → 渠道 → 模型。
- 四类型包括免费模型、EAC 模型、白嫖模型接入、聚合渠道。空分类保留入口与空状态。
- 保留 provider/model/reasoningEffort，不合并不同渠道的同名模型，不改变调用路径。
- 支持模型搜索、推理等级、刷新、逐层返回及 Escape。
- 设置中可新增分组、调整名称与顺序、选择来源类别、指定提供商归组，导入导出及恢复默认。
- 关闭「启用分层模型选择器」恢复官方选择器；不删除模型或账号。

## 安装

安装前请备份 DSH profile 配置。不要修改应用安装包。

### 通过插件管理器安装

本包在 `package.json` 中声明了 `dsh.bundle`（指向仓库根目录的 `cordis.patch.yml`），可用 DSH 插件管理器的「从 GitHub 安装」输入仓库地址：

```text
https://github.com/youyaemmm-pixel/dsh-custom-lists
```

仓库根目录直接包含 `package.json`、`index.js`、`client.js` 与 `cordis.patch.yml`，不需要构建步骤。

安装后刷新 GUI 生效；如界面未更新，完整退出并重开 DSH。

### 本地安装（开发／测试）

1. 将本目录解压到稳定的本地插件目录，确保目录内直接包含 package.json、index.js、client.js。
2. 在目标 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中新增以下条目，将示例 file URL 替换为**你自己的实际绝对路径**：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: custom-lists
      name: "file:///ABSOLUTE/PATH/dsh-custom-lists/index.js"
```

Windows 路径需使用正确的 file URL，例如 `file:///C:/Plugins/dsh-custom-lists/index.js`。本包没有自动改写 profile 的安装脚本。

3. 刷新原 GUI；必要时完整退出并重开 DSH。
4. 设置左侧进入「自定义列表」确认启用和提供商归组。

以上本地方式只用于开发／测试，会绕过 bundle 声明直接挂载入口文件。市场收录状态以插件目录中的条目为准；收录不等于安全审查，也不会由本仓库单方面宣称。

## 示例目录

```text
【官方】官方来源
└─ 模型
【插件】Our Free Model
├─ 免费模型 → 渠道 → 模型（无模型时显示空状态）
├─ EAC 模型 → EAC → 模型
├─ 白嫖模型接入 → 账号渠道 → 模型
└─ 聚合渠道 → 渠道 → 模型（无模型时显示空状态）
【中转】自定义中转来源
└─ 模型
```

不附带任何用户分组或模型清单；界面从安装者当前模型目录读取可用内容。

## 数据与隐私

设置仅保存显示规则至浏览器 localStorage，按当前 profile 名称隔离；不包含凭据。换浏览器或清除站点数据前请导出设置。profile 名称在运行时由本机注入，不是本发布包内置的数据。不主动上传分组、profile 名称或诊断。详见 PRIVACY.md。

## 兼容性与限制

- 基于 DSH 官方模型组件 `0.2.0-rc.2` 的接口实现，不承诺兼容所有未来版本。
- 使用 `conversation.input.model`、`settings.section`、`modelDirectories`、`sessions` 和 `remote.session`；选择器优先级为 -10。不要与其他替换同一槽位的插件同时启用。
- `/model` 命令维持官方样式。
- OFM 无公开可靠的渠道归属接口：使用已核实 provider ID 表和其 EAC/Kilo 展示标签。新渠道可能需要手动归组。
- 四类型归属依据当前可见目录及已知规则推导，不是 OFM 完整后台分类 API 的镜像。未知提供商不保证自动正确归类；请检查实际结果。
- 不会在没有可用模型时伪造模型或连接；空目录不代表执行过网络连通性探测。
- 冷启动错误已补齐 remote/remote.session 依赖声明，但本版尚待真实桌面端重启复测。

## 故障与卸载

出现「自定义列表异常／会话错误」时记录完整错误，可尝试错误界面的重试或开关一次启用设置。提交 issue 前请去除账号、端点、密钥及本地路径。

卸载前建议导出显示规则；通过插件管理器禁用/卸载，或删除本地安装时新增的 custom-lists 补丁条目，然后刷新 GUI。不要覆盖整个 profile；那可能撤销其他配置修改。

## 许可

MIT。选择器适配自 DeepSeek Harness 官方组件，保留 DeepSeek 原许可。导航理念参考 dsh-model-picker，详见 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md。

plugins.description: All-session token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-usage-stats

在 DSH 设置里增加一个 **使用统计** 页面：扫描本机全部会话日志，汇总累计、峰值、连续天数、聊天时长、每日趋势和模型用量。

![使用统计界面预览（演示数据）](preview.png)

![趋势与模型用量预览（演示数据）](preview-models.png)

> 预览图使用虚构的演示数据，不含真实会话、账号或用量。

## 统计口径

- Token：`输入 + 缓存读取 + 缓存写入 + 输出`，与 DSH 自己的 `tokenUsage` 投影一致。
- 会话：包含子会话，跨工作区汇总；被 fork 的子会话会物理复制父会话日志，统计时用 `inheritedEventCount` 去掉父会话前缀，避免重复计费。
- 模型：取自每条 `assistant/message` 的 `message.source.model`；没有该字段的旧日志回退到最近的 `request/header.config.model`。
- 聊天时长：同一会话内相邻事件间隔不超过 1 小时才累计；长时间挂起不会把“聊了几天”算成一次聊天。
- 连续天数：按本地日期统计有 Token 用量的连续天数。

数据来自 `sessionQuery` 对持久化日志的重放；不会改写日志。首次打开会在后台扫描全部会话（几百个会话通常十几秒到半分钟，视日志量而定），随后缓存 5 分钟，页面上的“刷新”会强制重算。

## 页面内容

- 五张卡片：累计 Token、峰值 Token、最长聊天时长、当前连续天数、最长连续天数。
- Token 活动热力图：近 12 个月，支持每日 / 每周 / 累计三种聚合；悬停格子显示日期、Token 数和轮消息数。
- 每日 Token 趋势图：按模型分线（前 5 个模型 + 其他），可切换近 7 日 / 近 30 日 / 全部；悬停显示当天总量、各模型明细和十字线。
- 模型用量环图：当前时间范围内的模型占比与 Token 数。

## 安装

从 GitHub 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:XEsx630/dsh-usage-stats
```

本地开发时，也可以在 **插件 / Plugins** 页面选择 **Add plugin**，填入本目录的绝对路径并启用 `dsh-usage-stats`。两种方式都依赖 profile 里声明的 bundle；HMR 会热加载，如果设置侧栏没有出现 **使用统计**，刷新页面（`Ctrl+R`）或重启 DSH。

## 卸载

在插件页面卸载，或从 profile 的 `package.json` 中删除 `dsh-usage-stats` 依赖与 bundle 条目，再删掉 `node_modules/dsh-usage-stats`。

## 结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host 半：重放会话、按日期/模型折叠、`/dsh-usage/api/stats` |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半：注册 `settings.section`，绘制卡片、热力图、趋势图和环图 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 把 Host 插件插入 profile |
| `test/fold.test.js` | 折叠、模型归属、fork 前缀的自检（`node --test`） |

## API

`GET /dsh-usage/api/stats`（同源、仅本机 Host）返回：

```json

  "models": [{ "model": "deepseek-v4.1-flash", "input": 0, "output": 0, "cacheRead": 0, "cacheWrite": 0, "total": 0 }],
  "modelDays": [{ "date": "2026-10-19", "models": [{ "model": "deepseek-v4.1-flash", "total": 0 }] }]
}
```

> **这是踏雪寻仙 DeepSeek Harness 插件系列的一员**（[dsh-files](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-files) 39★ · [dsh-models](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-models) 模型选择 + 子代理路由 + 推理层级）。同作者完整技能系列：[session-digger](https://github.com/taxueseek/session-digger) 29★ · [taxue-invest](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-invest) 21★ · [taxueskills](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxueskills) 23★ · [taxue-creative-style](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-creative-style) 12★ ## 它和「模型自带搜索 / AI 搜索 / 聚合搜索」比，强在哪 > 简单来说：前三种方案解决「**人**找信息」，Argo 解决「**Agent 及搜索核查于一身，具备一条龙的搜索服务**」。差别不在界面，在交付物，给人看的叫总结页或链接清单，给 Agent 的应是能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的优质内容，更可靠的搜索信息。

| 维度 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 垂直问题（行情 / 化学式） | 泛搜网页 | 泛搜再总结 | 泛搜网页 | **直连垂直源，直接给答案** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 重复查询 | 每次都打网 | 每次都打网 | 靠页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | > 机制上，Argo 把搜索当成一条**证据管线**：语言检测 → 领域路由 → 多引擎召回 → RRF 融合 → 证据快评，交付的是 Agent 可直接排序、可 `fetch` 复核、不撑爆上下文的材料。工具链不用换，需要换的是「搜索结果应该长什么样」——再往下一层，还有和「再包一层搜索 API 的差别」，那是实现细节的对比。 --- ## 2026，检索正在发生什么变化 Agent 干活的量级变了，检索的玩法跟着变了四件事，每一件 Argo 都已经落在代码里： 1. **检索从「给链接」变成「给证据」。** Agent 不看网页排版，它要能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的结构化材料——所以 Argo 交付的是带可信度分解的 JSON，而不是 SERP 清单。 2. **上下文成为第一成本。** 一次网页抓取动辄上万 token，Agent 的窗口烧不起。Argo 的 Agent 档单次约 3.7KB，字段集合与字节预算都有检查卡着，升级不会悄悄变胖。 3. **网站开始为 AI 备料。** llms.txt 标准与 `.md` 直出在头部文档站快速铺开——Argo 抓取链第零级自动探测这些 AI 友好变体，命中即跳过整条反爬链；HTTP/TLS 都失败还有 r.jina.ai 阅读器级保底。 4. **免费开放生态够用了。** 政府、学术、标准、安全机构的开放 API + 免 key 引擎，已经能覆盖大多数领域（221 个免配置源）；稀缺免费额度（firecrawl 1000 credits/月、stackexchange 300 次/天）做了「日常补位、关键顶上」的分层，订阅墙不是唯一解。 5. **检索质量从「感觉」到「度量」。** 排序有金标（MRR/nDCG 地板）、融合有增益消融检查、路由有负向控制矩阵——「这版比上版好吗」从此是数字问题，不是玄学。 > v2.9.3 把以上全部落地：264 个源、94 个领域、229 个免配置开箱。逐项细节见 [docs/为什么选择argo.md](docs/为什么选择argo.md) 与 [发布说明](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v2.9.0.md)。 --- # Argo 阿尔戈：给 Agent 用的搜索与深度研究工具 ## 这是什么 **Argo 是一个装在 Agent 里的搜索与深度研究工具，也可以获取相关网页的信息。背后连着 266 个搜索源，覆盖 95 个业务领域，同时支持本地文件的基础搜索能力。在开源搜索项目里，具备非常强大的搜索能力。** 支持配置 API Key 提升搜索质量（配了 Key 的源质量通常更好，没配则自动跳过），也支持免费引擎和本地引擎自动保底。覆盖中英日韩等 18 种语言，支持金融、学术、影视、体育、代码、宏观等垂直场景。 ## 子技能 Argo 的能力通过四个子技能（sub-skills）组织，每个子技能是一条独立可用的管线： | 子技能 | 能力 | |--------|------| | **local-search** | 本机文件搜索 + 本地零成本聚合引擎（32 个本地引擎）。搜代码符号、文件名、文档全文、文件结构。可并入网络搜索结果，加一个开关本机命中就并进同一次搜索 | | **local-seek** | 本地语义搜索（BM25 + 向量混合），搜笔记、记忆、资料库。三层递进：先定位文件、再看上下文、最后精读段落 | | **ego-search** | 登录态专业搜索。知乎、小红书、公众号等需要登录才能看的内容，用真实浏览器配合登录态去搜。默认关闭，需时开启 | | **js-run** | 无浏览器执行网页 JS。不开浏览器跑「环境探测 + 纯计算」型网页脚本，单次上下文 P50 约 1ms | 四个子技能覆盖了从「搜本机」到「搜全网」到「搜登录墙后面」的完整链路。大部分场景用 local-search + 联网搜索就够，特殊场景再开 ego-search 和 js-run。 ## DSH 插件 Argo 同时是 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，一行命令装好： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo" ``` 装完重启 `dsh web` 即生效。搜索和抓取成为原生一等工具，不依赖 MCP 连接，不占常驻上下文开销。另有十一个工具按需开启。完整接入形态见下文。 ## 核心优势 **266 个源，229 个免密钥开箱可用。** 不配任何 API Key 就能跑，免费引擎和本地引擎自动保底。配了 Key 的源质量通常更好，没配则自动跳过。一次安装，全场景可用。 **本地搜索 + 联网搜索一体。** 这是 Argo 独一份的能力。本机文件搜索底层是 rg、mdfind 那套开发者日常工具，搜代码符号、文件名、文档全文、文件结构。加一个开关，本机命中会并进同一次网络搜索结果里，结果上标着来源是本机文件。写东西时记得自己半年前记过一段话但忘了在哪，用这个搜比翻文件夹快。 **双层缓存，热查询约 10ms。** 时效性没那么强的内容（百科类、历史数据这类），第一次查完会进缓存，之后同样的查询直接命中，不再每次都走一遍 API。既省钱也省时间。 **多语言 + 垂直场景。** 实测过 18 种语言，中文、英文和日文能查到当地一手来源。问论文走学术库，问影视走条目库，问代码走问答社区，问行情走金融源。泛泛的问题才走通用搜索。 ## 装完就能用 零配置就能跑。三种装法，按你的习惯挑： **想让 AI 助手自己会搜**，把技能包装进它的技能目录。以后你说「帮我查一下」「核实一下」，它会自己去查。 **想随手试**，用一条 npx 命令即用即走，不用装。 **想让助手常驻着用**，给它挂上 MCP，19 个检索工具随时可用。还有一键注入命令，能给 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Windsurf 自动配好，Codex、OpenCode 和 Cline 也在这个名单里。写配置前会备份，随时能撤。 ```bash # 方式一：一键脚本（推荐本机长期用） curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh | bash # 方式二：npx 即用即走（推荐 Agent 快速挂载） npx -y github:taxueseek/argo # 方式三：git clone（开发 / 改源码） git clone https://github.com/taxueseek/argo.git ``` 装完随手试一条： ```bash argo search "python asyncio error handling" ``` 它给你的是 StackOverflow 官方 API 里按社区得分排过序、标了采纳状态的问题，不是一堆 SEO 农场。 想看看自己机器上现在有几个源可用，一条命令就列出来： ```bash argo search --list-engines ``` ## 接入形态 Argo 支持四种接入方式，按你的场景挑： | 形态 | 适合 | 说明 | |------|------|------| | **MCP Server** | Agent 常驻挂载 | 19 个检索工具随时可用，一条命令注入 Claude Code / Cursor / Windsurf / Codex / OpenCode / Cline，写配置前自动备份 | | **DSH 插件** | DeepSeek Harness 用户 | 一行 `dsh plugin add` 装好，搜索和抓取成为原生一等工具，不依赖 MCP 连接，不占常驻上下文开销 | | **Skill 文件** | Claude Code / Grok Build / Kimi 等 | 技能包装进 Agent 的技能目录，你说「帮我查一下」「核实一下」，它自己去查 | | **npx 即用即走** | 快速试一下 | `npx -y github:taxueseek/argo`，不用装，适合临时把 MCP 挂进任意客户端 | 四种形态底层是同一套 Python 代码，CLI 与 MCP 工具一一对应，装哪种都不缺能力。 ## 问啥像啥

| 你这样问 | 大致会怎样 | |----------|------------| | python asyncio error handling | 编程问答域 → StackOverflow/StackExchange 官方 API，带得分与采纳标记 | | AAPL / 美股盘前 | 美股域，与 A 股分流 | | 肖申克的救赎 主演 / Inception director | 影视域 → IMDb 等 | | 梅西 俱乐部 / 库里 球队 | 体育域 → TheSportsDB 等 | | 埃菲尔铁塔在哪 / where is Eiffel Tower | 地理实体 → OpenStreetMap 等 | | NASA founding year / 国务院职能 | 组织实体 → Wikidata 等 | | 周杰伦 专辑 / Taylor Swift album | 媒体域 → iTunes 等 | | アニメ おすすめ / 한국 영화 추천 | 识别日/韩语 → 语言友好源，少塞中文专用站 | | 美国 CPI、日本 通胀率 | 宏观数据域；国别分流（本国权威源优先） | | log4j 漏洞 CVSS / nodejs 22 end of life | 安全域 → NVD 官方；生命周期域 → endoflife.date | | attention is all you need | 学术域 → arXiv/OpenAlex/CrossRef，元数据与 DOI 直连 | | 阿司匹林 分子式 | 化学域 → PubChem 类答案 | | 台积电估值分歧（深度研究） | 拆子问题 + 多源并行，垂直源被 boost | --- ## 它怎么工作

``` 查询 ├─ 意图消歧（可选） ├─ 查询改写（可选；路由仍看原始意图） ├─ 语言检测 + 语言偏好 ├─ 路由（域规则 + TF-IDF + 预算 + 语言补充源 + 热路径缓存） ├─ 多引擎召回（熔断 / 负缓存 / 并行） ├─ 空结果分阶恢复（放宽 → 换同族/通用 → 跨语言；防污染） ├─ RRF 融合 + 可选精排 ├─ 证据快评（权威 · 证据密度 · 时效 · 共识） └─ 统一 JSON（含 engine_outcomes / recovery / route_reason） ``` ### 证据评分（简版） ``` selection ≈ 域名权威，SERP/跳转链压到很低 absorption ≈ 数字 / 定义 / 对比 / 披露等证据密度 freshness ≈ 发布时间（会忽略「2015 年以来」这类历史对比年） 综合 ≈ 0.40·selection + 0.35·absorption + 0.15·freshness + 0.10·引擎分 ``` 结果字段含 `selection`、`absorption`、`credibility_fast`、`evidence_flags` 等，方便 Agent 直接排序。 ### Agent 使用纪律（建议） 1. **高后果问题**（持仓、安全、是否属实）：search → 看快评分 → 对 top 结果 `fetch` → 再下结论 2. **数字**：写清计算方式，冲突时并列，不要硬合并 3. **搜索结果页 / 跳转链**：不要当正文信源 4. **社交帖**：当舆情与叙事，不当事实真值 5. **事实核查**：宁可多一两条分层查询（来源 / 对比 / 主体） --- ## 快速开始 任选一种即可。**以 GitHub 为唯一安装来源**（`npx github:taxueseek/argo` 或 `install.sh` / `install.ps1`），当前推荐 **v2.9.7**。**请勿用 `npm install argo-search`**——npm registry 上那份是**非官方陈旧版 v1.0.1**（非本仓库维护，功能残缺、不随本项目更新）。本包 `package.json` 已设 `private: true` 防止误发布到 npm registry。 **零配置就能跑**：不配 API Key 时走免费引擎 + 本地 `local_*` 引擎；配了 Key 的源质量通常更好，没配则自动跳过。 ### 方式一：一键脚本（推荐本机长期用） macOS / Linux： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` Windows（PowerShell）： ```powershell powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubuser

2026，检索正在发生什么变化 Agent 干活的量级变了，检索的玩法跟着变了四件事，每一件 Argo 都已经落在代码里： 1. **检索从「给链接」变成「给证据」。** Agent 不看网页排版，它要能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的结构化材料——所以 Argo 交付的是带可信度分解的 JSON，而不是 SERP 清单。 2. **上下文成为第一成本。** 一次网页抓取动辄上万 token，Agent 的窗口烧不起。Argo 的 Agent 档单次约 3.7KB，字段集合与字节预算都有检查卡着，升级不会悄悄变胖。 3. **网站开始为 AI 备料。** llms.txt 标准与 `.md` 直出在头部文档站快速铺开——Argo 抓取链第零级自动探测这些 AI 友好变体，命中即跳过整条反爬链；HTTP/TLS 都失败还有 r.jina.ai 阅读器级保底。 4. **免费开放生态够用了。** 政府、学术、标准、安全机构的开放 API + 免 key 引擎，已经能覆盖大多数领域（221 个免配置源）；稀缺免费额度（firecrawl 1000 credits/月、stackexchange 300 次/天）做了「日常补位、关键顶上」的分层，订阅墙不是唯一解。 5. **检索质量从「感觉」到「度量」。** 排序有金标（MRR/nDCG 地板）、融合有增益消融检查、路由有负向控制矩阵——「这版比上版好吗」从此是数字问题，不是玄学。 > v2.9.3 把以上全部落地：264 个源、94 个领域、229 个免配置开箱。逐项细节见 [docs/为什么选择argo.md](docs/为什么选择argo.md) 与 [发布说明](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v2.9.0.md)。 --- # Argo 阿尔戈：给 Agent 用的搜索与深度研究工具 ## 这是什么 **Argo 是一个装在 Agent 里的搜索与深度研究工具，也可以获取相关网页的信息。背后连着 266 个搜索源，覆盖 95 个业务领域，同时支持本地文件的基础搜索能力。在开源搜索项目里，具备非常强大的搜索能力。** 支持配置 API Key 提升搜索质量（配了 Key 的源质量通常更好，没配则自动跳过），也支持免费引擎和本地引擎自动保底。覆盖中英日韩等 18 种语言，支持金融、学术、影视、体育、代码、宏观等垂直场景。 ## 子技能 Argo 的能力通过四个子技能（sub-skills）组织，每个子技能是一条独立可用的管线： | 子技能 | 能力 | |--------|------| | **local-search** | 本机文件搜索 + 本地零成本聚合引擎（32 个本地引擎）。搜代码符号、文件名、文档全文、文件结构。可并入网络搜索结果，加一个开关本机命中就并进同一次搜索 | | **local-seek** | 本地语义搜索（BM25 + 向量混合），搜笔记、记忆、资料库。三层递进：先定位文件、再看上下文、最后精读段落 | | **ego-search** | 登录态专业搜索。知乎、小红书、公众号等需要登录才能看的内容，用真实浏览器配合登录态去搜。默认关闭，需时开启 | | **js-run** | 无浏览器执行网页 JS。不开浏览器跑「环境探测 + 纯计算」型网页脚本，单次上下文 P50 约 1ms | 四个子技能覆盖了从「搜本机」到「搜全网」到「搜登录墙后面」的完整链路。大部分场景用 local-search + 联网搜索就够，特殊场景再开 ego-search 和 js-run。 ## DSH 插件 Argo 同时是 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，一行命令装好： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo" ``` 装完重启 `dsh web` 即生效。搜索和抓取成为原生一等工具，不依赖 MCP 连接，不占常驻上下文开销。另有十一个工具按需开启。完整接入形态见下文。 ## 核心优势 **266 个源，229 个免密钥开箱可用。** 不配任何 API Key 就能跑，免费引擎和本地引擎自动保底。配了 Key 的源质量通常更好，没配则自动跳过。一次安装，全场景可用。 **本地搜索 + 联网搜索一体。** 这是 Argo 独一份的能力。本机文件搜索底层是 rg、mdfind 那套开发者日常工具，搜代码符号、文件名、文档全文、文件结构。加一个开关，本机命中会并进同一次网络搜索结果里，结果上标着来源是本机文件。写东西时记得自己半年前记过一段话但忘了在哪，用这个搜比翻文件夹快。 **双层缓存，热查询约 10ms。** 时效性没那么强的内容（百科类、历史数据这类），第一次查完会进缓存，之后同样的查询直接命中，不再每次都走一遍 API。既省钱也省时间。 **多语言 + 垂直场景。** 实测过 18 种语言，中文、英文和日文能查到当地一手来源。问论文走学术库，问影视走条目库，问代码走问答社区，问行情走金融源。泛泛的问题才走通用搜索。 ## 装完就能用 零配置就能跑。三种装法，按你的习惯挑： **想让 AI 助手自己会搜**，把技能包装进它的技能目录。以后你说「帮我查一下」「核实一下」，它会自己去查。 **想随手试**，用一条 npx 命令即用即走，不用装。 **想让助手常驻着用**，给它挂上 MCP，19 个检索工具随时可用。还有一键注入命令，能给 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Windsurf 自动配好，Codex、OpenCode 和 Cline 也在这个名单里。写配置前会备份，随时能撤。 ```bash # 方式一：一键脚本（推荐本机长期用） curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh | bash # 方式二：npx 即用即走（推荐 Agent 快速挂载） npx -y github:taxueseek/argo # 方式三：git clone（开发 / 改源码） git clone https://github.com/taxueseek/argo.git ``` 装完随手试一条： ```bash argo search "python asyncio error handling" ``` 它给你的是 StackOverflow 官方 API 里按社区得分排过序、标了采纳状态的问题，不是一堆 SEO 农场。 想看看自己机器上现在有几个源可用，一条命令就列出来： ```bash argo search --list-engines ``` ## 接入形态 Argo 支持四种接入方式，按你的场景挑： | 形态 | 适合 | 说明 | |------|------|------| | **MCP Server** | Agent 常驻挂载 | 19 个检索工具随时可用，一条命令注入 Claude Code / Cursor / Windsurf / Codex / OpenCode / Cline，写配置前自动备份 | | **DSH 插件** | DeepSeek Harness 用户 | 一行 `dsh plugin add` 装好，搜索和抓取成为原生一等工具，不依赖 MCP 连接，不占常驻上下文开销 | | **Skill 文件** | Claude Code / Grok Build / Kimi 等 | 技能包装进 Agent 的技能目录，你说「帮我查一下」「核实一下」，它自己去查 | | **npx 即用即走** | 快速试一下 | `npx -y github:taxueseek/argo`，不用装，适合临时把 MCP 挂进任意客户端 | 四种形态底层是同一套 Python 代码，CLI 与 MCP 工具一一对应，装哪种都不缺能力。 ## 问啥像啥

| 你这样问 | 大致会怎样 | |----------|------------| | python asyncio error handling | 编程问答域 → StackOverflow/StackExchange 官方 API，带得分与采纳标记 | | AAPL / 美股盘前 | 美股域，与 A 股分流 | | 肖申克的救赎 主演 / Inception director | 影视域 → IMDb 等 | | 梅西 俱乐部 / 库里 球队 | 体育域 → TheSportsDB 等 | | 埃菲尔铁塔在哪 / where is Eiffel Tower | 地理实体 → OpenStreetMap 等 | | NASA founding year / 国务院职能 | 组织实体 → Wikidata 等 | | 周杰伦 专辑 / Taylor Swift album | 媒体域 → iTunes 等 | | アニメ おすすめ / 한국 영화 추천 | 识别日/韩语 → 语言友好源，少塞中文专用站 | | 美国 CPI、日本 通胀率 | 宏观数据域；国别分流（本国权威源优先） | | log4j 漏洞 CVSS / nodejs 22 end of life | 安全域 → NVD 官方；生命周期域 → endoflife.date | | attention is all you need | 学术域 → arXiv/OpenAlex/CrossRef，元数据与 DOI 直连 | | 阿司匹林 分子式 | 化学域 → PubChem 类答案 | | 台积电估值分歧（深度研究） | 拆子问题 + 多源并行，垂直源被 boost | --- ## 它怎么工作

``` 查询 ├─ 意图消歧（可选） ├─ 查询改写（可选；路由仍看原始意图） ├─ 语言检测 + 语言偏好 ├─ 路由（域规则 + TF-IDF + 预算 + 语言补充源 + 热路径缓存） ├─ 多引擎召回（熔断 / 负缓存 / 并行） ├─ 空结果分阶恢复（放宽 → 换同族/通用 → 跨语言；防污染） ├─ RRF 融合 + 可选精排 ├─ 证据快评（权威 · 证据密度 · 时效 · 共识） └─ 统一 JSON（含 engine_outcomes / recovery / route_reason） ``` ### 证据评分（简版） ``` selection ≈ 域名权威，SERP/跳转链压到很低 absorption ≈ 数字 / 定义 / 对比 / 披露等证据密度 freshness ≈ 发布时间（会忽略「2015 年以来」这类历史对比年） 综合 ≈ 0.40·selection + 0.35·absorption + 0.15·freshness + 0.10·引擎分 ``` 结果字段含 `selection`、`absorption`、`credibility_fast`、`evidence_flags` 等，方便 Agent 直接排序。 ### Agent 使用纪律（建议） 1. **高后果问题**（持仓、安全、是否属实）：search → 看快评分 → 对 top 结果 `fetch` → 再下结论 2. **数字**：写清计算方式，冲突时并列，不要硬合并 3. **搜索结果页 / 跳转链**：不要当正文信源 4. **社交帖**：当舆情与叙事，不当事实真值 5. **事实核查**：宁可多一两条分层查询（来源 / 对比 / 主体） --- ## 快速开始 任选一种即可。**以 GitHub 为唯一安装来源**（`npx github:taxueseek/argo` 或 `install.sh` / `install.ps1`），当前推荐 **v2.9.7**。**请勿用 `npm install argo-search`**——npm registry 上那份是**非官方陈旧版 v1.0.1**（非本仓库维护，功能残缺、不随本项目更新）。本包 `package.json` 已设 `private: true` 防止误发布到 npm registry。 **零配置就能跑**：不配 API Key 时走免费引擎 + 本地 `local_*` 引擎；配了 Key 的源质量通常更好，没配则自动跳过。 ### 方式一：一键脚本（推荐本机长期用） macOS / Linux： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` Windows（PowerShell）： ```powershell powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubuser

DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process.
