🇨🇳 中文版 | 🇺🇸 English

# dsh-rea English | [简体中文](README.zh.md) · [Releases](https://github.com/sqhc/dsh-rea/releases) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) > **Unofficial.** This repository is an independent DeepSeek Harness bundle. It is > not affiliated with, endorsed by, or published by the REA project. It contains > no REA source code: at runtime it installs the official > [`rea-agents`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/rea-agents) package from npm and > connects its MCP server to the Harness. See [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md). A configuration-only [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) bundle that connects the REA reverse-engineering MCP server. Once installed, the agent can call REA tools as `mcp__rea__` — inspect native binaries, app bundles, JavaScript/Electron applications, managed assemblies, websites, packet captures, firmware images, and runtime behavior. ## Origin and provenance - **Upstream project:** [REA — Reverse Engineer Anything](https://github.com/morluto/rea) by **morluto**, MIT-licensed. The npm package is [`rea-agents`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/rea-agents); documentation lives at [rea.tools](https://rea.tools/). - **This repository:** , maintained by [sqhc](https://github.com/sqhc). It is a packaging layer, not a fork. - **Relationship:** unofficial integration. It turns the `rea-mcp` registration that REA's own `rea setup --client dsh` writes into an installable DSH bundle with locale metadata and an icon. No REA source code, binaries, or artwork are copied; the official package is fetched from npm at runtime. - **Packaging contract:** DeepSeek Harness's `dsh.bundle.patch` format and the harness-shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`. ## What this bundle actually does The bundle inserts one row into the Harness plugin composition: ```yaml - insert: - id: rea-mcp name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: rea transport: stdio command: npx args: ['-y', 'rea-agents@6.7.0', 'mcp'] ``` `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` is shipped with DSH. REA is not vendored, forked, or rebuilt here — the official npm package runs as a local stdio MCP server. ## Requirements - DeepSeek Harness with the shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` (verified with `0.2.1-rc.2`). - Node.js and npm on the Harness process `PATH`. REA officially supports Node.js 22.x (>=22.19), 24.x (>=24.11), or 26+. Node.js 20 can start the server but is outside REA's supported range. - Network access on the first launch so `npx` can fetch `rea-agents@6.7.0`. - macOS is what this bundle was verified on. Linux should work the same way. Windows is untested; native REA providers also have their own prerequisites. ## Version compatibility | REA version | Bundle version | DSH version (verified) | Notes | |---|---|---|---| | `rea-agents@6.7.0` | `0.1.0` | `0.2.1-rc.2` | Baseline; 207 tools, compact input schema, output schema off | | `rea-agents@6.x.x` | `0.1.x` | `0.2.x` | Patch versions only; pin exact REA version in `cordis.patch.yml` | *Always read REA release notes before upgrading. Tool names and schemas are part of the model-facing contract.* ## Install Clone this repository, then ask the Harness agent to install the bundle directory with `plugin_manager` (`action: install_bundle`). The agent needs the absolute path to the checkout. Installing changes the current DSH profile and survives restarts. Before installing, you can run the preflight script: ```bash node scripts/preflight.mjs ``` It checks the Node version and npm cache, performs an MCP initialize + `tools/list` handshake against `rea-agents@6.7.0`, and reports the tool count and catalog size. It also warms the npx cache, which makes the first Harness launch much faster. ## First launch The first launch may take a while because `npx` downloads REA. The bundle starts with `failOnStartupError: false` and automatic reconnect, so a slow first download does not disable the row; calls fail until the server is ready. Check the Harness log if no REA tools appear after a few minutes. ## Verify Ask the agent to call `mcp__rea__binary_session` with no arguments. It reports the current target/provider/server identity without starting analysis. A healthy result identifies the REA server version (`6.7.0`). ## Tool catalog and context cost REA advertises 207 tools. Rendering the complete catalog would cost several megabytes, so this bundle always sets: - `REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE=compact` — bounded input schemas; REA still validates calls against the full canonical contract. - `REA_MCP_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE=off` — output schemas are omitted from discovery; REA still validates structured results server-side. Measured at REA 6.7.0: about **215–230 KiB of tool JSON (~55–57k tokens)**. With deepseek-flash's 1M-token context this is acceptable, but it is a real fixed cost on every request while the plugin is enabled. Disable the bundle when you are not doing reverse engineering. If you prefer the full advertisement and your model route accepts it, change `REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE` to `full`. Do not combine `full` input with output schemas unless you have measured the cost: the complete catalog is ~3.4 MB. ## Configuration Edit `cordis.patch.yml` in the checkout and reinstall/reload the bundle. | Key | Value | Why | |---|---|---| | `serverName` | `rea` | Tool prefix `mcp__rea__` | | `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `600000` | Native analysis and provider startup can exceed the 60 s default | | `failOnStartupError` | `false` | A slow first npx download should reconnect, not fail the row | | `NPM_CONFIG_CACHE` | `!!js` → `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-rea/npm` | Avoid `EPERM` from a root-owned `~/.npm`; override with `DSH_REA_NPM_CACHE` | | `REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE` | `compact` | Keep the advertised catalog bounded | | `REA_MCP_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE` | `off` | Remove multi-megabyte output schemas | ## Troubleshooting ### `npm error code EPERM` / root-owned npm cache The `NPM_CONFIG_CACHE` expression in the patch points npx at `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-rea/npm` (or `/cache/dsh-rea/npm` when the profile directory is available), falling back to `~/.dsh/cache/dsh-rea/npm`. In the verified Desktop profile it resolved to `~/.dsh/cache/dsh-rea/npm`. If you need a different directory, set `DSH_REA_NPM_CACHE` in the environment of the Harness process (requires a Harness restart), or replace the `!!js` expression with a literal path. We do not recommend `sudo chown -R` on your whole npm cache just for this plugin. ### No `mcp__rea__*` tools - Run `node scripts/preflight.mjs`; it isolates Node/npm/REA problems from DSH. - Check that `npx` resolves to a Node version REA supports. - Check that the `rea-mcp` row is active and not `disabled`. - If the row failed to load, reload the bundle or restart the Harness. ### Duplicate REA registration Do **not** also run `rea setup --client dsh` for this profile. Both registrations would use `serverName: rea`; the MCP client rejects the duplicate and one tool set disappears. Pick one integration and remove the other. ### Use a specific Node installation The patch runs `npx` from `PATH`. To pin a Node 24 installation instead, replace the command with that Node binary and point `args` at the installed REA launcher (`/rea-agents/scripts/rea.mjs`, then `mcp`). Restart the Harness after editing. ### Optional: REA workflow skill REA also publishes an agent skill. Its own setup can install it into `~/.agents/skills`, which DSH discovers: ```bash npx -y rea-agents@6.7.0 setup --skill --dry-run npx -y rea-agents@6.7.0 setup --skill --yes ``` This is independent of the MCP connection provided by this bundle. ## Upgrade REA 1. Read the REA releas

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.description: DeepSeek 网页工作台 for DSH — 在侧栏列出 DeepSeek 网页版会话，点开即用完整网页对话，支持接力到当前或新任务。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-deepseek-webdesk

> **DeepSeek 网页工作台 for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** — 把 DeepSeek 网页版的会话列表搬进 DSH 侧栏，点开就是完整的网页对话，并支持把对话接力到当前任务或新建任务。

[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-3%20passed-brightgreen)](#开发)

![DeepSeek 网页工作台：左侧是网页版会话列表，右侧是完整网页对话](docs/screenshot-desk.png)

## 它是什么

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）桌面端插件。安装后，左侧栏「工作区」下面会多出一块 **「会话」**，直接列出你 DeepSeek 网页版里的历史会话；点任意一条，主区域打开完整的 `chat.deepseek.com`，并自动跳到那条对话。

不是浮层、不是侧栏面板、也不是新开浏览器——它复用 DSH 自带的内嵌浏览器租约，并把网页登录态一起带过来。

## 功能

- **侧栏会话列表**：网页版历史会话（标题 + 时间），20 秒自动刷新。
  - 悬停行显示 **置顶 / 删除**（与 DSH 工作区会话行同款交互；置顶同步 DeepSeek 云端，删除有确认弹窗）。
  - 点「会话」标题折叠/展开；底部「显示更多」每次多加载 20 条。
- **完整网页对话**：点会话进入独立 DeepSeek 页，页面铺满主内容区。
  - 顶部是插件自己的头部：`DeepSeek · 当前会话标题` + 刷新 / 接力 / 在浏览器打开 / 右侧栏。
  - 中文界面（DSH 渲染进程默认 `--lang=en-US`，插件会强制 DeepSeek 网页使用 `zh_CN`）。
- **自带登录态持久化（默认）**：第一次在 DeepSeek 页里正常登录后，插件会把网页的 `localStorage`（含 `userToken`）、可读 cookie 和真实 UA 存到本机 `~/.dsh/deepseek-webdesk/session.json`（权限 600）；之后打开网页、重启 DSH 都会自动装回，**不需要额外插件、也不用反复登录**。
  - 兼容回退：如果本机装了 [`dsh-deepseek-web-login`](https://github.com/cv-superding/dsh-deepseek-web-login) 且还没有自己的快照，会先用它的登录态完成首登，然后自动落盘到上面那份快照。
- **接力到 Harness**：两种去向，各支持「最后一条回复 / 整段对话 / 当前一轮问答」：
  - **插入到刚才的任务**：切回原会话，把内容作为草稿插入输入框并聚焦（失败复制到剪贴板）。
  - **新建任务继续**：在当前工作区新建一个 Harness 任务，内容直接填进新任务输入框。
- **单选中态**：进入 DeepSeek 页时工作区会话会取消选中，不会出现两个选中状态；点工作区任务即离开 DeepSeek 页。
- **可拖动窗口**：DeepSeek 页顶部工具条、侧栏「会话」标题行都是窗口拖动区域（按住拖动即可移动整个 DSH 窗口，不再选中文字）；「会话」的收起/展开箭头、`＋` 等按钮仍可点击。
- **全局唤出快捷键（可选附加组件）**：在 **设置 → 通用 → 全局唤出 DSH** 里开启/关闭、点「修改」录制新组合；默认 **macOS `⌥ Space`、Windows `Alt+Space`**。任意页面按一下唤出 DSH，再按一下隐藏。
  - `⌘W` 关掉窗口后也能唤回：助手检测 DSH 是否有可见窗口，没有就用 `dsh://open` 让 DSH 重新创建/聚焦主窗口（已实测）。
  - 实现：插件 Host 会编译并启动一个本地原生小助手（macOS 用 Swift 的 Carbon 全局热键，Windows 用 PowerShell + WinForms 全局热键），由它显示/隐藏整个 DSH 窗口；不需要给 DSH 主程序提权，也不依赖系统“聚焦”功能。
  - 助手二进制只在首次启用时编译到 `~/.dsh/deepseek-webdesk/helper/`（本机），卸载/停用插件后进程退出。

![DeepSeek 页（页面区域）](docs/screenshot-page.png)

## 安装

需要 DSH 桌面端（>= 0.2.1-rc.2）。

```sh
# 用 DSH 自带 CLI，以 link 方式装进 desktop profile
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add \
  "link:/path/to/dsh-deepseek-webdesk"
```

也可以从 GitHub 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zneoxlab/dsh-deepseek-webdesk
```

安装完成后重启 DSH（或等插件热加载），左侧栏会出现「会话」。

## 依赖与联动

- **必需**：DSH 桌面端的内嵌浏览器能力（`globalThis.dshDesktop.browser`）。
- **可选**：[`dsh-deepseek-web-login`](https://github.com/cv-superding/dsh-deepseek-web-login) —— 仅作为首次登录态的兜底来源，不是必需依赖。
- 插件 **Host 半** 优先用自己保存的 `~/.dsh/deepseek-webdesk/session.json`，没有时再读 `~/.dsh/web-login/` 的账号；拿到 token 后调用 DeepSeek 官方接口 `chat_session/fetch_page` 拉会话列表，通过同源路由 `/dsh-deepseek-webdesk/api/sessions` 交给客户端。token 只在本机请求头内使用，不打印、不上报。

## 开发

```sh
cd dsh-deepseek-webdesk
npm test        # node --test，Host 映射 + 客户端槽位注册
```

文件结构：

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `client.js` | 侧栏会话列表、主区域网页页、内嵌浏览器租约、共享登录、中文强制、接力 |
| `index.js` | Host 半：读网页登录账号、拉取/置顶/删除 DeepSeek 会话列表的 API |
| `cordis.patch.yml` / `package.json` | DSH bundle 与客户端模块清单 |
| `locale/*.json` | 插件管理器中显示的名称与说明 |
| `docs/` | 截图（会话标题已打码） |

## 隐私

- 会话列表与对话内容只在本机 DSH 进程与 DeepSeek 网页之间流转；登录快照只存本机 `~/.dsh/deepseek-webdesk/session.json`（chmod 600）。
- 删除/置顶走 DeepSeek 网页端同款接口，操作的是你自己的账号数据。
- 仓库里的截图已对个人会话标题打码。

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

---

<details>
<summary>English</summary>

**dsh-deepseek-webdesk** is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) desktop plugin that lists your `chat.deepseek.com` conversations in the DSH sidebar and opens the full web chat in the main area. It reuses DSH's embedded-browser lease and the web session captured by `dsh-deepseek-web-login`, forces the Chinese locale, and hands conversations off to the current Harness task or a brand-new one.

</details>

plugins.description: 一份能交出去的自查表、整改说明和合规证明
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-compliance-doc

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-compliance-doc)

**检查结果别只躺在终端里 —— 自查表、整改说明、带边界声明的合规证明，一次生成三份能直接交出去的文档。**

**关键词**：合规报告 · 自查表 · 整改说明 · 合规证明 · 等保三级 · 安全自查 · 整改复核 · 一键体检 · 交付文档 · 审计留痕

---

## 先说清楚它是什么、不是什么

**不装的代价**：扫描结果只在终端滚一遍屏，领导要「自查表」、客户要「整改说明」、
测评机构要「检查记录」，你还得手工从日志里一条条复制进 Excel —— 慢、容易漏、
格式还不统一；更麻烦的是，手写文档很容易顺手写一句「已合规」，把提示项说成结论。

**是**：把一份本地静态检查报告，整理成三份**可以直接交付**的文件：

| 文件 | 内容 | 谁看 |
|---|---|---|
| `自查表.csv` | 序号 / 检查项 / 严重度 / 依据 / 位置 / 状态 / 建议，UTF-8 BOM，Excel 双击就能开 | 执行整改的人 |
| `整改说明.md` | 背景、检查范围与方法、逐条问题 + 整改建议、复核方式 | 领导 / 客户 / 项目经理 |
| `合规证明.md` | 检查范围、规则条数、依据清单（去重）、结论措辞 | 对外提交 / 归档 |

**不是**：
- ❌ **不是合规认证** —— 静态检查证明不了合规，它只如实记录「规则库这一次查到了什么」
- ❌ **不是等保测评 / 监管检查 / 第三方审计的替代品** —— 那需要测评机构按标准现场核查
- ❌ **不产生新判据** —— 规则来自你已安装的深鲸守护插件，它只做整理和成文
- ❌ **不写「已合规」「保证通过」** —— 三份文件都带同一条声明，结论措辞按「提示项」而非「违规」表述

**一句话分界**：别的插件负责「查」，它负责把查出来的东西写成**能交出去、且有边界说明**的文档。

```
dsh-sbom / dsh-data-rights / ...  = 查
dsh-fix-verify                     = 复核改前改后
dsh-compliance-doc                 = 把上面两步的结果变成可交付文档
```

---

## 用法

```bash
# 从一个普通扫描报告生成三份文档
dsh-compliance-doc --input report.json --out ./交付文档

# 带单位名、检查日期、等保三级文档档次
dsh-compliance-doc --input report.json --out ./交付 \
  --org "某某科技有限公司" --date 2026-10-20 --profile 等保三级

# 配合 dsh-fix-verify：把改前改后复核结果整理成整改说明
dsh-fix-verify --before old --after new --json > fix-verify.json
dsh-compliance-doc --input fix-verify.json --out ./交付 --org "某某科技有限公司"
```

输出目录不存在会**自动创建**。

### 输入兼容两种 JSON

**① 普通 / suite 扫描报告**（`dsh-guard-core` 的标准输出）：

```json
{ "generatedAt": "...", "stats": { "scannedFiles": 34, "rulesRun": 12, ... }, "findings": [ ... ] }
```

**② `dsh-fix-verify` 的复核报告**：顶层有 `fixed` / `remaining` / `regressed` 数组。

字段不对、JSON 坏、输入缺失 → **exit 2**，不会硬编一份「看起来正常」的文档。

---

## 措辞红线（三份文件都写）

> 本文件由本地静态检查生成，不构成合规结论，不替代等保测评/监管检查/第三方审计。

- 不出现「已合规」「保证通过」「绝对合规」这类结论；
- 规则未命中时 `合规证明.md` 会写「本次检查覆盖 N 条规则、M 个文件，未发现提示项」，
  同时明确提醒「**未命中不等于没有问题**」；
- `--profile 等保三级` 只影响**文档组织方式**，不改变规则集，也不构成等保测评结论。

---

## 输出示例

```
  ✅ 自查表.csv        3 条检查项，Excel 可直接打开
  ✅ 整改说明.md       背景 / 范围与方法 / 逐条问题与建议 / 复核方式
  ✅ 合规证明.md       范围 / 规则条数 / 依据清单 / 结论措辞

  扫描    34 个文件 · 运行规则 12 条
  提示项  3 条（高 1 · 中 1 · 低 1）
```

### 退出码

| 码 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `0` | 三份文件正常生成 |
| `2` | 输入缺失 / JSON 解析失败 / 字段不对 / 参数错误 |

---

## 不要做什么

- 不要把它生成的 `合规证明.md` 当成「合规证书」对外使用 —— 它只是检查记录
- 不要删掉文件里的免责声明 —— 那句话是这份文档能用的前提
- 不要在输入报告为空时断定「项目没问题」—— 未命中不等于没有问题
- 不要把它当扫描器 —— 它不跑规则，只整理报告
- 不要用 `--profile 等保三级` 暗示已经做过等保测评 —— 那只影响文档排版

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-compliance-doc
```

## License

MIT © 深鲸 DeepWhale

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 39 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规**（12）｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理**（6）｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据**（5）｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

plugins.description: Model ordering, three-tier token prices, and per-turn/session cost estimates for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-model-billing

为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 调整模型顺序，并按轮次估算模型费用。

中文 · English · Changelog

> **AI 生成声明**：本项目的代码、文档和图标由 AI 辅助生成，并经人工审核、修改和测试；发布者对最终发布内容负责。 > > **AI-generated notice**: The code, documentation, and icon in this project were generated with AI assistance, then reviewed, modified, and tested by a human; the publisher is responsible for the released content. ## 中文 `dsh-model-billing` 是一个 DSH Web 客户端插件。它接管输入框右下角的模型选择器，让你按自己的顺序排列模型，并为每个模型维护三档 token 价格；会话过程中按实际 usage 估算每一轮和整个会话的费用。 ### 功能 - **自定义模型顺序**：在“设置 → 模型与费用”中用 ↑ / ↓ 调整已配置模型的顺序。模型选择器按这个顺序展示，跨提供方也保持你排的顺序，并用提供方名称分组。 - **三档 token 价格**：每个非 DeepSeek 模型可填写每百万 tokens 的缓存命中输入、缓存未命中输入、输出价格。`0` 是有效价格，留空表示未设置。 - **DeepSeek 官方价内置**：`deepseek-flash` 和 `deepseek-v4-pro` 直接使用 DeepSeek 官网的峰谷价，只读展示，不需要填写。 - **逐轮费用**：每轮结束后在轮尾显示该轮费用。 - **本会话费用**：输入框下方显示本会话累计估算、最近一轮费用和缓存命中率；展开后可查看按轮次和按模型的明细。 - **DeepSeek 也计入金额**：每条 usage 按事件发生时的北京时间自动选择高峰或空闲价，与第三方模型一起进入统计。 ### 估算口径 ```text 缓存命中输入 × 命中价 +（未缓存输入 + 缓存写入）× 未命中价 + 输出 × 输出价 ``` 价格单位是“元 / 百万 tokens”。缓存写入按缓存未命中价计算，这是三档价格模型下的近似处理。金额来自会话日志中的 provider usage，实际账单以 provider 为准。 ### DeepSeek 官方价 以下价格内置在 [`host.js`](host.js) 的 `DEEPSEEK_PRICES` 中，单位“元 / 百万 tokens”。来源：[DeepSeek 模型 & 价格](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/)（查询于 2026-10-19）。 | 模型 | 时段 | 缓存命中 | 缓存未命中 | 输出 | |---|---|---:|---:|---:| | deepseek-flash | 高峰 | 0.04 | 2 | 8 | | deepseek-flash | 空闲 | 0.02 | 1 | 4 | | deepseek-v4-pro | 高峰 | 0.30 | 9 | 27 | | deepseek-v4-pro | 空闲 | 0.15 | 4.5 | 13.5 | 高峰时段为北京时间周一至周五 `9:00–12:00`、`14:00–18:00`（中国法定节假日除外）；其余时间、周末和法定节假日全天为空闲时段。空闲价是高峰价的一半。 DeepSeek 价格只读，不写入本地价格配置。官网调价或节假日安排变化后，需要更新 `host.js` 中的 `DEEPSEEK_PRICES` 和 `DEEPSEEK_HOLIDAYS`；目前内置的是 2026 年节假日。 ### 其他模型价格 插件**不预置**第三方模型价格。首次使用时，在“设置 → 模型与费用”中按 provider 的官方价填写三档价格即可；未填完整价格的模型不会产生金额，界面会标记“未定价”或“部分未定价”。 不同平台的缓存折扣、上下文阶梯价和活动价差异较大，建议直接使用你的实际结算价。插件不做自动抓取，也不猜测默认价。 ### 安装 **npm** ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-model-billing ``` **从 dsh-market 安装** 在 dsh-market 中搜索 `dsh-model-billing` 安装。 **从 GitHub Release 手动安装** 1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/likaileave/dsh-model-billing/releases) 下载 `dsh-model-billing.tgz`。 2. 执行： ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-model-billing.tgz ``` 把 `desktop` 换成你实际使用的 profile。 **从源码安装** ```sh git clone https://github.com/likaileave/dsh-model-billing.git dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-model-billing ``` 安装或更新后刷新 Web 页面。设置页位于“模型与费用”。 ### 发布 npm 包和 GitHub Release 使用相同版本号，两个渠道分别发布： - npm： - GitHub Releases： 两个渠道是并列的发布渠道，不承诺自动同步。 ### 数据位置 模型顺序和价格保存在： ```text ~/.dsh/model-billing.json ``` 若设置了 `DSH_HOME`，则为 `$DSH_HOME/model-billing.json`。保存时先写临时文件再原子替换；文件损坏时回退为空配置，不会在未保存的情况下覆盖原文件。 ### 已知限制 - 模型选择器由本插件接管，依赖 `ctx.modelDirectories`。该服务不可用时，插件不会强行覆盖内置选择器，价格和费用统计不受影响。 - `/model` 命令仍由 DSH 自带实现，顺序不保证与右下角选择器一致。 - 一轮里的多次模型尝试（重试、失败等）会分别计入；失败调用如果 provider 没有返回 usage，则无法计入。 - 只统计当前载入 Host 的会话；未打开的历史会话在进入后按需计算。 - 第三方价格是静态配置，不会自动跟随官网调价。 ### 开发 ```sh node --check host.js node --check client.js node --test test/host.test.mjs test/routes.test.mjs ``` 当前 10 个测试通过。插件没有运行时 npm 依赖。 ### License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 likaileave --- ## English `dsh-model-billing` is a DSH Web GUI plugin that takes over the composer's model picker, lets you order configured models yourself, stores three per-million-token prices per model, and estimates per-turn and session cost from provider usage. ### Features - **Custom model order** in Settings → Models & Cost; the composer picker follows that order across providers and groups models by provider. - **Three prices per model**: cache-hit input, cache-miss input, and output, in CNY per million tokens. `0` is a valid price; blank means unset. - **Built-in official DeepSeek pricing** for `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro`, selected per usage event between peak and off-peak Beijing time. - **Per-turn amount** at the end of each turn. - **Session summary** below the composer plus a detail panel grouped by turn and by model. - **DeepSeek is billed too**, using the same three-price formula and the event's timestamp. ### Cost formula ```text cache-hit input × hit price + (uncached input + cache write) × miss price + output × output price ``` Prices are CNY per million tokens. Cache writes are approximated at the cache-miss price. Figures come from provider usage in the session log; the provider's invoice is authoritative. The plugin ships **no third-party price defaults**. Enter your provider's actual rates in Settings → Models & Cost. Models without a complete three-price set are marked as unpriced and contribute no amount. DeepSeek prices are read-only and built into `host.js`. ### Install **npm** ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-model-billing ``` **From dsh-market** Search for `dsh-model-billing` in dsh-market. **From a GitHub Release** Download `dsh-model-billing.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/likaileave/dsh-model-billing/releases), then: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-model-billing.tgz ``` **From a checkout** ```sh git clone https://github.com/likaileave/dsh-model-billing.git dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-model-billing ``` Refresh the Web page after installing or updating. ### Release channels The npm package and the GitHub Release use the same version number and are published separately: - npm: - GitHub Releases: They are parallel distribution channels, not an automatic mirror. ### Data Order and prices live in `~/.dsh/model-billing.json` (or `$DSH_HOME/model-billing.json`). Writes use a temporary file plus atomic replace. ### Limitations - The custom picker depends on `ctx.modelDirectories`; when that service is unavailable the plugin leaves the built-in picker alone. - The `/model` command is still implemented by DSH and may not follow the custom order. - Multiple attempts within a turn are counted separately; failed calls without provider usage cannot be counted. - Only sessions loaded by the current Host are counted. - Third-party prices are static and are not refreshed automatically. ### License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 likaileave

plugins.description: 让文本模型读懂一首歌：本地音乐分析插件，把音频拆成能量、速度、调性、密度，音频不出本机。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-soundcheck

> 文本模型看不见声音。这个插件把一首歌拆成它能读的东西。

丢一首本地音频给它，它把能量、速度、调性、编曲密度量一遍，
再合成一段人话——哪里最满、哪一下反差最大、收尾是淡出还是硬切。

**它不是让模型"听见"，是让模型"读懂"。** 没有多模态，也能对一首歌说上话；
代价是它只知道结构，不知道声音长什么样——人声、歌词、乐器只给方向，
能说的和不能说的它都会标出来。

说白了：**给一首歌做体检**。时长、响度、有没有削波、拍速、调性这些硬指标它说得比较准。

**音频不出本机。** 没有上传、没有联网、没有云端分析。

---

## 它真能帮上什么

不是吹的，下面这些是从实际对话里试出来的：

**一首老钢琴曲**，它能说出：
> 4 分 10 秒、99 拍；D# 大调但不太稳；前 16 秒几乎空着，之后一路铺满；
> 2:24 之后越往后越密；3:12 抽空 18 dB，3:28 又砸回来；4:00 淡出但底下还有东西。

它报告里说的那三件事，在曲线上就是三个点：

![能量曲线：3:12 抽空、3:28 砸回、4:00 淡出](docs/energy-piano.png)

**一首古筝领奏的器乐**：
> 慢热型：前 32 秒铺垫，1:52 最密，2:24 开始加厚，4:32 塌下去、4:48 硬收尾。
> 和声一直在 D–E–F# 上打转，听感偏五声。

它还押了一句"民族/东方融合、偏配乐或国风电子"——**方向是对的，但这是推断，不是测量**。

**一份只有鼓和贝斯的半成品**：
> 低频占满、中高频空着；峰值 −3.7 dBFS、整体 −21.8 dBFS，还有 6–8 dB 余量。

这种"还差多少电平"的判断，对做混音的人最直接。

它不是在"听懂"，它是把能量、密度、调性这些量出来，再合成一段判断。

---

## 它是怎么做到的

本机解码，然后算几样东西：

- **能量曲线**：16 秒一块，绝对 dBFS，不归一化；
- **节拍**：两条独立算法交叉验证，所以能发现"半速/双倍速"；
- **调性**：Krumhansl 模板 + 候选排序，模板不适用时会直说；
- **和弦**：只到根音级，不硬猜大/小三度和七度；
- **编曲密度**：起音密度、频谱变化率，用来判断"满不满"；
- **声源**：一个 16 MB 的小模型看"像什么"，只当方向。

最后把这些合成三段：`[判断]`（结论）、`[依据]`（数字）、`[可信]`（哪些能信）。

没有大模型，不联网，音频不出本机。

你看到的三个能力，其实是三种问法：

- `audio_analyze` —— 整首
- `audio_section` —— 某一段
- `audio_provision` —— 装运行环境（`/audio-install` 背后就是它，也可以让助手直接调）

---

## 装

**需要**：Windows、Python 3.10+（命令行能跑 `python -V`）、约 550 MB 磁盘、第一次要联网。

**三种装法，选一个：**

1. DSH 插件管理界面 → 从本地文件夹安装
2. 命令行：
   ```
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<你解压出来的目录>"
   ```
3. 直接跟 DSH 说："把这个插件装上，目录是 ……"，让它自己装。

装完**重启 DSH**。

然后装运行环境——**这一步不会自己偷偷开始**，得你点一下：

- 在 DSH 里输入 **`/audio-install`**（`/` 菜单里能看到，带说明）
- 它会告诉你：要下约 **470 MB**（librosa + onnxruntime + 16 MB 模型），大概几分钟，走国内镜像
- 装完再输入 **`/audio-status`** 可以确认状态

不想点也行，直接跟 DSH 说："帮我把音频插件的引擎装好"——它会自己从头装到尾，不用你敲命令。

之后每次分析只要几秒。

---

## 怎么问

不用记命令，像跟人说话就行：

- "这首歌怎么样？"
- "副歌在哪？哪一段最满？"
- "2:40 到 3:10 这段怎么回事？"
- "速度多少？什么调？"
- "这歌是什么风格？"

追问 **"为什么"** 会给数字；追问 **"像什么"** 会给方向，并标上"这是推断"。

还有个好用的问法：**"如果我猜错了，应该听到什么？"** —— 它会给你一个反证条件，你听一遍就能否掉。

---

## 一句提醒

这是个**轻量**插件，没有大模型撑着。

结构、速度、响度、调性这些硬信息，它说得比较准；乐器和风格只能给方向——别拿它当严谨鉴定，尤其别拿它断中文乐器和细分流派。

---

## 许可

MIT。

第三方依赖与模型（librosa、scipy、onnxruntime、YAMNet 等）的许可见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

plugins.description: Model-driven tool-result archiving for DeepSeek Harness: long results carry an inline id, the model archives the ones it no longer needs into the session's own folder, and a recoverable stub stays in context.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-archive

让**模型自己**决定哪些工具结果可以离开上下文，并把它们归档到**本会话自己的目录**里。

和"按大小自动剪枝"的插件不同，这里的触发权在模型手里：它知道哪份输出已经读完了、哪份后面还要引用。

## 怎么告诉插件"这份可以归档了"

**不需要先列清单。** 每个 ≥800 字符的纯文本结果在写入上下文时，会自动带一行内联编号：

```
[#a1b2c3d4 · 24810 chars]
npm run build ...
```

模型看到哪个编号不要了，直接一次调用把它们全部归档：

```
context_archive { ids: ["a1b2c3d4", "9f3e0b21"], note: "已提取所需字段" }
```

`context_archive {}`（不传 ids）仍然可用，它会返回一份带工具名和首行预览的清单，用于**发现**：老结果没有内联编号、或者模型想确认还有哪些可归档时用。

编号 = 结果正文（去掉那行前缀后）的 sha256 前 8 位，纯函数推导，不依赖任何映射表。

归档后，那条结果在上下文里变成三行存根：

```
[archived #a1b2c3d4 · bash · 24810 chars / 612 lines]
file: ...\sessions\...\<session-id>\archives\a1b2c3d4.txt
first: npm run build ...
```

## 归档去哪

```
~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace-slug>/<session-id>/archives/
├── a1b2c3d4.txt      # 原文（带 session/seq/tool/时间/note 头）
└── index.json        # 归档索引：编号 → seq / 工具 / 字符数 / note / 时间
```

会话目录由 DSH 的 `sessionPersistence.locate()` 解析，不靠拼字符串；拿不到该服务时回退到
`projectKey(cwd)` + 会话 id 的等价路径。会话被删除时归档随目录一起消失，不会留垃圾。

## 行为保证

- **原文永不丢失**：先写归档文件，再改上下文；文件写失败就不替换。
- **只增日志**：替换是一次 `surfaceOp: { op: 'replace' }` 的 `tool/result` 追加，原始事件仍在只增日志里，replay 可复现。
- **只改 content**：按宿主校验规则，替换保留 `turn`/`step`/`message.source` 等全部字段。
- **幂等**：同一编号再归档返回 `already_archived`，不会套娃。
- **护栏**：最近 `keep_turns`（默认 3 轮）内的工具结果不可归档，`0` 表示不设护栏；含图片等非文本块的结果不归档；单次最多 20 条。
- **失败放行**：任何一条出错只影响它自己，返回逐条状态，不抛异常。

## 配置

三层，优先级从高到低：**单次调用参数 > 运行时文件 > profile 配置**。

### 运行时文件（改完立即生效，不用重启）

`~/.dsh/context-archive.json`：

```json
{
  "keepTurns": 3,
  "annotate": true,
  "annotateMinChars": 2000,
  "minChars": 2000,
  "maxAnnotated": 200
}
```

插件在每次用到配置时重新读取它（mtime 缓存），所以**下一条工具结果就会按新值处理**。设置面板改的就是这个文件；手改同样生效；删掉文件即回到 profile 配置。

### profile 配置（初始默认值，装载时读取）

`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: context-archive
  name: dsh-context-archive
  config:
    keepTurns: 3
    annotate: true
    annotateMinChars: 2000
    minChars: 800
```

注意这是**顶层数组**，把这段插到数组里（不要新建一层 `config:`）。改完需要重启。

| 键 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `keepTurns` | 3 | 最近多少轮保持不动；0 = 全部可归档 |
| `annotate` | true | 是否在长结果前加一行内联编号 |
| `minChars` | 2000 | 唯一的归档阈值：≥ 它的结果才带编号、才进清单 |
| `nudge` | true | 有 ≥5 条可归档时，每 40 个事件最多提醒一次 |
| `maxAnnotated` | 200 | 同时存在的编号上限；0 = 不限，达到上限后新结果不再编号 |

阈值只有一个：编号和清单共用。带编号的结果形如 `[#a1b2c3d4]`（13 字符），不再附带大小。

### 单次调用覆盖

| 参数 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `keep_turns` | 配置值 | 覆盖本轮调用的轮次护栏 |
| `min_chars` | 配置值 | 覆盖本轮清单的最小长度 |
| `limit` | 40 | 清单最多返回条数 |
| `stats` | false | 返回分桶回收统计，不改动任何内容 |
| `note` | — | 归档原因，写入归档文件头与索引 |

配置非法（负数、非整数、`annotate` 非布尔）时插件会**明确报错并拒绝装载**，不会半加载。

## 统计面板

装好后侧栏（better-sidebar）多一个「上下文归档」tab，上半部分是分桶统计，下半部分就是上面四个阈值，改完点保存即时生效。

### 为什么不是每次扫日志

3 千条结果扫一遍约 1 秒；30 万条就没法用了。所以分母是**增量折叠**的：

- 订阅 `session/event`，每个 `tool/result` 落一条就按大小进桶，O(1)；
- 每个会话记一个 `lastSeq`，同一个 seq 只折一次（重启、resume、事件重放都不会重复计数）；
- 第一次见到某个会话时，从它的内存前缀**回填一次**，之后只处理新增；
- 计数写在 `~/.dsh/context-archive-stats.json`（1.5 秒防抖落盘，退出前 flush）。

装好或升级后第一次打开面板会做一次全量 `reconcile`（就是原来的扫盘），把已存在的会话折进计数器并写入各自的 `lastSeq`，之后不再扫。
需要手动重建时：`GET /dsh-context-archive/stats?reconcile=1`。

### 口径

- **结果数**：所有会话里的 `tool/result`（存根不计）。
- **已编号**：带内联编号的结果——**只有这些才可能被回收**，所以回收率的分母用它，而不是全部结果。历史结果没有编号，混进分母只会把回收率稀释成 0.1%。
- **分子**：各会话 `archives/index.json` 里的条目（条目本来就不多，每次读一遍很便宜）。
- **打平率** `p* = 前缀成本(13) / (平均正文 − 平均存根)`：这一档的回收率要高于它，编号才划算。
- **结论**：每桶至少 3 条归档样本才判「划算 / 不划算」，否则「样本不足」。

面板里的「推荐阈值」是**第一个被观测到划算的桶**，样本不足时不给建议。

同样的数据也能让模型取：`context_archive { stats: true }`。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context-archive
```

从源码开发时用本地链接（改代码即时生效，但**要重启 DSH** 才会重新导入）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<path-to-this-folder>
```

开发验证：

```sh
npm test    # node --test，38 个用例，零依赖
```

## 安全说明

- **不联外网**：没有任何出站请求；只在 DSH 自己的回环服务器上注册两个同源端点 `GET /dsh-context-archive/stats`、`GET|POST /dsh-context-archive/config`（后者只写上面那个 JSON 文件，输入按白名单校验、上限 4 KB）。
- **会写盘**：归档文件是工具输出的**原文**，可能包含密钥、令牌或隐私内容；它们落在 `~/.dsh/sessions/<...>/<session-id>/archives/`（与你自己的 DSH 数据同权限），随会话删除而删除。不要在共享机器上归档敏感输出。
- **会改上下文**：归档通过一次 `tool/result` 的表面替换实现（只改 `content`，保留 `turn`/`step`/`callId`），原始事件永久保留在只增日志里，可回放、可回捞。
- **失败放行**：写盘失败、校验不通过、找不到会话时一律保持原样，不会把成功调用变成错误。

## 已知限制

- 需要在**下一次**模型请求时才看到替换后的短存根（本轮的请求已经发出）。
- 内联编号只加在插件启用**之后**产生的结果上；更早的历史结果仍可用 `context_archive {}` 列出后归档。
- 插件改动后要**重启 DSH** 才生效（Node 的 ESM 模块缓存不会随重装刷新）。
- 存根里的 `first:` 预览是压平后的前 120 字符，不含完整摘要；需要细节时按路径 `read`/`grep`。
- 与 `dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` 不冲突（存根远小于其 8192 字符阈值），但两者同时开启时以先到者为准。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-playwright-cli

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-playwright-cli)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-playwright-cli)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-playwright-cli)](LICENSE)

Drive a real browser from **DeepSeek Harness**: one tool, `playwright_cli`, wraps
[`microsoft/playwright-cli`](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli), plus a bundled
`playwright-cli` skill that teaches the model the command vocabulary.

playwright-cli itself recommends *CLI + skills* over MCP for coding agents: commands are short, and
the page snapshot goes to a file instead of a giant tool schema or accessibility tree. This plugin
keeps that design and only adds the two missing pieces — a tool the model can call, and a skill that
is discovered and loaded on demand.

中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)。

## Install

**In the app:** **Plugins → Plugin Manager → install bundle → `dsh-playwright-cli`**.

**From a shell**, when the Harness CLI is on your PATH:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-playwright-cli
```

**From an agent:** `plugin_manager` with `action: install_bundle`, `target: dsh-playwright-cli`.

> PATH collisions are common on Windows (`dsh` may belong to another product). If `dsh plugin` is not
> the Harness CLI, use the in-app Plugin Manager.

`playwright-cli` must be available on the machine:

```bash
npm install -g @playwright/cli@latest
```

And a browser has to exist — playwright-cli ships none. Either download its Chromium once:

```bash
playwright-cli install-browser chrome-for-testing
```

or reuse a browser that is already installed, which needs no download at all:

```text
playwright_cli  open https://example.com --browser=msedge
```

## Quick start

```text
playwright_cli  open https://playwright.dev --browser=msedge
playwright_cli  snapshot --depth=4
   → [artifacts] C:\...\.playwright-cli\page-....yml   (read this file to get refs)
playwright_cli  click e15
playwright_cli  fill e7 "user@example.com"
playwright_cli  screenshot --filename=shot.png
playwright_cli  close
```

Every result carries the page status, the artifacts it produced (absolute paths), and the CLI's exit
code. `--raw` returns just the value, e.g. `--raw eval "document.title"`.

## Tool parameters

| Parameter | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | yes | One playwright-cli command without the `playwright-cli` prefix. Quote arguments containing spaces. |
| `session` | no | Named browser session (`-s=<name>`), for isolating parallel tasks. |
| `workdir` | no | Working directory; artifacts land in `<workdir>/.playwright-cli/`. Defaults to the session directory. |
| `timeoutMs` | no | Per-call wall clock limit (default from config, capped at 900000). |

## Configuration

Every field is optional and lives in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` under the `playwright-cli` row:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `executable` | auto-discovered | Absolute path to `playwright-cli.js` (run with `nodePath`) or to a real executable |
| `nodePath` | `node` from PATH | Node used for the CLI *and* the browser daemon it spawns |
| `session` | none | Default session name |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | Per-command limit |
| `disableUpdateNotifier` | `true` | Sets `NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1` (see the Node 24 note below) |
| `env` | `{}` | Extra environment, e.g. `PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_BROWSER: chrome` |

## How it works

- **No shell.** The command line is tokenized and passed as an argv vector to
  `node playwright-cli.js …`, so `&` in URLs, spaces in paths, `--data="k=v"` and Windows quoting
  cannot corrupt a command.
- **Discovery.** It walks up from the session directory looking for a local
  `node_modules/@playwright/cli` or `node_modules/playwright`, then checks the usual global npm,
  pnpm and Homebrew locations. `executable` overrides all of it.
- **Real Node, not the Host binary.** The desktop Host runs as Electron-as-node
  (`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`), so `process.execPath` is the app binary. playwright-cli re-spawns its
  browser daemon with that path and dies with `too many arguments`; the plugin therefore resolves a
  real `node` from PATH first.
- **Exit codes are honest.** playwright-cli's update notifier crashes the process *after* a successful
  command on Node 24 (exit code becomes `0xC0000409`); the notifier is disabled by default.
- **Artifacts are files.** Snapshots, screenshots, PDFs, videos, traces and console logs are resolved
  to absolute paths and listed under `[artifacts]`, so the model reads them with `read` / `read_image`
  instead of paying for them in the result.
- **Hints, not guesses.** The two first-run failures (no browser installed, browser not started) get
  an extra `[hint]` line with the exact next command.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `playwright-cli is not installed or was not found` | no local/global install | `npm i -g @playwright/cli@latest`, or set `executable` |
| `Browser "chrome-for-testing" is not installed` | no bundled browser | `playwright_cli install-browser chrome-for-testing`, or `--browser=msedge` |
| `Chromium distribution 'chrome' is not found` | Chrome not in its default path | `--browser=msedge` or `--browser=chrome` |
| `too many arguments. Expected 1 argument but got 2` | CLI launched with the Electron binary | leave `nodePath` unset so the plugin resolves `node` |
| `The browser '<name>' is not open` | session idle-closed or never opened | `open` again (add `--persistent` to keep the profile) |
| `百度安全验证` page on Baidu | site-level anti-automation captcha | not a plugin bug: report the wall, try another engine |
| snapshot only has header/footer | results rendered after the command returned | re-run `snapshot`, or use `find "<text>"` |

## Maintaining this plugin

### Repository layout

| Path | Owns | Update it when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Tool schema, spawn, discovery, artifacts, hints, presenters | CLI flags/output shape change, or DSH's `ToolDefinition` changes |
| `skill.js` | Model-facing skill text (command table, loop, triage) | the command surface changes |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Loader row + default config + field comments | you add a config key |
| `locale/*.json`, `icon.svg` | Plugin Manager title, description, icon | wording/branding |
| `README.md`, `README.zh.md` | user + maintainer docs | any behavior change |

### Adapting to a new playwright-cli release

1. `npm view @playwright/cli version`, then `npm i -g @playwright/cli@latest`.
2. `playwright-cli --help` — compare the command list with the table in `skill.js`. The skill *is* the
   model's contract, so keep it in sync before anything else.
3. Check `open` / `attach` flags (`--browser`, `--device`, `--persistent`, `--profile`, `--config`).
   New flags normally need docs only, no code.
4. Check the output markers: `### Page`, `### Snapshot`, `[Snapshot](.playwright-cli/…)`, `### Events`
   with `console-….log#L1-L6`. If a path shape changes, adjust `MARKDOWN_LINK`, `FILE_TOKEN` and the
   `#L…` stripping in `collectArtifacts()`.
5. Check session selection: the plugin passes `-s=<name>` **and** sets `PLAYWRIGHT_CLI_SESSION`. If a
   release starts rejecting one of them, drop the env assignment in `execute()`.
6. Check the error strings matched by `hintFor()`: `is not installed`,
   `Chromium distribution 'chrome' is not found`, `is not open, please run open first`.
7. Run the smoke test below, then bump the version and the changelog.

### The output schema is enforced

DSH validates the tool's returned value against `output.schema`; a mismatch fails the whole call with
`returned invalid output`. Declare every nullable field as
`oneOf: [{type:'string'}, {type:'null'}]` (this bit us once with `signal: null`), and build the
returned object and the schema together.

### Adapting to a new DSH release

1. `dsh --version`; only raise `engines.dsh` when you depend on something new.
2. Re-check the four services the plugin uses. In a live session: `cordis_inspect_query` with
   `platform: host`, `provider: Service`, `input: {"service":"tools"}` (also `subprocess`, `skills`,
   `workingDirectory`).
3. Confirm `ctx.subprocess.resolveExecutable('node')` s

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（95 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 95 plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goes

plugins.description: Archived-conversation workspace for DeepSeek Harness: browse with previews, restore, recycle, and permanently delete — batch actions, crash-safe transactions, and an Agent-callable tool. 归档会话工作台：预览、恢复、回收站、彻底删除，支持批量与 Agent 调用。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archive-desk · 归档工作台

> **Archived-conversation manager for DeepSeek Harness** — browse, restore, recycle, and permanently delete archived sessions.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-archive-desk.svg?style=flat)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-archive-desk)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-archive-desk.svg?style=flat)](./LICENSE)

![dsh-archive-desk · 归档工作台](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LumiDesk/dsh-archive-desk/main/docs/assets/social-preview.png)

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）只提供「归档」：它把会话 id 藏进 `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json`，日志继续留在磁盘上，界面上再没有任何删除入口。这个插件补上后半段——**看得见、恢复得了、删得掉**，并且把同一套能力开放给 Agent。

## 界面

侧栏点「归档工作台」进入整页管理：「已归档」与「回收站」两个页签，支持按标题 / 摘要 / 项目搜索、排序、分页、多选与批量删除；删除默认进回收站，彻底删除要显式选择 + 知情确认。列表首次加载显示骨架屏，刷新时保留旧数据。

## 为什么需要它

| 不装插件                                                                 | 装上之后                                              |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| 归档会话只能靠 `archivedFilter` 在侧栏里翻                               | 一个完整的管理页：状态、搜索、排序、分页、批量操作    |
| 想删只能手改 `workspace.json` + 手动删目录（还容易被运行中的宿主写回去） | 删除走注册表 API 与事务化文件操作，不会与内存状态打架 |
| 删错了无法恢复                                                           | 默认移入回收站，可恢复；彻底删除要二次确认 + 知情勾选 |
| Agent 完全够不着归档                                                     | `archived_conversations` 工具：列、删到回收站、恢复   |

## 能力

| 能力         | 说明                                                                                       |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 归档列表     | 侧栏图标 → 中间整页，展示标题、摘要、项目、时间、体积、状态                                |
| 状态区分     | `运行中` / `未关闭` / `失效` / 正常；运行中的会话不会误判为可删除                          |
| 搜索与排序   | 按标题 / 摘要 / 项目 / cwd / id 过滤；最近活动 / 体积 / 标题 / 归档顺序                    |
| 分页         | 每页 10 / 20 / 50，删除后自动校正页码                                                      |
| 批量操作     | 多选、当前页全选、选择全部筛选结果、批量删除/取消归档                                      |
| 取消归档     | 行内或批量把会话移出归档集合；文件不动，侧栏行回到原项目                                   |
| 删除确认     | 默认放入回收站；彻底删除需主动切换 + 勾选「不可恢复」                                      |
| 回收站       | 删除默认移入 `~/.dsh/archive-desk/trash/`，可恢复；分页、批量恢复/彻底删除/清空            |
| 损坏条目     | 回收站里缺 meta 或 payload 的条目仍可见，只允许删除                                        |
| 失效引用清理 | 指向已不存在会话的归档记录，一键移除（只删引用，不动文件）                                 |
| 会话菜单     | 会话「…」菜单里对已归档会话多一行「删除」，复用同一个确认弹窗                              |
| Agent 工具   | `archived_conversations`：`list` / `unarchive` / `delete`（进回收站）/ `trash` / `restore` |

### 状态是什么意思

| 状态     | 判定                                                          | 能否删除             |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| `运行中` | 会话已加载，且 DSH 的 `workspace/session-activity` 报告有活动 | 否                   |
| `未关闭` | 会话已加载，但没有活动——只是还开在主面板里                    | 否，先切换到其他会话 |
| `失效`   | 归档 id 存在，但 `sessions/` 下找不到目录                     | 只能移除归档引用     |
| 正常     | 目录存在、未加载、无活动                                      | 是                   |

DSH 的 `sessions.get(id)` 只代表「已加载」，不代表「正在运行」。本插件用 DSH 自己的活动瀑布（turn / job / 定时任务 / 子 Agent）判断运行状态，避免结束了的对话被误标。

### 删除到底做了什么

一个会话被删除时，插件按固定顺序处理，任何一步失败都会留下可解释的状态：

1. 会话目录移入回收站（或彻底删除）；
2. 删除投影缓存 `storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`（派生数据，可重建）；
3. 从所属 workspace 的成员列表里摘掉；
4. 从 `archivedSessionIds` 里移除；
5. 发出 `api-session/removed`，侧栏行立即消失。

运行中或仍打开的会话一律跳过；附件目录 `~/.dsh/attachments` 永不触碰（内容寻址、跨会话共享）。

### 性能

列表不再每次请求重读所有日志：

- 一次扫描 `sessions/*` 建立会话路径索引；
- 列表摘要写入 `~/.dsh/archive-desk/summaries.json`，用「目录大小 + 最新 mtime」做条件缓存；
- 未命中的会话最多 4 路并发读取；
- 删除确认只查选中项（`inspect`），不拉全量列表；
- 客户端首次加载显示骨架屏，刷新保留旧数据，快速搜索会取消旧请求。

## 安装

```bash
# 在 DSH 的 profile 里安装（dsh 会把参数转发给 pnpm）
dsh plugin add dsh-archive-desk
```

也可以从本仓库安装：`dsh plugin add github:LumiDesk/dsh-archive-desk`，或在 DSH 里用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle` 指向本地目录。**从本地目录安装前先 `pnpm build`**，`dist/` 不入库。安装后出现在「设置 → 插件」，侧栏出现「归档工作台」图标。

要求：DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`（本机验收版本）或更高。

## 使用

1. 点侧栏的「归档工作台」→ 打开管理页；「已归档」列出全部归档会话，「回收站」是待清理的。
2. 勾选会话 →「删除」→ 选「放入回收站」或「彻底删除」→ 确认；也可以点「取消归档」把它移出归档集合。
3. 取消归档只改 `archivedSessionIds`，不移动/删除文件；侧栏行会回到原项目。
4. 已归档会话的「…」菜单里也有「删除」，点了会跳到管理页并弹出同一个确认框。
5. 顶部横幅会提示有多少条引用已经失效（日志被删但归档 id 还在），点按钮一键清掉。
6. 回收站里可以单行或批量恢复、彻底删除，也可以清空整个回收站。

给 Agent 用：

```jsonc
{ "action": "list", "query": "登录", "limit": 10 }          // 看
{ "action": "unarchive", "ids": ["session-…"] }             // 取消归档，文件不动
{ "action": "delete", "ids": ["session-…"], "confirm": true } // 删到回收站
{ "action": "trash", "limit": 20 }                           // 看回收站
{ "action": "restore", "trashIds": ["2026…-session-…"] }     // 恢复
```

彻底删除**不开放给工具**：批量、不可恢复的操作留给人在面板里做。

## 无配置

这个插件没有 `settings.json`、插件配置页或环境变量开关。

- 每页条数、排序是页面上的可见控件，默认 20 / 最近活动，不持久化；
- Agent 只能删到回收站，彻底删除只由人操作；
- 摘要长度、批量上限、回收站分页等是代码常量，不是部署旋钮。

理由很简单：归档管理工具的安全边界应该由代码固定，而不是让用户或部署者去调一个可能被误改的开关。

## 技术栈

| 层          | 选择                                                          | 为什么                                                                         |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 语言        | TypeScript（`strict`，ESM）                                   | 插件要碰会话日志、注册表与文件系统，类型是最便宜的护栏                         |
| Host 构建   | `tsc` → `dist/index.js`                                       | 不需要打包器；Node 直接加载 ESM                                                |
| Client 构建 | `esbuild` → `dist/client.js`（minify）                        | 浏览器半必须是单个 `__ModuleLoader__` 工厂文件                                 |
| Client UI   | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`（external）           | 复用宿主的 Modal/Toast/Button/Tabs，自动跟随主题；不打包第二份组件             |
| 传输        | 自注册 HTTP 前缀路由 + `connection.requestRejection`          | 宿主的 `connection.rpc.handle` 在组合 profile 里不可用（见 docs/设计.md §4.2） |
| 状态        | `ctx.workspaceRegistry` 的公开 API                            | 直接改 `workspace.json` 会被宿主内存状态覆盖                                   |
| 活动判定    | `workspace/session-activity` 瀑布                             | 与 DSH 自己的归档准入一致，不会把「已加载」当成「运行中」                      |
| 存储        | 文件系统（回收站两阶段写入 + 摘要缓存）                       | 会话本身就是目录，移动目录比复制快且原子                                       |
| 测试        | `node:test`（零依赖）+ 宿主自己的 `assertSupportedJsonSchema` | 测试直接跑 TS，工具 schema 用宿主同一个校验函数把关                            |
| 质量        | Prettier + ESLint + Commitlint + Husky/lint-staged            | 提交前自动格式化、检查、校验提交信息                                           |

## 工程结构

```
src/host/index.ts        Host 入口：HTTP 路由、能力探测、工具注册、启动诊断
src/host/service.ts      业务：列表 / 删除事务 / 恢复 / 清空 / 清理失效引用
src/host/paths.ts        路径解析、id 校验、体积/指纹、跨卷与越界保护
src/host/cache.ts        列表摘要缓存（summaries.json）
src/host/trash.ts        回收站存储（两阶段写入 + 恢复事务 + 损坏条目）
src/host/tool.ts         Agent 工具定义（lossless JSON + 结构化摘要）
src/host/diagnostics.ts  启动诊断（~/.dsh/archive-desk/last-boot.json）
src/client/index.tsx     侧栏图标、槽位注册、会话菜单项、样式注入
src/client/page.tsx      管理页：Tabs、表格、分页、选择、加载态
src/client/dialog.tsx    删除/清空确认弹窗
src/client/api.ts        HTTP 调用与错误
src/client/locales.ts    zh/en 字典
src/client/styles.ts     面板 CSS（主题 token）
scripts/build-client.mjs 把 Client 打成 __ModuleLoader__ 期望的单文件
dist/                    构建产物（不入库；安装/发布前先 pnpm build）
docs/设计.md             设计与决策记录
```

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build        # host(tsc) + client(esbuild)；改完 src/ 必须构建
pnpm typecheck
pnpm lint
pnpm test         # node --test，零测试依赖；会先自动 build
pnpm format
```

提交走 Conventional Commits，Husky 在 `pre-commit` 跑 lint-staged、在 `commit-msg` 跑 commitlint。

### 发版

```bash
pnpm release patch          # 0.3.0 → 0.3.1（minor / major / 显式版本号同理）
pnpm release minor --dry-run
```

脚本 `scripts/release.mjs` 会依次做：工作区干净检查 → 目标版本未被占用检查 →
`typecheck` / `lint` / `test` → `npm version`（提交并打 `vX.Y.Z` tag）→ `npm publish` →
推送提交与 tag → `gh release create --generate-notes`。任何一步失败都会停下并打印下一步该做什么。

> npm 11 的分阶段发布 + Security key（passkey）意味着 `npm publish` 必须在**能打开浏览器的交互式终端**
> 里完成授权；在 CI 或非交互 shell 里会得到 `EOTP`。脚本遇到这种情况会保留版本提交与 tag，并提示你

plugins.description: Ink-wash whale-leap splash for the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
plugins.readme_text:
# Ink Whale Leap · 水墨鲸跃

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that plays a short ink-wash whale-leap animation over the web UI when the page loads, then fades out by itself.

![Ink Whale Leap](assets/launch.png)

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

## What it shows

A full-window overlay in the palette of an ink wash on paper: the whale rises out of the still water, three ink rings spread from the waterline, a few ink drops scatter upward, and the wordmark `DeepSeek Harness` settles in with a red `鲸` seal and the line `鲸跃 · 与你同游`.

- 3.95 s after the page loads the overlay fades, and it is removed from the DOM at 4.75 s.
- `Esc` dismisses it immediately.
- With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the animations are turned off.
- If the tab is hidden when the page loads, playback waits for the tab to become visible (15 s fallback).
- The overlay is decorative: `aria-hidden="true"`, `pointer-events: none`, so it never takes clicks or keyboard focus.

![Ink rings spreading from the waterline](assets/rings.png)

## Install

Once the plugin is listed in the DSH plugin market, install it from Settings → Plugins. From a command line:

```
dsh plugin add dsh-ink-whale-leap
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so installing it adds one loader row — there is no client bundle to approve.

## Preview without installing

Open `preview.html` in a browser from a checkout of this repository; it loads `splash.js` against a blank page.

## How it works

This is a host-only plugin. It reacts to `webserver/index-inject` by pushing a single inline `<script>` row, and serves the animation source at `/ink-whale/splash.js` from the `webServer` service.

There is deliberately no client entry point: in DSH, a client bundle that fails to activate aborts the web boot, and a launch animation is not worth that risk. Every step of activation is wrapped in `try/catch`, so a missing service or a failing injection leaves the app untouched instead of breaking it.

The animation itself is one self-contained IIFE with inline CSS and SVG (`splash.js`) — no network requests, no fonts, no images.

## Configuration

None. The plugin has no settings page and no options.

## Uninstall

Remove it the same way as any other plugin (market uninstall, or `dsh plugin remove dsh-ink-whale-leap`).

## Notes

- The animation runs once per page load, on every window that loads the web UI — it is not a once-per-install welcome screen.
- It only paints over the web UI; the desktop window chrome is unaffected.

## License

MIT
