plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `allowedModels` | `[]` | Model whitelist, adapter mode only — legacy sidecar ignores it (plugin 0.3.14+, issue #83): exact model ids DSH may show and call. Empty exposes every eligible free-lane model. Narrowing only — paid/deprecated/blocklist/probe rules still win, and a direct call to a non-whitelisted id fails fast with a tagged error before any network traffic. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | **Local OpenCode delegation** (plugin 0.3.x, [docs/delegation.md](docs/delegation.md), ref #76) — opt-in fallback for the persistent `403 FreeTierError` credential gate. Disabled by default; the anonymous path is unchanged unless you enable it: ```yaml delegation: enabled: true # arm the delegate (default false) # opencodePath: '' # explicit binary; else managed -> global -> npm # minVersion: '1.18.0' # candidates below this are skipped # memLimit: '96MiB' # GOMEMLIMIT for the child # gcPercent: 30 # GOGC for the child # trimIntervalMs: 60000 # Windows EmptyWorkingSet tick; 0 disables # startTimeoutMs: 60000 # health-wait budget ``` Enabling it makes the plugin custody your opencode credential (only the `opencode` entry, seeded 0600 into an isolated XDG root, never logged) and run a managed local `opencode serve` when — and only when — the anonymous lane *and* its sibling retry both refuse with the credential gate. Read [docs/delegation.md](docs/delegation.md) §2 before enabling. ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely ca

plugins.description: 每条问题给具体改法，不是一句「请整改」
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-remediation

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-remediation)

**检查报告只说「哪有问题」，改法还得自己查 —— 这个插件把「改成什么样、大概多久、改完怎么验」直接给出来。**

**关键词**：整改建议 · 修复建议 · 漏洞修复 · 合规整改 · 怎么改 · 整改清单 · 修复方案 · 改前改后 · 检查报告解读 · 一键整改

---

## 不装会怎样

你跑完一轮检查，拿到一份几十条的 JSON 报告：`LOG-RETENTION-SHORT`、`FIN-AUTH-PLAINTEXT`、
`MED-EMR-RETENTION-1`……每条都有一句「请整改」。然后呢？

- 改到什么值才算合规？日志留存写 90 天还是 180 天？
- 这条规则对应的是哪个文件、哪一行？改配置还是改代码？
- 这条要写文档，模板长什么样？
- 改完了怎么确认真的改掉了，而不是「看着像改了」？
- 哪些能直接机械改，哪些必须业务决策？

这些事现在都得自己一条条查法条、翻代码、问同事。**dsh-remediation 就是把这个空档补上**：
它不新增任何判据，只读你已有的检查报告，把每条问题翻译成**能照着做的改法**——
具体步骤、改前 → 改后片段、预计工时、改完重跑哪条命令。
对声明过 `autoApply` 的规则（如 LICENSE、日志留存天数），还能机械改掉：
默认 dry-run，确认后 `--apply` 才落盘，先备份、只碰声明过的文件。

```
dsh-cn-log-retention / dsh-industry-medical / ...  = 查【哪有问题】
dsh-remediation                                    = 告诉你【到底怎么改、改完怎么验】
dsh-fix-verify                                     = 复核【改前 → 改后】问题少了没有
```

---

## 先说清楚它是什么、不是什么

**是**：

- 一个「检查报告 → 整改清单」的转换器：输入任意 guard 插件的 `--json` 报告，输出按严重度排序的整改清单；
- 每条命中尽量配：**问题**（title + ruleId + 文件:行）、**依据**（source）、**具体改法**（步骤 / 改前改后片段）、**预计工时**、**改完怎么验**（重跑哪条命令、哪个 ruleId 应消失）；
- 一份**可交付的 Markdown 整改清单**（`--out`），能直接放进整改报告附件；
- 对 recipe 里声明了 `autoApply` 的规则，提供**有边界的机械修改**：默认 dry-run 只打印「将改什么」，`--apply` 才写盘。

**不是**：

- ❌ **不是扫描器** —— 它没有 `rules/`，不新增判据；问题从报告来，验证靠重跑原插件；
- ❌ **不替你判断违规** —— 报告和建议都是提示确认，不是安全结论、合规结论或违规判定；
- ❌ **不保证「照做就合规」** —— 改法给的是常见落地路径，具体条款适用、业务取舍仍需人工确认；
- ❌ **不乱改文件** —— 只处理 recipe 里声明过的 `autoApply`，未声明的文件一个字节都不碰；
- ❌ **不编假改法** —— 没有 recipe 的规则会明说「本条暂无专用改法」，回引原报告 advice，并提示 `--list-recipes`。

---

## 安装与使用

```bash
# 通常随深鲸守护插件一起安装；单独装：
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-remediation

# 1) 跑任意守护插件，拿 JSON 报告
dsh-cn-log-retention --root ./my-project --json > report.json
#   也可以用一键体检的总报告
dsh-guard-suite --json > report.json

# 2) 生成整改清单（默认只打印，不改文件）
dsh-remediation --input report.json --root ./my-project

# 3) 另存可交付的 Markdown
dsh-remediation --input report.json --root ./my-project --out ./整改材料/

# 4) 先看哪些能机械改（dry-run），确认后再落盘
dsh-remediation --input report.json --root ./my-project
dsh-remediation --input report.json --root ./my-project --apply

# 5) 列出已覆盖的规则 id 与一句话改法
dsh-remediation --list-recipes

# 6) JSON 输出（给 CI / 二次处理）
dsh-remediation --input report.json --root ./my-project --json
```

`--rules-from <目录>` 可以追加自己的 recipe 目录（目录下放 `*.json`，可重复指定）。

### 输出长什么样

```
  深鲸守护 · 整改建议 v0.1.0
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  输入     report.json
  项目     /path/to/my-project
  命中     5 条（高 3 · 中 2） · 有专用改法 4 条 · 暂无专用改法 1 条
  自动修改 3 条可机械修改 · dry-run（文件未改动）

  【高】3 条

  1. 🔴 日志留存期短于法定 6 个月
     规则    LOG-RETENTION-SHORT · logger.js:2
     依据    《中华人民共和国网络安全法》第二十一条第（三）项 —— 网络日志不少于六个月
     现状    maxDays: 7
     改法
       1) 确认命中的是合规日志留存配置，不是排障用的短期轮转 —— 两者要分开配置。
       2) 把留存天数改为 ≥180 天（6 个月按 180 天算）。
       ...
     改前 → 改后（yaml）
       - retentionDays: 30
       + retentionDays: 180  # 网络安全法：网络日志不少于 6 个月
     工时    5 分钟
     验证    重跑 dsh-cn-log-retention --root <项目>，LOG-RETENTION-SHORT 应消失
     自动修改 ⏳ 可机械修改（dry-run）：将改写 1 个文件（1 处）；加 --apply 才落盘
```

没有 recipe 的规则长这样（不会编一个假改法）：

```
     改法    本条暂无专用改法。
             原报告建议：<该 finding 的 advice 原文>
             可用 --list-recipes 查看已覆盖的规则；这条需要按上面的建议人工判断。
     工时    待评估（暂无专用改法）
     验证    按原报告建议人工处理后，重跑原命令，确认 XXX 不再出现
```

---

## autoApply 的安全边界

| 边界 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 默认模式 | **dry-run**：只计算「会改哪个文件、改哪一行」，不写盘 |
| 落盘条件 | 必须显式 `--apply` |
| 备份 | 写盘前先备份为 `<file>.bak-<YYYYmmdd-HHMMSS>`；同一文件一次运行只留一份原始备份 |
| 修改范围 | 只处理 recipe 里声明的 `autoApply`：`newFile` 只创建声明路径，`setValue` 只改 glob 命中的文件 |
| 路径约束 | 所有目标必须落在 `--root` 之内，越界直接拒绝 |
| 已存在文件 | `newFile` 遇到同名文件不覆盖 |
| 找不到匹配 | `setValue` 的 pattern 匹配不到时不臆造修改，明确报告「未找到可改写的位置」 |
| 不做的事 | 不改未声明文件、不执行任意脚本、不联网、不删除文件 |

两种 `autoApply`：

```json
{"type": "newFile", "path": "LICENSE", "template": "mit"}
```

```json
{"type": "setValue",
 "glob": "**/*.{yml,yaml,json,env,conf,properties}",
 "pattern": "((?:retentionDays|maxDays)\\s*[:=]\\s*[\"']?)(\\d{1,3})",
 "after": "180"}
```

`setValue` 的约定：pattern **最后一个捕获组**是要被替换的值；`after` 是替换后的文本。
这样 `retentionDays: 30` 会变成 `retentionDays: 180`，而 key 保持原样。

---

## recipes：已覆盖的规则（42 条）

recipe 是本插件唯一的资产：每条规则一份，写清改法、工时、验证命令，可选声明 `autoApply`。
`--list-recipes` 可以随时查看当前版本覆盖了哪些规则。

### 行业/地方 high 规则（15 条，全覆盖）

| 插件 | 规则 |
|---|---|
| 医疗 | `MED-EMR-RETENTION-1` `MED-EMR-RETENTION-2` `MED-EMR-AUDIT-TRAIL-1` `MED-EMR-AUDIT-TRAIL-2` `MED-PRESCRIPTION-RETENTION` |
| 教育 | `EDU-APP-FILING-PUBLIC` `EDU-SCORE-RANK-PUBLIC` `EDU-AD-GAME-SDK` `EDU-STUDENT-ID-EXPOSURE` |
| 金融 | `FIN-PAY-SENSITIVE-RETENTION` `FIN-AUTH-PLAINTEXT` `FIN-AMC-10Y` `FIN-CLIENT-LOCAL-STORE` |
| 地方 | `LR-SZ-26` `LR-SZ-73` |

### 高频通用规则（27 条）

`LOG-RETENTION-SHORT` `LOG-DISABLED` `LOG-SENSITIVE` `FILING-NO-ICP` `FILING-NO-APP`
`FILING-NO-PRIVACY-ENTRY` `FILING-NO-OPERATOR` `LIC-SELF-FILE` `ENV-NOT-IGNORED`
`SBOM-NO-LIST` `DEP-NO-LOCKFILE` `CI-WRITE-ALL` `CI-UNPINNED-ACTION` `CONSENT-PRECHECKED`
`MLPS-DEFAULT-CRED` `CRYPTO-WEAK-HASH` `PII-IDCARD` `RIGHTS-NO-DELETE` `INCIDENT-NO-PLAN`
`CLASSIFY-NO-POLICY` `LIFE-NO-RETENTION-POLICY` `PIPIA-NO-RECORD` `EDU-APP-FILING-RECORD`
`MED-DEVICE-CYBER-POLICY` `MED-HGR-ETHICS-CONSENT-2` `LR-SZ-79` `LR-SZ-80`

其中声明了 `autoApply` 的有 16 条：`LICENSE` 等缺文件类会创建最小模板，
日志留存天数 / 日志级别 / 收银留存期 / CI 权限等配置值类会做定点替换。

> 没覆盖的规则不是「不重要」，而是**还没有可以机械套用的改法**。
> 清单会明说「本条暂无专用改法」并回引原报告 advice，绝不会编造步骤。

---

## 退出码

| 码 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `0` | 正常（包含 dry-run、apply 成功、`--list-recipes`、`--help`） |
| `2` | 输入缺失 / JSON 坏了 / 缺 `findings[]` / `--root` 不存在 / 参数错误 / recipe 损坏 |

自动修改执行失败（如目标路径越界）会在输出里明确标出，但不改变退出码 2 的语义——
输入本身没问题、清单仍然可用。

---

## 与现有插件不重叠在哪

- 30 多个检查插件负责**发现**问题；本插件负责**把问题变成改法**，不新增任何判据；
- `dsh-guard-suite` 负责**聚合**全套检查；本插件消费它的报告，但不重复扫描；
- `dsh-fix-verify` 负责**复核**改前/改后同一套规则的结果；本插件负责**告诉你怎么改**，
  改完仍建议用 `dsh-fix-verify` 复核；
- `dsh-compliance-doc` 负责**交付文档**；本插件的 `--out 整改清单.md` 可以作为它的输入素材。

---

## 免责声明

本插件输出的是**整改建议与提示确认**，不构成安全结论、合规结论或违规判定。
改法基于常见工程实践与报告中的 source 依据整理，具体条款适用、业务取舍、上线变更仍需人工确认。
未命中的规则不代表项目没有问题；改完请重跑对应检查插件验证。

## 开发与测试

```bash
bash tests/run.sh   # 65 条真断言：清单内容 / dry-run 不改文件 / apply 备份与落盘 / 坏输入 exit 2 / 端到端改掉真实 finding
```

端到端那条最硬：复制 `dsh-cn-log-retention` 的正例样本 → 真插件报 `LOG-RETENTION-SHORT`
→ `dsh-remediation --apply` → 重跑同一插件，断言该 finding 消失。

## License

MIT

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 39 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规**（12）｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理**（6）｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据**（5）｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**供应链与构建**（5）｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [工具审查](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [物料清单](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom)

plugins.description: dsh session delete，提供会话「备份后删除」或「彻底删除」功能
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-archive-delete

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的会话列表加一个安全的「删除」入口：**先完整备份到本地，校验通过后才删除**。

装上之后，在侧栏任意会话的「…」菜单最下方会多出删除选项。

## 为什么需要它

DSH 只有「归档」，没有删除。想真正释放磁盘空间就得手动去找
`~/.dsh/sessions/<工作区>/<uuid>/` 删目录，同时还要手动清理
`workspace.json` 和投影缓存——漏一步，侧栏就会留下点不开的空壳会话。

本插件把这件事做成一条安全的流水线：

```
确认 → 复制会话目录 + 缓存 + 元数据快照 → 逐文件校验 → 删除原件 → 清理账本
```

任何一步失败都会中止，原会话保持完好。

## 功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 备份删除 | 把会话完整备份到指定文件夹，校验通过后再删 |
| 彻底删除 | 不备份，直接删除 |
| 两种模式并存 | 菜单可同时显示两个选项，也可只显示其一 |
| 子代理会话 | 自动找出该会话派生的所有子代理，一起备份、一起删除 |
| 自定义备份位置 | 系统文件夹对话框选择，或直接输入路径 |
| 四种命名方式 | 日期+主题 / ID前八位+主题 / 纯主题 / 前八位+主题+日期 |
| 路径校验 | 无效路径当场提示，不会写入设置 |
| 一键恢复 | 每个备份文件夹带 `RESTORE.txt`，按说明复制回去即可 |

## 安装

### 方式一：在 DSH 界面里装（推荐）

左侧栏 **插件** → 右上角 **添加插件** → 输入包名安装：

```
dsh-session-archive-delete
```

装完重启 DSH。

### 方式二：命令行

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-session-archive-delete
```

`<profile>` 通常是 `desktop` 或 `web`，可在 `~/.dsh/profiles/` 下看到。

### 方式三：从源码本地开发

```bash
git clone https://github.com/device1999/dsh-session-archive-delete.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/path/to/dsh-session-archive-delete
```

或在 profile 的 `package.json` 里写 `link:` 依赖，然后在 `node_modules` 里建一个
指向源码目录的 junction（Windows）或 symlink（macOS / Linux）。

## 使用

### 删除一个会话

1. 侧栏会话行点「…」
2. 选「备份删除」或「彻底删除」
3. 确认框里核对会话名、ID 和备份路径
4. 点「确认」

删除成功后侧栏会立即刷新；如果删的是当前会话，会自动跳到下一个。

### 设置

**设置 → 备份删除**：

| 设置项 | 选项 |
|---|---|
| 删除模式 | 两个菜单项同时显示 / 只显示「备份删除」/ 只显示「彻底删除」 |
| 备份位置 | 点击选择文件夹，或直接编辑地址栏；留空 = 默认位置 |
| 备份文件夹命名 | 四种格式任选 |

设置保存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-session-archive-delete.json`。

### 默认备份位置

按以下优先级确定：

1. 设置里填写的路径
2. 环境变量 `DSH_ARCHIVE_ROOT`
3. 插件配置 `workspaceRoot`
4. 自动推断：从会话记录里选出使用最多的工作区目录
5. 都拿不到时：`<用户主目录>/DSH-归档会话`

> 备份位置不能设在 `~/.dsh` 内部，否则 DSH 会把它当成数据目录重新扫描。

## 备份结构

```
<备份位置>/<按命名规则生成的文件夹>/
  sessions/<工作区目录>/<会话id>/    会话原始文件（保留原名）
  projcache/<会话id>.json            界面投影缓存
  meta/workspace.json                删除前的元数据快照
  meta/session_projcache.json
  manifest.json                      清单：完整 id、标题、大小、子代理列表
  RESTORE.txt                        恢复步骤
```

子代理会话也备份在同一个文件夹的 `sessions/` 下，清单里列在 `subagents` 字段。

## 恢复一个会话

详见每个备份文件夹里的 `RESTORE.txt`，大意是：

1. 完全退出 DSH
2. 把 `sessions/<工作区>/<会话id>` 复制回 `~/.dsh/sessions/<工作区>/`
3. 把 `projcache/<会话id>.json` 复制回 `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/`
4. 在 `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json` 里把会话 id 加回对应工作区的 `sessionIds`
5. 启动 DSH

## 安全性

- **不删未校验的内容**：复制后逐文件比对大小与数量，不一致就中止
- **删前先摘账本**：先把引用从 `workspace.json` 移除并落盘，再删文件，
  避免 DSH 内存状态把引用写回
- **删后复查**：目录删除后检查 3 次，防止文件句柄重建目录
- **路径边界校验**：会话目录必须位于 `~/.dsh/sessions` 下，且目录名与会话 id 完全一致
- **运行中会话**：先取消当前轮次再删除，不会留下半截日志

## 系统要求

- DSH 0.2.x（Web / 桌面客户端）
- Windows / macOS / Linux
- 系统文件夹对话框依赖 PowerShell 7（Windows）。没有 pwsh 时会自动回退到页面内目录浏览

## 已知限制

- 默认备份位置依赖宿主提供的 `sessionQuery` 服务来推断工作区；取不到时回退到用户主目录
- 子代理关系来自会话 header 的 `parentSession` 字段，会话文件是 zstd 压缩，无法纯读盘解析
- 备份是完整复制，大会话会占用相应磁盘空间

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-session-archive-delete
```

重启 DSH。已生成的备份文件夹不会被删除，可按需自行清理。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: Strata local inference provider and model manager for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# Strata for DeepSeek Harness

Manage Strata Unleashed GGUF models, vision/projector files, MTP, saved profiles and measured Flash Next tuning inside DSH.

## Install in DSH

Requires DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**, running its Web profile.

1. Open **Plugins → Add plugin → GitHub**.
2. Paste `https://github.com/averyjohnkucan-arch/dsh-strata`.
3. Install and enable the plugin. Reload the browser, or restart DSH if its manager requests it.
4. Open **Settings → Models → Strata**.

The plugin is a ready-to-install Cordis bundle. It does not patch DSH, replace its UI, install a second DSH, or require a plugin compilation step. Its package uses DSH's shipped peers, so installation does not download another provider stack or ask to run provider dependency build scripts.

## Models

Choose **Add model**, then **Select model files**. Browse the host's model directory and select multiple files, or **Select all model files here**. You can navigate between directories while retaining the selection. **Inspect and assign** reads headers and assigns the main model, its ordered shards, the vision projector and MTP. It reports missing shards, mixed main-model sets and unsupported MTP formats.

Edit the profile and save. **Start** prepares a missing runtime/model pack before starting the server. Runtime installation and model preparation show progress and can be cancelled. Existing installed engines and prepared packs can be selected under **Runtime and imported model data**. The model becomes available in DSH's conversation model picker after saving.

**Edit** reopens a saved profile. **Remove profile** deletes its saved configuration and stops its owned process; downloaded model files are retained. **Attach running server** explicitly connects to an already-running server advertising the profile's model ID. Stopping or disabling an attachment only detaches; it never terminates the external process. Launch settings are not applied to an external server.

All documented inference flags from the pinned executable's help have controls under **All engine CLI options**. Blank means the engine default; boolean **Omit flag** means the flag is not passed, not that an engine-default feature is necessarily disabled. The complete JSON editor supports repeated flags as arrays and multi-value flags as `{"argv":["first","second"]}`. Additional argv is an array, never a shell string. Environment variables and the complete server configuration are also editable.

## Updates, disable and removal

Update each repository independently through DSH's plugin manager. Turn its switch off to remove its card, provider registration and tools, and stop the servers it owns. Remove the bundle to uninstall its code. Saved profiles and runtime data remain in `~/.dsh/dsh-strata/` (or `$DSH_HOME/dsh-strata/`) so reinstalling restores them. Delete that plugin-owned data directory separately if you want a complete reset. Neither plugin requires the other.

## Integration

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and `dsh.client`; the patch inserts only its own Cordis row. The client registers React UI through the documented `settings.models.footer` slot and uses DSH theme tokens and locale service. The Host registers an `LlmAdapter` through `ctx.llm.registerAdapter`, delegates wire conversion, images and replay to DSH's public `PiAiAdapter`, and owns a separate `ctx.webServer.register` route. An ephemeral bearer capability supplied through `webserver/index-inject` protects its JSON actions. There is no iframe, DOM injection or replacement of built-in provider cards.

Registrations and process lifetimes are owned by `ctx.effect`/`ctx.on`. The agent-facing `strata_models` tool uses the same operations as the card and DSH's `approveEscalation` mechanism; host-management calls require Full access or explicit per-call approval. UI actions require the owner's page capability. This initial version targets the local Web profile; remote delegated access and Electron-only profiles have not been validated.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm test
pnpm run check
```

Node 22.19+ is required. Development provider dependencies may report skipped optional install scripts; the published plugin has no install scripts and consumes DSH's installed peer packages. The two repositories contain their own code and tests and can be developed separately.

## Strata runtime and supported formats

Engine source: [StrataUnleashed](https://github.com/averyjohnkucan-arch/StrataUnleashed), pinned to `c73cde37581e6a79664176a08a232480c1b1fcfc`, the latest revision inspected for this release. Engine updates are explicit version changes, independent of saved model settings.

The automated setup currently builds the NVIDIA CUDA engine on Linux from that pinned source, creates a Python environment, installs the engine's requirements, and builds CPU/CUDA vision readers. It attempts a Vulkan vision reader and retains CPU fallback if Vulkan tools are unavailable. This requires Python with venv support, Git, CMake, Ninja, a C++ compiler and a compatible CUDA toolkit/driver. These system prerequisites are not installed with administrator privileges. Another supported engine binary can be supplied manually. This first release is not a universal precompiled engine distribution.

Automatic model packing currently supports **qwen4exp / Flash Next** using the fork's own `iq_pack.py`. Other architectures need an upstream-prepared compatible runtime pack. A selected MTP GGUF must be Strata's packed Q2_0 format accepted by `mtp_rt.py`; arbitrary standalone FP16/Q4/Q8 MTP GGUFs are recognized but explicitly rejected before conversion. A prepared MTP runtime is supported. MTP is never silently dropped and the tuner does not move it off the text GPU.

Vision choices are Auto, GPU, iGPU/Vulkan, CPU, and Off. Auto uses iGPU on cards with at most 12 GiB when a compatible Vulkan reader and device index are configured, otherwise CPU; larger cards prefer GPU. An independently configured CPU vision reader is the fallback. Vulkan device selection uses a plugin-owned launcher wrapper so its environment does not redirect the CUDA text engine. Automatic iGPU discovery is not implemented; supply the Vulkan index. GPU/CPU/iGPU vision execution has not been rebenchmarked for this plugin release.

Only the engine's actual mixed K/V formats are accepted: FP16/FP16, FP16/Q8, FP16/Q6, Q8/Q8, Q8/Q6, Q6/Q8, Q6/Q6, Q8/Q5, Q5/Q5, Q5/Q4, Q4/Q4. K/V dropdowns do not imply that every Cartesian combination is supported. The explicit expert-tail-skipping environment control can alter model output and is never enabled automatically by the tuner.

## Saved configurations

Use **Import saved Strata configuration** to import an existing JSON run configuration. Existing engine arguments are retained in their original order until an inference control changes. Supplied settings are locked against tuning. The import records the source-file SHA-256 and its existing validation status. Moving `/opt/prod/...` paths to an existing Local AI v2 location changes paths only.

The owner's local installation includes Atomic Chat Q5 Regular/Turbo and Gyro Large Regular/Turbo from Local AI v2. These machine-specific profiles and model weights are not bundled into this public repository. Their saved records contain pending validation statuses; importing them does not make them newly validated and does not run inference.

## Tuning

**Tune saved profile** is opt-in and measures the selected model on the current GPU. Editing a value enables **Keep my value**; clear it to let the tuner adjust that control. Imported existing tunes are locked. Failed or cancelled tuning preserves the previous saved tune.

The search starts at 80% resident KV, probes FP16/FP16, Q4/Q4 and Q8/Q8, refines supported pairs with K prioritized, searches resident cells when needed, and targets 6–10% free GPU memory. It measures decode candidates, then prefill candidates with a separate decode regression check capped at 5% loss. Finally it searches expert slots toward 0.7–1.5% free VRAM, retaining a larger margin if the next allocation does not fit. The final candidate is measured at the requeste

plugins.description: QiuYa 增强工具箱：为 DeepSeek Harness 添加长文本附件、会话独立窗口、批量归档和计划批注。
plugins.readme_text:
# QiuYa 增强工具箱

给 DeepSeek Harness 加一点顺手的小功能。

长文本附件、会话分窗、批量归档、计划批注、菜单增强，还有手绘 Q主题。

## 安装

打开 Harness 的 **插件 → 添加插件**，复制下面的完整链接安装：

```text
https://github.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/releases/latest/download/dsh-qiuya-tools.tgz
```

安装后点击 **立即启用**，进入 **设置 → QiuYaTools**。左下角账号菜单也有入口。

**已安装？** 打开 **QiuYaTools → 版本更新 → 检查更新**。有新版时直接更新，完成后重开 Harness，原有设置保留。

## 功能

- **长文本转附件**：粘贴长文本自动变成 TXT；字符数、行数阈值可调，默认 1000 个字符或 15 行。
- **会话独立窗口**：右键打开，或拖出列表；同一会话重复打开会唤起已有窗口。
- **多选与批量归档**：Shift 连选、⌘ / Ctrl 多选，再右键归档；支持归档工作区全部会话。
- **计划批注**：选中文字添加评论，直接提交修改建议，保留原有输入草稿。
- **Q主题「鲸与海」**：白发少年与鲸鱼的手绘海面，支持浅色、深色外观。

会话菜单（右键或 `…`）：

- 置顶 / 取消置顶
- 重命名、分叉、归档
- 标记未读 / 已读
- 复制标题、会话 ID、工作目录
- 打开工作目录
- 新窗口打开

工作区菜单（右键或 `…`）：

- 移到顶部
- 复制路径、打开目录
- 归档全部会话

五项增强功能默认开启，每项可单独设置，也可一键开关全部。Q主题默认关闭，独立设置。

## 说明

- 当前适配官方 macOS Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`；独立窗口要求 macOS 13+，支持 Apple Silicon 和 Intel。
- 未读标记保存在本机，重新进入会话后清除。归档保留工作区和磁盘目录。
- 安装时填写上面的完整链接。当前未发布 npm 包，单独填写 `dsh-qiuya-tools` 不适用于新安装。

[下载与发布记录](https://github.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/releases) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/issues) · [使用细节与开发](docs/development.md) · [www.qiuya.cc](https://www.qiuya.cc)

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `allowedModels` | `[]` | Model whitelist, adapter mode only — legacy sidecar ignores it (plugin 0.3.14+, issue #83): exact model ids DSH may show and call. Empty exposes every eligible free-lane model. Narrowing only — paid/deprecated/blocklist/probe rules still win, and a direct call to a non-whitelisted id fails fast with a tagged error before any network traffic. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | **Local OpenCode delegation** (plugin 0.3.x, [docs/delegation.md](docs/delegation.md), ref #76) — opt-in fallback for the persistent `403 FreeTierError` credential gate. Disabled by default; the anonymous path is unchanged unless you enable it: ```yaml delegation: enabled: true # arm the delegate (default false) # opencodePath: '' # explicit binary; else managed -> global -> npm # minVersion: '1.18.0' # candidates below this are skipped # memLimit: '96MiB' # GOMEMLIMIT for the child # gcPercent: 30 # GOGC for the child # trimIntervalMs: 60000 # Windows EmptyWorkingSet tick; 0 disables # startTimeoutMs: 60000 # health-wait budget ``` Enabling it makes the plugin custody your opencode credential (only the `opencode` entry, seeded 0600 into an isolated XDG root, never logged) and run a managed local `opencode serve` when — and only when — the anonymous lane *and* its sibling retry both refuse with the credential gate. Read [docs/delegation.md](docs/delegation.md) §2 before enabling. ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely ca

plugins.description: PTC 增强套件：跑在 run_code/SDK 上的「刨根问底」预设 + 跨会话答题与提醒的注意力中心 + dsh-ops 取证工具对齐。41 条单测通过。PTC suite for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-attention-center · PTC 增强套件

一个安装包，三块能力：

| 能力 | 挂在哪 | 干什么 |
|---|---|---|
| **刨根问底 · Inquiry（PTC）** | `preset-inquiry` | 新会话选这个模式：先问 20~30 个问题把方向钉住，再动手。跑在 PTC 上——模型只看到 `run_code` + 自动生成的 SDK |
| **注意力中心** | `attention-core` + `client.js` | 右下角运行中计数、失败/完成提醒、**跨会话答题弹窗**（不用切过去）、可选手机推送 |
| **OPS / PTC 对齐** | 预设内的 `tool-presentation` | PTC 下 `dsh-ops` 的 `ops_*` 工具全部降为 SDK 绑定：一次 `run_code` 里并发取证，中间结果不进上下文 |

## 这是什么

给 **DeepSeek Harness** 用的一套「先问清楚、再动手」的工作台：

- 一个 **PTC 预设**（刨根问底 · Inquiry）：模型只拿到 `run_code` + 生成的 SDK，用问题把模糊想法钉成方向；
- 一套 **注意力中心**：跨会话的答题弹窗、运行中计数、失败 / 完成提醒，不用在对话之间来回切；
- 一层 **OPS / PTC 对齐**：`dsh-ops` 的 `ops_*` 工具在 PTC 下变成 `tools.ops_*`，一次程序里并发取证、只把要用的几行返回。

开源、MIT、无遥测、不含任何凭据。仓库：<https://github.com/zxh21149-commits/dsh-attention-center>

> 为什么放一起：刨根问底最怕「问了没人答」——它每轮要等你 5 分钟；注意力中心正好负责把问题递到你眼前、答完自动续上。而 PTC 让每轮取证（读文件 / 查目录 / 看仓库）压进一次 `run_code`，问出来的题才带着证据。

## 装

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle   target = github:zxh21149-commits/dsh-attention-center
```

装完重启 DSH（Host 半要注册投影、技能与预设）；客户端半刷新页面即可。

**依赖**：DSH ≥ 0.2.0；PTC 需要宿主侧 `ptc-runtime`（官方发行版自带，本包会覆盖它的 `timeoutMs`）。
`dsh-ops` 是**可选**的第三方插件（Rust 实现、Windows x64），装了就会以 SDK 绑定出现在 `run_code` 里；没装也能跑，取证换成原生 `bash` / 文件工具。

## 你会得到什么

### 1. 刨根问底 · Inquiry（PTC）

新会话选预设「刨根问底 · Inquiry」，或在任意会话敲 `/pao`、`/pau`、`/inquiry`（`/pao 补充文字` 算种子）。

- 先猜方向给 3 条 → 每轮 6 题、一题一页、可跳过可自填，**推荐项排第一并带 `(Recommended)`**
- 每轮收尾复述三栏：**【已确认】【我的推断】【还差的】**
- 收口出《需求简报》存 `~/.dsh/inquiry/`，你点头才动手
- 你说「够了 / 直接做」立即收口

提问是 **timed** 模式：5 分钟内答完直接拿答案；超时返回 `pending`，题还留着、答案随后作为用户消息回来（PTC 下 `run_code` 有执行期限，阻塞式等待被打断可能丢题）。

### 2. 注意力中心

| 场景 | 表现 |
|---|---|
| 有会话在跑 | 右下角常驻气泡「运行中 N」（点开看是哪几个，点一下跳过去） |
| 某轮失败 | 失败卡：会话名 + 错误摘要；**打开 / 重试 / 忽略** |
| 某轮完成 | 完成卡：哪个会话完成了 + 「看结果」 |
| 别的对话在等你答题 | 居中弹窗，题目从上往下排，**就地选/填/提交**，不用切会话 |
| 没操作 | 默认 **10 分钟**后自动提交推荐项（可切 5/10/20/30/60 或永不）；气泡上有 `⏳N分` 倒计时 |
| 人不在电脑旁 | 手机推送：PushPlus / 企业微信群机器人 / Qmsg / Server酱 / webhook |

自动选择有三道闸，专治「没弹窗却自己选了」：

1. **只对弹窗真正显示过的题生效**——没显示过就一直等；
2. **计时从「第一次显示给你看」开始**，不是从问题创建开始；
3. 自动提交后留一张黄边卡片：**哪个会话 + 每题选了什么** + 打开会话 / 知道了。

### 3. PTC × OPS

同一个任务的两条路：

```text
原生：model → ops_glob → 结果进上下文
      model → ops_grep → 结果进上下文
      model → ops_inspect ×3 → 三份结果进上下文     （5 次往返）

PTC：model → run_code {
        const files = await tools.ops_glob({ pattern: ['**/*.md'] })
        const heads = await Promise.all(files.slice(0, 3).map((f) =>
          tools.ops_inspect_local_file({ file_path: f })))
        return heads.map((t) => t.slice(0, 20))      // 只有这 20 行进上下文
      }                                              （1 次往返）
```

`dsh-ops` 的 README 原话：「PTC 模式经 SDK 调用底层工具，权限门不变」——工具还在、权限门不变，变的只是「怎么调」。

## 配置

### `attention-core`（插件页可编辑）

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `notifyProvider` | `none` | `none` / `pushplus` / `qmsg` / `wecom` / `serverchan` / `webhook` |
| `notifyPushplusToken` / `notifyWecomWebhook` | 空 | 对应渠道凭据（**别贴聊天**，明文存本机） |
| `notifyOnError` / `notifyOnQuestion` / `notifyOnDone` | `true` | 失败 / 提问超时 / 完成是否推 |
| `notifyQuestionTimeoutMinutes` | `5` | 提问多久没人答就推一次 |
| `notifyMinRunSeconds` | `300` | 完成推送的运行时长门槛 |
| `notifyTestOnStart` | `false` | 开一次立刻发测试消息，验完关掉 |

> 推送只在**电脑开机 + DSH 在运行**时发生；睡眠不推。
> 配置也可以写在 `~/.dsh/attention-notify.json`（文件优先，`fs.watch` 热载，保存即生效）。

### `inquiry-core`

`rounds`（默认 4）、`questionsPerRound`（6）、`language`（zh）、`questionBankPath`（自定义题库）、`briefDir`（`~/.dsh/inquiry`）、`autoLoadSkill`。技能正文按这些配置生成，改完即重建。

### `ptc-runtime`（全局）

本包把 `run_code` 默认期限调到 `330000`ms、上限 `600000`ms：提问要等 300s，不抬期限的话 `run_code` 会先在默认 120s 掐断它。**这一条对所有 PTC 预设生效**，不想要就删掉 patch 里那一行。

## 从旧包迁移

之前是三个独立东西（`dsh-inquiry-mode` 包、`dsh-attention-center` 本地插件、手写的 profile patch）：

1. 卸载旧的：插件管理里移除 `dsh-inquiry-mode` 与旧的 `dsh-attention-center`（否则技能 / 命令 / 覆盖层会重复注册）；
2. 装本包；
3. **删掉**你 profile `cordis.patch.yml` 里手写的 `preset-inquiry` / `ptc-runtime` 覆盖（本包自带，留着会互相覆盖）；
4. 重启 DSH，开新会话选「刨根问底 · Inquiry」。

## 回退

删掉 `cordis.patch.yml` 里本套件插入的行 → 重启。客户端半刷新页面即卸。

## 结构

```text
index.js              Host：attention 投影 + 推送接线（client.js 是它的浏览器半）
client.js             浏览器半：角栈气泡 / 答题弹窗 / 提醒卡 / 自动选择
lib/                  projection · notify · providers
inquiry/index.js      刨根问底 Host：技能 + /pao /pau /inquiry
inquiry/lib/          config · bank · prompt · commands
inquiry/banks/        zh.json（8 维约 40 问）/ en.json
cordis.patch.yml      attention-core + inquiry-core + preset-inquiry(PTC) + ptc-runtime
docs/PTC-OPS.md       PTC 与 OPS 的搭配说明
test/                 41 条单测（15 注意力 + 26 刨根问底）
```

## 测试与验证

```bash
node --test        # 41 passing
```

| 类别 | 内容 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 单元测试 · 注意力 | 15 条：失败投影折叠、通知事件折叠与去重、5 个推送渠道的请求体、提问超时、完成推送门槛 | ✅ 15/15 |
| 单元测试 · 刨根问底 | 26 条：配置边界、题库校验与回退、技能正文生成、`/pao` 命令 followup、`apply` 组装 | ✅ 26/26 |
| 服务端渲染探针 | 六场景：答题卡、失败卡（打开/重试/忽略）、失焦不弹、缺 slot props 不崩、对象型 status 兼容、完成卡；另断言气泡出现 `⏳10分` | ✅ 全绿 |
| 真实交互 | 使用者本机实测跨会话答题弹窗：能选、能提交、能续上原对话 | ✅ |
| 真实失败链路 | 会话 `59a3953c` 的 `upstream request timed out` → 失败卡正确出现 | ✅ |
| 远程推送 | 渠道请求构造有单测；未配凭据，真机没收到过消息 | ⚠️ 未验证 |
| PTC 预设 | 配置与 `ptc-runtime` 期限已写入；尚未在真浏览器跑一轮确认工具面板只剩 `run_code` | ⚠️ 未验证 |
| 自动选择记录卡 | 三道闸逻辑与渲染已测，真触发一次「超时自动提交」尚未发生 | ⚠️ 未验证 |

> 「未验证」三项是发布时的真实状态，不粉饰：它们需要凭据 / 真浏览器 / 真实空闲超时才会出现。

## 能做到什么

- **把模糊想法问成方案**：4 轮 × 6 题，每题给可选项 + 自填；每轮复述【已确认】【我的推断】【还差的】；收口《需求简报》。
- **不切对话也能答题**：任何会话在等你回答时，弹窗里就地选、就地提交。
- **知道别的会话在发生什么**：运行中 N、失败卡（打开/重试/忽略）、完成卡（看结果）。
- **自动选择不背着你**：只对弹窗真正显示过的题生效，计时从首次显示起算，事后留可归因的记录卡。
- **PTC 取证**：一次 `run_code` 里并发读文件 / 搜仓库 / 看目录，中间结果不进上下文，只返回要用的那几行。
- **手机提醒（可选）**：PushPlus / 企业微信群机器人 / Qmsg / Server酱 / 通用 webhook，五选一。

## 已知限制

| 限制 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 远程推送要自备凭据 | 仓库不带任何 key；不配就是纯本地提醒 |
| 不打包 `dsh-ops` 本体 | 它是第三方 Windows x64 原生插件（Rust 二进制）；不装照样能用，取证换成原生 bash/文件工具 |
| PTC 的等待受 `run_code` 期限约束 | 本包把提问设 300s、`run_code` 默认期限设 330s；自行改动时两者要一起改 |
| `/compact` 无重试 | DSH 自身行为，与本插件无关；撞上网络窗口失败就再按一次 |
| 客户端刷新、Host 重启 | `client.js` 改动刷新页面即可；Host 行 / 预设 / 技能的改动要重启 DSH |

## 许可

MIT。

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `allowedModels` | `[]` | Model whitelist, adapter mode only — legacy sidecar ignores it (plugin 0.3.14+, issue #83): exact model ids DSH may show and call. Empty exposes every eligible free-lane model. Narrowing only — paid/deprecated/blocklist/probe rules still win, and a direct call to a non-whitelisted id fails fast with a tagged error before any network traffic. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | **Local OpenCode delegation** (plugin 0.3.x, [docs/delegation.md](docs/delegation.md), ref #76) — opt-in fallback for the persistent `403 FreeTierError` credential gate. Disabled by default; the anonymous path is unchanged unless you enable it: ```yaml delegation: enabled: true # arm the delegate (default false) # opencodePath: '' # explicit binary; else managed -> global -> npm # minVersion: '1.18.0' # candidates below this are skipped # memLimit: '96MiB' # GOMEMLIMIT for the child # gcPercent: 30 # GOGC for the child # trimIntervalMs: 60000 # Windows EmptyWorkingSet tick; 0 disables # startTimeoutMs: 60000 # health-wait budget ``` Enabling it makes the plugin custody your opencode credential (only the `opencode` entry, seeded 0600 into an isolated XDG root, never logged) and run a managed local `opencode serve` when — and only when — the anonymous lane *and* its sibling retry both refuse with the credential gate. Read [docs/delegation.md](docs/delegation.md) §2 before enabling. ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely ca

plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect. # dsh-bing

[![CI](https://github.com/lsl1931/dsh-bing/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/lsl1931/dsh-bing/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-5b8cff)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)

> English: Windows toast notifications for DSH that name the project, with a warm, selectable phone-style sound pack.

给 DSH 桌面端的**带项目名 Windows 通知**：会话结束、出错或停下来等你时 **bing** 你一下。内置一套柔和、接近手机系统提示音的合成音效，可在插件详情页里逐个试听和切换。

当前版本 **0.2.1**，已在 DSH 桌面端 0.2.1-rc.2 / Windows 11 上实装。

## 为什么再做一个

参考插件 dsh-notify-desktop 的接缝选得很对，但两件事不顺手：

1. 通知只说了“任务完成”，没说是哪个项目、哪次会话；
2. 电子短音太生硬；这一版换成温和的铃、木琴、卡林巴、水滴，带一点房间混响。

这个仓库同时保留原插件已经验证过的东西：窗口有焦点不打扰、点通知回前台、切回窗口立刻停声、服务级提问也能提醒。

## 特性

- 标题：**项目名 · 已完成** / 出错了 / 等你确认 / 还在等你
- 正文：真实会话标题 + 本轮摘要
- 项目名解析：重命名过的工作区标题 → cwd 最后一段 → 真实会话标题 → DSH
- 音效：8 个柔和合成音（0.8–1.9 秒），四类场景（完成 / 出错 / 等待 / 催办）各选一个，每个都能试听
- 入口：侧边栏 **插件 → dsh-bing 详情页** 的配置区，不占用设置页
- 自定义：导入自己的 wav/mp3/…；复制到本机用户目录，原文件移走也不影响
- 点通知把窗口拉回前台；宿主 Toast 的点击回包只有 `dsh://open`，所以不跳转会话

## 内置音效

| 名称 | 文件 | 场景 | 时长 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 极光 | sounds/01-aurora.wav | 完成（默认） | 1.8s |
| 木琴 | sounds/02-marimba.wav | 完成 | 1.3s |
| 卡林巴 | sounds/03-kalimba.wav | 完成 | 1.1s |
| 玻璃 | sounds/04-glass.wav | 等待（默认） | 1.5s |
| 气泡 | sounds/05-bubble.wav | 等待 | 0.8s |
| 低音 | sounds/06-low.wav | 出错（默认） | 1.0s |
| 回声 | sounds/07-descend.wav | 出错 | 1.3s |
| 花开 | sounds/08-bloom.wav | 催办（默认） | 1.9s |

全部由 scripts/generate-sounds.mjs 合成，44.1kHz / 单声道 / 16-bit PCM，按 RMS 校准响度。
可以直接双击 `sounds/*.wav` 试听，也可以在插件详情页里点 ▶。

**关于苹果/华为原声**：它们的系统音效有版权，仓库不直接打包。这 8 个是按“软起音、木质/玻璃/铃、带一点空间感”的听感重新合成的。
如果你本机有正版音效文件，插件详情页的「添加音效…」可以直接导入；文件只复制到本机用户目录，不会上传。

## 环境

- Windows 10 / 11
- DSH 桌面端 0.2.x（profile `desktop`）
- 普通用户不需要 Node；仓库里的 `lib/` 已经构建好

## 安装

从 GitHub 安装（DSH CLI 会把参数转给 pnpm）：

    & "<DSH 桌面端安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "github:lsl1931/dsh-bing"

本地开发时用链接安装（路径换成你的 clone）：

    & "<DSH 桌面端安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "link:<绝对路径>\dsh-bing"

装完**完全退出并重启** DSH 桌面端。不要和 dsh-notify-desktop 同时启用，否则同一轮会弹两条通知。

所有数据都在本机：偏好存渲染层 localStorage，导入的音效复制到 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-bing\custom`，不上传任何内容。

## 配置

侧边栏打开 **插件**，进入 **dsh-bing** 详情页。配置区在描述和组件列表之间，
包含总开关、提示音、五类结束状态、三类等待确认、四类音效选择 + 试听、催办分钟数、测试通知、自定义音效导入/删除/缓存清理。

这是 plugin-manager 给组合包自带配置的官方 slot（`plugins.bundle.config`，key `dsh-bing`），不需要修改 harness。

## 开发

零运行时依赖；宿主是纯 ESM，客户端是 CJS 模块由 `build.mjs` 打成一个 bundle。

    npm run sounds         # 重新生成 8 个音效
    npm run sounds:check   # 校验已提交的音效（含逐字节可复现）
    npm test               # node:test（36 个用例）
    npm run build          # 生成 lib/index.js、lib/shared/*、lib/client.js
    npm run check          # 音效校验 + 单测 + 构建

Node >= 22。改完源码后重新 `npm run build` 并重启 DSH。

## 已知限制

- 仅 Windows；Toast 与 System.Media.SoundPlayer 都是 Windows 路径。
- 点通知只回前台，不跳会话。
- 顶层插件列表卡片不显示配置；配置在 dsh-bing 的详情页。
- 苹果/华为原始系统音效有版权，仓库只提供风格接近的合成音；自定义导入走本机目录。

## 目录

    src/index.js          宿主半：projection + 13 条路由 + Toast/音频
    src/shared/           schema、projection、音效库与 WAV 缓存
    src/client/           watcher、文案、设置、React 配置面板
    sounds/catalog.json   内置音效的单一事实来源
    scripts/              合成与 WAV 工具
    lib/                  构建产物（提交，profile 直接链接）
    PLAN.md               实现规划与设计决策

## 参考与许可

实现思路参考了 [paleech0/dsh-notify-desktop](https://github.com/paleech0/dsh-notify-desktop)（MIT）公开的行为与接缝说明；代码为本仓库独立实现。

音效文件由本仓库脚本生成，随本仓库以 MIT 发布。许可证见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Desktop 的 Agent Teams 提供成员级模型/思考强度路由，并允许主对话释放（删除）团队成员子智能体运行实例。

# dsh-plugin-team-subagent-control

这是一个**DeepSeek Desktop（DSH）**的"智能体团队（Agent Teams）"模式补上两项能力：

1. **按成员指定模型与思考强度（reasoning effort）** —— 粒度是"每个团队成员一个"，不影响主对话和其它成员。
2. **主对话可以删除团队成员子代理** —— 释放它的运行实例（含它自己带出来的子代理），主代理/团长不允许删除。

两项能力都以**模型可见的工具**形式提供（按你的选择：不做设置面板）。

---

## 1. 前置确认结论

| 项目 | 结论 | 来源 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 接入方式 | Cordis **宿主插件行**（`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 行），无需 `isolate` realm、无需前端 bundle | 已按宿主既有插件格式实现 |
| 运行依赖 | **零 npm 依赖**：不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包，只消费宿主注入的服务 | 本仓库代码 |
| 作用粒度 | **按成员**（per-member） | 你的确认 |
| 生效方式 | 覆盖该成员每次 LLM 调用的 `agent/request` 配置 | 宿主公开事件 `agent/request` |
| 思考强度取值 | **以模型自己声明的档位为准**，非法值拒绝并回报可选值 | 你的确认 + `llm.resolveModelInfo()` |
| 删除语义 | **释放运行实例**；宿主没有"抹掉名册"的 API，故名册里该成员会变成 `inactive`，可被再次唤起 | 你的确认 + 宿主 API 限制（见 §5.2） |
| 可删范围 | 只允许删团队成员，**禁止删主代理/团长** | 你的确认 |
| 删除后可否恢复 | 可以：名册记录保留，`send_message` 会冷恢复（但该成员的模型指定已被清除，回到继承） | 宿主既有语义 |

---

## 2. 文件结构

```
dsh-plugin-team-subagent-control/
├─ package.json          # ESM 包声明；dsh.bundle.patch 指向 cordis.patch.yml（走包安装时用）
├─ cordis.patch.yml      # 宿主插件行定义（insert 一行）
├─ lib/
│  ├─ index.js           # 插件入口：name / inject / apply；注册工具 + 挂事件监听
│  ├─ tools.js           # 4 个模型可见工具的定义与编排
│  ├─ routes.js          # 模型/档位覆盖的存储与 agent/request 合并逻辑
│  ├─ release.js         # "删除成员" = 中断 → 释放下属 → 释放本体 → 复核
│  ├─ team.js            # 团队身份/成员解析、存活判定、状态渲染
│  └─ util.js            # 日志、错误描述、safely() 兜底、输出格式
├─ test/
│  └─ smoke.mjs          # 假宿主自测（零依赖，node test/smoke.mjs）
└─ README.md
```

### 各模块职责与对接点

| 模块 | 对接的宿主能力 | 职责 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | `ctx.tools.register()`、`ctx.on('agent/created')`、`ctx.on('session/disposed')`、`ctx.get('agents')` | 装配与兜底；给已在场和新出现的团队成员挂覆盖钩子 |
| `lib/routes.js` | `ctx.get('llm').resolveModelInfo()`、每个 Agent 自己的 `ctx.on('agent/request')` | 保存覆盖、把它合并进冻结的 `LlmCallConfig` |
| `lib/release.js` | `agentTeams.interrupt()`、`subagents.drainContinuableDescendants()`、`subagents.drainContinuableChildren()`、`agentTeams.listMembers()`、`agents.get()` | 删除流程与真实状态复核 |
| `lib/team.js` | `agentTeams.tryMembership()/listMembers()`、`agents.get()` | 判断"我在不在团里、对方是不是成员"并渲染成人类可读状态 |
| `lib/tools.js` | `tools.register()` 的工具契约 | 4 个工具的参数校验、错误文案、结果汇总 |

---

## 3. 安装

插件零依赖，所以有两种装法。**推荐 A**（不碰 npm，最稳）。

### 方式 A：用 `file:///` 行直接挂载（推荐）

1. 把整个 `dsh-plugin-team-subagent-control` 目录放到一个**长期存在**的路径，例如
   `D:\\github-code\\dsh-plugin-team-subagent-control`。
2. 打开 profile 的补丁层：
   `C:\\Users\\<你>\\AppData\\Roaming\\dsh-desktop\\harness\\profiles\\web\\cordis.patch.yml`
3. 在文件末尾追加（注意 YAML 缩进，URL 里的空格写成 `%20`）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: team-subagent-control
      name: "file:///D:/DeepSeek%20Harness/dsh-plugin-team-subagent-control/lib/index.js"
```

4. 保存。该 profile 的 `dsh.profile.patchReload` 是 `live`，保存后通常**热生效**。
   若工具没有出现，重启 DeepSeek Desktop。
5. 打开日志确认一行：
   `[team-subagent-control] 已加载：team_route_options / team_set_member_route / team_member_status / team_delete_member`

> 只加这一处即可。**不要**同时使用方式 B，否则同名工具会注册两次。

### 方式 B：作为包安装（市场 / `dsh plugin add`）

本目录已有 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `cordis.patch.yml`，因此可以直接以包形式安装。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add link:D:\\github-code\\dsh-plugin-team-subagent-control
```

安装后重启；包的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会自动插入同一行。若你的环境没有 `dsh` 命令，用市场插件管理界面按本地路径安装，效果相同。

### 卸载

- 方式 A：删掉那 3 行 YAML。
- 方式 B：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-team-subagent-control`（或界面里禁用）。

### 自测（不依赖 DSH，随时可跑）

```powershell
cd "D:\\github-code\\dsh-plugin-team-subagent-control"
node test/smoke.mjs
```

它会用假宿主跑 20 组断言，覆盖：档位校验、覆盖合并、路由失效回退、删除只动目标、拒绝删团长、服务缺失、调用取消等退化路径，以及 `apply()` 在服务全缺时也能正常激活。

---

## 4. 使用

启用后先进"智能体团队"模式，然后直接在对话里说人话即可，模型会调用对应工具。

**A. 先查有哪些模型与档位**

> 看看现在能用哪些模型，以及 `deepseek-flash` 支持哪些思考强度。

工具调用：`team_route_options` → `team_route_options(provider, model)`

**B. 给某个成员换模型/档位**

> 把 alice 换成 deepseek-pro，思考强度用 max。bob 保持现在的模型，但档位降到 low。

工具调用：
```
team_set_member_route(member="alice", provider="deepseek-official", model="deepseek-pro", reasoning_effort="max")
team_set_member_route(member="bob", reasoning_effort="low")     # 只改档位，模型沿用
```

只给档位时，插件读该成员**当前活着的** `agent.options` 来补全 provider/model。成员没有运行实例时会拒绝并提示显式给出 provider+model。

**C. 查看谁在用哪个模型？**

> 现在每个成员分别用的什么模型？哪些是继承主对话的？

工具调用：`team_member_status`

输出形如：
```
- alice｜teammate｜running｜已指定：deepseek-official / deepseek-pro @ max
- bob｜teammate｜inactive｜继承：deepseek-official / deepseek-flash @ low
```

**D. 删除成员**

> 把 alice 删掉。

工具调用：`team_delete_member(member="alice")`

返回会明确写**释放前状态 / 释放后状态 / 运行实例是否还在**，并附过程记录（是否先中断了它的回合、是否连带释放了它下属的子代理）。

**E. 撤销模型指定**

> 让 alice 回到跟随主对话。

工具调用：`team_set_member_route(member="alice", clear=true)`

---

## 5. 工作原理（以及为什么删除只能做到这一步）

### 5.1 模型与思考强度

- 宿主 `AgentOptions` 就是 `{ provider?, model?, reasoningEffort?, maxTokens?, subagentDepth? }`。
  每次模型调用前由 `agent/request` waterfall（payload `{ turn, step, signal }`）产出冻结的
  `LlmCallConfig = { provider, model, reasoningEffort?, temperature?, maxTokens?, stop? }`。
- 本插件在**每个团队成员自己的 ctx** 上监听 `agent/request`：先 `await next()` 拿到宿主原生配置，
  再把覆盖字段浅合并进去，其余字段（`maxTokens`、`temperature` 等）原样保留。
- 档位归属规则与宿主 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent` 一致：`reasoningEffort` 属于"模型自己的词汇表"，
  所以**换模型且没有显式指定档位时，会丢弃继承来的档位**，绝不把旧档位发给新模型。
- 档位合法值来自 `llm.resolveModelInfo(provider, model).reasoning.efforts[].id`（含 `defaultEffort`），
  设置时即时校验，非法值直接把可选值列回去。

### 5.2 删除子智能体

宿主**没有** `agentTeams.deleteMember/removeMember` 这类 API（`agentTeams` 只有
`membership / listMembers / spawnTeammate / sendMessage / interrupt / waitForChange / 任务板`）。
真正可用的释放路径是子代理层面：

| 行为 | 宿主 API |
| --- | --- |
| 判定成员存活 | `agents.get(sessionId)`；团队自己的 `memberView()` 就是用它的 `status`（`running` / `inactive`）。 |
| 停当前回合 | `agentTeams.interrupt(caller, targetName)`（仅团长可调用） |
| 释放成员本体 | `subagents.drainContinuableChildren(parent, [childId])`（`dsh-subagent/lib/typert.host.js:163`），要求 `parent` 是**同一个活着的** Agent |
| 释放成员带出来的子代理 | `subagents.drainContinuableDescendants([memberAgent])` |

所以删除流程是：**解析目标 → 拒绝主代理 → 正在跑就先 `interrupt` → 释放下属 → `drainContinuableChildren` → 用 `listMembers` + `agents.get` 复核**。
每一步都有 20s 超时，任何一步失败都变成一句可读说明，不会把主对话卡住或抛异常。

**关键限制（请务必知悉）**：`drainContinuableChildren` 释放的是**运行实例**，团队名册是持久化的（Lead 会话日志），宿主没有删除名册行的 API，因此删除后
`listMembers` / 界面里该成员仍然存在，状态显示 `inactive`。这正是"界面状态与实际状态一致"：卡上显示 inactive，实际也确实没有运行实例了；
再次 `send_message` 会冷恢复它。若你要"彻底消失"，只能等宿主开放名册删除 API。

---

## 6. 稳定性设计（对应验收标准）

| 要求 | 实现 |
| --- | --- |
| 不破坏原有功能 | 插件是**新增** 4 个工具 + 在两个事件上加监听；不接管、不替换任何宿主工具（`list_agents`/`send_message`/`interrupt_agent` 原样可用）。 |
| 激活失败不拖垮宿主 | `apply()` 内部全部走 `safely()`；单个工具注册失败只记日志，其余工具照常注册；`inject` 只强制要求 `tools`，其余服务懒取。 |
| 操作失败有明确提示 | 所有失败返回 `✖ 原因 \n提示：下一步怎么做`，并区分 `UNAUTHORIZED`/超时/模型不存在/档位非法。 |
| 不阻塞主对话 | 释放流程带 20s 超时；覆盖钩子出错时**完整回退**宿主原配置；调用被取消时立刻返回且不落任何修改。 |
| 不误伤 | 覆盖只挂在"当前团成员"的 ctx 上，一次性 one-shot 子代理不参与；删除精确到单个 `sessionId`，并用宿主真实状态复核后才宣布成功。 |
| 幂等 | 对已释放成员重复删除不会报错；重复设置覆盖直接覆盖旧值。 |

---

## 7. 已知限制

1. **不能删除名册行**：见 §5.2，宿主无 API。删掉的只是运行实例。
2. **不能预设新成员的路由**：宿主 `spawn_teammate` 只接受 `provider`（spawn provider，如 `spawn`/`fork`），
   不接受 model/effort。因此只能"先创建、后指定"，指定从该成员的**下一个**回合生效。
3. **指定是进程内状态**：重启 DSH 后成员的模型指定丢失，回到继承主对话。
   （如需持久化，可后续接 `settings` 命名空间，见 §8 第 1 条。）
4. **删除会清掉该成员的模型指定**：避免被冷恢复后"带着旧设定复活"。若你更希望保留，改
   `lib/tools.js` 里 `team_delete_member` 中的一行即可。
5. **只覆盖 LLM 路由**：不改系统提示、工具集、预算；`maxTokens`/`temperature` 不提供设置入口。
6. **档位校验依赖 `llm.resolveModelInfo`**：宿主若未暴露该方法，插件会放行但打警告。
   拼写错误会在该成员回合由宿主报错。
7. **非团队模式**：工具会明确说明"当前会话不在智能体团队中"，不做任何隐含动作。
8. **成员互删不支持**：只有团长能删（与宿主 `interrupt` 的权限模型一致）。
9. **若宿主未来把团队成员改成非直系子代理**：`drainContinuableChildren` 会返回
